jobs.title: Director of Business Development - US
jobs.excerpt: Role OverviewDriven by surging demand for immersive and volumetric content, as well as new perspectives that can unlock creative storytelling, Muybridge is commercialising a genuinely novel technology platform across sports broadcast, premium studio production, and live entertainment.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

Driven by surging demand for immersive and volumetric content, as well as new perspectives that can unlock creative storytelling, Muybridge is commercialising a genuinely novel technology platform across sports broadcast, premium studio production, and live entertainment. This comes at a defining moment for the broadcast industry: after decades of relative stability, the convergence of GPU computing, computer vision, and autonomous production is fundamentally reshaping how content is captured, produced, and distributed. The buyers, workflows, and value chains that defined the last generation are being rewritten and Muybridge is at the centre of that shift. This is a rare opportunity to be first in - building a territory, owning a pipeline, and closing landmark deals that define a category.

The Director of Business Development - US will be the primary commercial presence across the region. Operating from a home office, you will represent Muybridge independently across a complex, multi-stakeholder value chain: leagues, clubs, venues, broadcasters, production service companies, studio operators, and live event producers. You will carry an annual revenue quota and be expected to over-deliver on it.

Success in this role requires working on two levels simultaneously: managing and developing channel partnerships - the service companies, systems integrators, and broadcast partners through whom deals are often structured and delivered, while also creating demand and building conviction at the top of the value chain with rights holders, leagues, federations, and executive decision-makers. You will be expected to be present at key live deployments, acting as the commercial face of Muybridge on-site, strengthening partner and client relationships in the field, and supporting the deployment team when needed.

This is a senior, self-sufficient role - one for someone equally comfortable in a boardroom and a broadcast truck. You will carry technical conversations with prospects, supported remotely by our technical team, and close enterprise-level deals that often span multiple decision-makers and long sales cycles. You report directly to the CCO and collaborate closely with your East Coast counterpart to ensure cohesive national coverage.

What You'll Do

Revenue Generation & Channel Partner Development

  • Own and manage a structured West US pipeline, forecasting accurately and reporting to the CCO on a regular cadence.
  • Meet and exceed an annual sales quota through a combination of new logo acquisition and expansion within existing accounts.
  • Develop account plans for key strategic targets and execute against them with discipline and creativity.
  • Maintain a rigorous and up-to-date record of all conversations, opportunities, and account activity in the company's CRM system, ensuring full pipeline visibility for the leadership team.
  • Prepare, submit, and negotiate commercial proposals and offers, managing the full arc from initial qualification through to signed agreement.
  • Steer legal documents and partnership agreements to closure, working closely with the CCO and internal stakeholders to navigate complex contract structures and multi-party negotiations.
  • Conduct business and commercial modelling to assess deal economics, validate pricing structures, and ensure sustainable value creation for both Muybridge and its customers and partners.
  • Coordinate closely with the East Coast Director of Business Development to ensure cohesive national coverage, avoid overlap, and maximise joint opportunities where accounts or partners span both territories.
  • Serve as the regional voice on market dynamics, competitor activity, pricing feedback, and emerging customer need.
  • Contribute to commercial strategy, proposal development, and partnership structuring discussions with the CCO and leadership team.

You will deploy this commercial approach across three priority verticals. The three verticals below represent Muybridge's current priority markets in order of revenue focus. As the platform scales, so will the addressable opportunity - spanning additional industries where computer vision and volumetric capture will reshape how content is created and consumed.

1. Sports Broadcast

  • Develop and close opportunities across the US sports broadcast ecosystem: leagues, franchises, venues, host broadcasters, rights holders, production service partners, and technology partners, with a focus on properties and stakeholders based on the West Coast.
  • Build and manage relationships with rights holders and broadcast partners across key US sports properties West US presence, including the major sports leagues like the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, PGA and emerging sports with large audiences.
  • Navigate complex multi-party value chains where technology, rights, and production responsibilities are distributed across several organisations.
  • Represent Muybridge at industry events, trade shows, and broadcast forums across the region.

2. Studio & Network Production

  • Identify and develop opportunities with the studio and broadcast teams of major US TV networks, streaming platforms (Netflix, Amazon, Apple TV+ and equivalents), and independent production companies with the intent of promoting and adopting a novel way to capture content that was previously impossible, unlocking new perspectives and introducing new forms of storytelling.
  • Target sports studios, news operations, scripted and unscripted productions, and film projects where the Muybridge platform creates a step-change in production value or workflow, leveraging the proximity to the world's most concentrated cluster of studio and streaming infrastructure on the West Coast.
  • Build relationships with creative directors, heads of production, technical directors, and commissioning executives across broadcast and streaming.

3. Live Events & Entertainment

  • Develop pipeline across the live events sector: major music tours, festivals, arena entertainment, and high-profile cultural productions seeking next-generation capture capabilities.
  • Partner with promoters, venues, production companies, and brand experience agencies - particularly across the LA, Las Vegas, and Pacific Northwest markets, to integrate Muybridge technology into premium live productions.

What We're Looking For

  • 8–12 years of experience in business development, enterprise sales, or commercial partnerships within sports media, broadcast technology, studio production, or live entertainment, or a combination of these.
  • A proven track record of hitting and exceeding revenue targets in complex, multi-stakeholder sales environments.
  • Comfortable operating at the intersection of technology, media, and live production, able to hold a credible technical conversation without engineering support in the room. A working understanding of broadcast workflows, signal chains, or production infrastructure is a meaningful advantage.
  • Existing network across US broadcasters, leagues, franchises, streaming platforms, or production companies is a strong advantage.
  • Experience selling novel or emerging technology into conservative or risk-averse buyers, you know how to build conviction around something new.
  • Highly self-directed: able to build pipeline from scratch, manage your own schedule, and operate without daily management support.
  • Willing and able to travel frequently across the US and occasionally internationally.
  • Based in a Pacific or Mountain time zone; candidates from LA, Seattle, Portland, Denver, Phoenix, or Salt Lake City are welcome while Bay Area candidates are considered on merit.

What Makes This Role Exciting

  • These are the first dedicated commercial roles at Muybridge, and the people who fill them will form the core of the commercial leadership team as the company scales.
  • You will be a vital commercial presence in the US for a technology that lives in a unique moment with no direct competitor and is deeply protected by patents, the category is yours to define.
  • The West Coast is ground zero for global streaming and studio production and you'll be selling into the world's most sophisticated content buyers from your doorstep.
  • You will work directly with the CCO and leadership team, with short decision-making cycles and real influence on commercial strategy.
  • You will close deals that appear in major broadcast productions + live events seen by millions.
  • Competitive base salary with a 50/50 performance-based structure designed to reward significant over-performance.
  • You will join at a pivotal moment - Series A closed, commercially proven, and ready to scale.

About the Role

An Australian company/client is looking for an experienced Meta Ads Specialist to manage and optimize paid social campaigns targeting high-end and luxury travelers, with a particular focus on North American clients travelling to Australia and cruise travelers.

Experience marketing to US and Canadian audiences, particularly travelers planning trips to Australia, will be highly regarded.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, launch and manage Meta (Facebook and Instagram) advertising campaigns targeting high-value and luxury travel audiences.
  • Develop audience strategies focused on North American travellers, particularly those from the US and Canada travelling to Australia.
  • Create and manage campaigns targeting cruise travellers and other high-intent travel audiences.
  • Develop strategies to reach affluent and luxury consumers who are interested in premium travel experiences.
  • Conduct audience research and identify relevant interests, behaviours, demographics and lookalike audiences.
  • Manage campaign budgets and optimise campaigns to achieve strong lead generation, enquiry and booking outcomes.

  • Conduct A/B testing across audiences, creative, messaging, placements and campaign objectives.
  • Work with the broader marketing team to develop effective ad messaging and creative concepts that appeal to a luxury audience.
  • Identify opportunities to improve lead quality and reduce wasted advertising spend.
  • Analyse campaign data and provide clear recommendations based on performance.
  • Implement retargeting strategies for website visitors, previous engagers, video viewers and other relevant audiences.
  • Keep up to date with Meta Ads platform changes, targeting capabilities, best practices and privacy-related changes.
  • Provide regular reporting on campaign performance, insights and recommended next steps.

Key Requirements

  • Proven experience managing Meta Ads campaigns professionally, ideally with responsibility for significant advertising budgets.
  • Demonstrated experience generating qualified leads, enquiries or bookings through Meta advertising.
  • Experience working with luxury, premium or high-end brands is highly desirable.
  • Experience within travel, tourism, cruises, luxury hospitality or a related industry is strongly preferred.
  • Experience targeting North American audiences (US and/or Canada).
  • Understanding of the Australian travel market and/or experience targeting international visitors travelling to Australia is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager, campaign structures, audiences, retargeting and conversion tracking.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret campaign data and make commercially sound decisions.
  • Experience with Meta Pixel, Conversions API and/or other conversion tracking tools is advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of customer journeys and how to move prospects from awareness through to enquiry and booking.
  • Excellent written English and an understanding of how messaging needs to be adapted for a high-end/luxury customer.

Ideal Background

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked with:

  • Luxury travel brands
  • Cruise companies or cruise-related businesses
  • Premium tourism and destination marketing
  • Luxury hotels and resorts
  • High-end travel agencies
  • Premium hospitality
  • High-value experiences and services
  • North American travel markets
  • Australian tourism campaigns targeting international travellers

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured not simply by generating clicks or impressions, but by attracting high-quality prospective customers who are genuinely interested in premium travel to Australia and ultimately convert into enquiries and bookings.

The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate how they have previously used Meta advertising to reach affluent audiences, generate qualified leads and deliver measurable commercial results.

Founding Institutional Solutions Lead, Cycles Prime

Full Time, Remote (US only)

About Cycles

Cycles' mission is to clear the most debt, for the most people, with the least money. We are building a neutral clearing layer that interconnects every settlement network across global financial markets. By optimizing payment and credit flows, Cycles resolves gridlock and improves capital efficiency and liquidity across the financial system.

Cycles is an independent venture backed startup originally incubated by Informal Systems. Cycles is backed by Blockchange Ventures, Coinbase Ventures, CMCC Global, Maven11, Compound VC, Primitive Ventures, Nascent and Cygni. This role presents a rare opportunity to join a high growth startup and be a part of the founding team led by Ethan Buchman, co-founder of Cosmos.

About Cycles Prime

Cycles Prime is a clearing solution for crypto trading firms that preserves working capital and reduces reliance on credit lines. It requires no collateral, no asset escrow, and no new counterparties, using a graph flow algorithm and advanced privacy technology to identify multilateral obligation cycles that can be netted, privately and provably, without moving cash.

About the Role

Crypto trading firms have billions in working capital tied up in bilateral exposures across venues. Cycles Prime frees it. We are in pilot with some of the largest trading firms in the market and need someone who can move them from pilot to production.

As an Institutional Solutions Lead, you help shape the product, carry the technical conversation on customer calls, stay close to firms through pilot, and run parts of deals yourself.

You have done trade ops at a trading firm, either in your current role or a prior one. You know how post trade actually runs and want to apply that to building something new.

In this role, you will

  • Run the account from onboarding through pilot, handling integrations and unblocking issues for buyers and users.
  • Support BD and partnerships,working with the exec team on strategy and carrying the technical and operational conversation on calls with heads of ops, middle office, risk, and treasury. You also help tighten how we pitch to the ops side of these firms.
  • Shape the Product, working directly with engineering and leadership on what we build next. You take counterparty feedback and turn it into real requirements. If something we are shipping will not hold up in a live ops workflow, you catch it before it goes out.

What we are looking for

  • Five to ten years of experience, with at least a few in trade operations, middle office, or settlement ops at a crypto trading firm, OTC desk, market maker, prime broker, exchange, or TradFi institution. You know post trade: settlement, reconciliation, collateral, counterparty risk, treasury.
  • Hands on experience with the settlement stack trading firms actually use. On the crypto side, that is Fireblocks, ClearLoop, BitGo Go Network, CUBIX, or similar. On the TradFi side, tri party, prime brokerage platforms, or CCP workflows. Post trade and OEMS tools like Talos are a plus.
  • You understand crypto market structure across centralized venues, OTC, and on chain settlement.
  • You can hold your own on a call with a head of ops or a risk lead. You ask the right follow ups and bring what you hear back to the product team without flattening it.
  • High agency. There is no playbook here. You see what matters and go do it.

Some of our benefits include

  • A unique, caring and friendly culture
  • 20 days (4 weeks) of paid vacation annually
  • Company closure from December 25th to January 1
  • Annual Lifestyle benefits (reimbursements for gym memberships, fitness equipment, etc)

  • Annual company retreats
  • Paid parental leave
  • ….. and many more!

The salary range for this role is 130,000 to 190,000 USD and may vary based on factors like location and experience.

jobs.excerpt: Why Keyrus, Why Now! Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses.
jobs.description:
Why Keyrus, Why Now!

Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence.

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating.

At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.

Role Details

📍 Job location:Portugal or Spain (Remote model- 8:00 - 17:00 h)
🕒 Contract type: Employee/ Contractor B2B
🗓 Target start date: End of 2026 Q4/ 2027 Q1
⏰ Working hours: Full-time (40h/week)
💵 Compensation: 45 - 50k per year or 280 daily rate

📋 What You'll Architect

As a Senior Data Engineerwith strong expertise inSnowflake, you will help organisations transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining technology, data, intelligence, and human decision-making.

This role is both technical and consultative, perfect for someone who can combine data engineering expertise, large-scale migration delivery, and modern cloud data platform design. We're looking for professionals who think like architects and act like builders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the migration of data workflows from Hadoop/Hive environments into Snowflake.

  • Design and implement a scalable Migration Factory to industrialise and automate migration processes.

  • Develop and optimise Dataiku workflows supporting data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and automation.

  • Design and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines to improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.

  • Analyse existing data solutions and identify opportunities for optimisation and performance improvement.

  • Implement scalable and high-performing Snowflake architectures, ensuring security, governance, and operational excellence.

  • Collaborate with Data Architects, Business Analysts, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

  • Contribute to documentation, knowledge transfer, and engineering best practices across projects.

👤 Who You Are

  • You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving complex data engineering challenges.

  • You enjoy transforming legacy environments into modern, scalable cloud data platforms.

  • You combine strong technical expertise with a practical understanding of business objectives.

  • You are comfortable working in collaborative and international environments.

  • You thrive when designing efficient, repeatable, and industrialised data processes.

  • You take ownership of technical initiatives and drive them through to successful delivery.

  • You enjoy investigating performance bottlenecks and identifying opportunities for optimisation.

  • You communicate clearly and effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

  • You are comfortable working in French and English within an international project environment.

🛠️ What You Bring

Qualifications & Experience

  • Relevant academic background in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 6+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role.

  • Proven experience delivering data migration programmes, ideally within Lift & Shift initiatives.

  • Strong experience working with modern data warehousing and data platform technologies.

  • Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.

  • Professional proficiency in English.

  • Professional proficiency in French.

  • Must be a Portuguese or European citizen or have a work permit for Portugal

Technical & Professional Skills

  • Strong expertise with Snowflake (data modelling, optimisation, performance tuning, security).

  • Hands-on experience with Dataiku or equivalent tools (Alteryx, Talend, Azure Data Factory, Informatica, Knime, Apache NiFi).

  • Strong experience with: Hadoop; Hive;Legacy-to-cloud migration projects

  • Proficiency in:

    • SQL

    • Relational databases

    • Analytical databases

  • Proficiency in big data frameworks such as Apache Spark, or alternatives (Databricks, Flink, Beam).

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to design scalable and maintainable data solutions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

  • Programming experience with Python or Scala.

  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices for data engineering.

  • Understanding of Data Governance, Data Quality, and Data Security best practices.

  • Experience working in consulting or client-facing environments.

  • Exposure to international projects and multicultural teams.

⭐ What Makes You Successful

  • You focus on delivering reliable, scalable, and business-ready data solutions.

  • You approach migration challenges with both technical rigor and pragmatism.

  • You think beyond individual pipelines and contribute to the long-term evolution of data platforms.

  • You are passionate about automation, standardisation, and engineering efficiency.

  • You communicate complex technical concepts in a clear and accessible way.

  • You proactively identify performance improvements and optimisation opportunities.

  • You contribute to collective intelligence by sharing knowledge and supporting others.

  • You combine autonomy with collaboration and thrive in cross-functional environments.

  • You continuously seek opportunities to improve platform performance, data quality, and engineering standards.

🎁What We Offer at Keyrus Portugal

  • Competitive salary aligned with your experience and the data market

  • Meal allowance: €10.20/day

  • Flexible benefits plan

  • Private medical insurance

  • 22 days of annual leave, increasing every 3 years (up to 25 days)

  • Continuous learning via KLX – Keyrus Learning Experience

  • A collaborative, international, and human-centred work environment

💰How Our Salary Ranges Work

At Keyrus, salary ranges reflect different levels of mastery and impact within the same role — not different job titles.

  • Bottom of the range
    You meet the core requirements and will need ramp-up time and support.

  • Middle of the range
    You are fully autonomous from Day 1 and deliver consistently.

  • Top of the range
    You are a reference for the role, mentor others, and raise the bar for the team.

Final offers are based on experience, autonomy, scope, and market context, and are discussed transparently during the process.

🔒Responsible AI & Recruitment

At Keyrus, all stages of our recruitment process are conducted and evaluated by human recruiters and interviewers.
To support accuracy and efficiency, AI may occasionally be used internally by our team exclusively for note-taking purposes during interviews. AI is never used to make decisions.

To ensure fairness, authenticity, and the protection of confidential and proprietary information, the use of AI tools by candidates during the recruitment process is strictly prohibited.

Our commitment to responsible AI practices ensures that hiring decisions are based solely on each candidate’s own skills, experience, judgment, and expertise.

⚠️Any use of AI assistance during the interview process may result in immediate disqualification from the recruitment process.

We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and encourage applications from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

Work with a Purpose:

At Hello Alice we are about equal access fueled by technology and powered by everyone who believes that diverse small business participation isn’t just the right thing to do, but the smart thing to do. That’s true of our small business owners, and it’s true of our team. If you agree, keep reading.

We currently support dozens of top-tier enterprise partners including Amazon, PayPal, Verizon, Google, Mastercard, PepsiCo, DoorDash, eBay, among many others with high-touch small business programs (grants and accelerator programs), events, and marketing services.   • You will drive complex sales cycles working cross functionally with product, marketing and brand teams

jobs.excerpt: About usMythic is building the future of AI computing with breakthrough analog technology that delivers 100× the performance of traditional digital systems at the same power and cost.
jobs.description:
About us

Mythic is building the future of AI computing with breakthrough analog technology that delivers 100× the performance of traditional digital systems at the same power and cost. This unlocks bigger, more capable models and faster, more responsive applications—whether in edge devices like drones, robotics, and sensors, or in cloud and data center environments. Our technology powers everything from large language models and CNNs to advanced signal processing, and is engineered to operate from –40 °C to +125 °C, making it ideal for industrial, automotive, aerospace, and defense.
We’ve raised over $100M from world-class investors including Softbank, Threshold Ventures, Lux Capital, and DCVC, and secured multi-million-dollar customer contracts across multiple markets.

About the role

Join us in advancing the MLIR ecosystem at Mythic. You’ll help extend our existing high-level dialects and design a new hardware-aware low-level dialect, building conversion paths that bridge to our current IRs. Working closely with hardware engineers and ML developers, your work will expand interoperability with PyTorch and other frameworks, laying the groundwork for long-term innovation. The result: an MLIR-based stack that unifies hardware constraints with developer needs and accelerates adoption of modern ecosystems.

Here's what you will do

  • Architect the migration of the existing compiler flow into MLIR, defining dialects, passes, and lowering strategies.
  • Build conversion paths between MLIR and Mythic’s custom low-level IR to keep both flows operational during migration.
  • Define validation infrastructure within MLIR, including interpretation or execution paths for simulation and debugging.
  • Enable compilation by extending MLIR integration across analog accelerators and digital subsystems.
  • Leverage Torch-MLIR where PyTorch inputs are available, and guide future integration with PyTorch 2.0 compiler technologies (TorchInductor, TorchDynamo, Torch-MLIR)

Here's the background we hope you will have

  • 3+ years of experience in compiler or high-performance systems development.
  • Proficiency in modern C++ (C++14/17/20) and Python.
  • Direct, hands-on experience with MLIR, including dialect design, compiler passes, or lowering pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of compiler IRs and transformations, with the ability to reason about lowering from high-level ops to hardware-aware representations.

The following would be nice to have, but is not required

  • Experience architecting complete MLIR flows: from frontend dialects down to hardware-aware dialects, including conversion to and from existing IRs.
  • Familiarity with PyTorch compiler technologies, especially Torch-MLIR and integration paths with PyTorch 2.0 (TorchDynamo, TorchInductor).
  • Knowledge of dataflow architectures, scheduling, and memory orchestration.
  • Background in heterogeneous or specialized accelerators (e.g., analog compute, NPUs, GPUs, DSPs).

What we offer

  • Shape the MLIR and PyTorch integration strategy for novel AI hardware.
  • Opportunity to contribute upstream and influence the broader ML compiler ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with a team spanning hardware, runtime, and compiler design.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
At Mythic, we foster a collaborative and respectful environment where people can do their best work. We hire smart, capable individuals, provide the tools and support they need, and trust them to deliver. Our team brings a wide range of experiences and perspectives, which we see as a strength in solving hard problems together. We value professionalism, creativity, and integrity, and strive to make Mythic a place where every employee feels they belong and can contribute meaningfully.

jobs.excerpt: Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende parttimebaan om werkervaring op te doen in het sales vak?
jobs.description:
Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende parttimebaan om werkervaring op te doen in het sales vak? Lijkt het je daarnaast interessant om aan de basis te staan van ons Amerika avontuur? En hou je bovendien van veel verantwoordelijkheid en een omgeving waar je veel kan leren je kan ontwikkelen? Kom dan ons team versterken bij Public Outdoor Creations.

Startdatum zsm – je werkt remote.

Wat doe je als Werkstudent Sales?
Als Werkstudent Sales ga je per regio, Amerikaanse landschapsarchitectenbureaus benaderen om contactgegevens te achterhalen. Vervolgens stuur je een digitale brochure toe en doe je de benodigde opvolging. Jouw doel is om elke week de database met Amerikaanse prospects verder uit te bouwen. Je werkt daarin nauw samen met het hoofdkantoor en eventueel onze productielocatie in Seattle (USA).

Jouw werkzaamheden kunnen onder andere bestaan uit:

  • Searchen naar landschapsarchitecten per regio;
  • Telefonisch en per email benaderen landschapsarchitecten;
  • Vastleggen van contactgegevens in onze database;
  • Opvolgen van eventuele vragen zowel telefonische als per email;
  • Intern overdragen van prospects.

Wat zien we graag terug in jou als onze Werkstudent Sales?
Met jouw ondernemerschap en go-mentaliteit, maak je het verschil! We staan open voor goede ideeën en initiatieven, daarmee maak je maakt het verschil!

  • HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau - een commerciële opleiding is een pre;
  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels in woord en geschrift;
  • Je bent van nature resultaatgericht, gestructureerd en communicatief vaardig;
  • Je bent flexibel en zelfstandig en hebt bovendien affiniteit met design en sales;
  • Je bent ca 8 - 16 uur per week beschikbaar.

We vragen veel maar wat mag je van ons verwachten?
We hebben niet alleen een passie voor de beste kwaliteit en de mooiste designs, maar ook voor onze werknemers. We bieden een zeer uitdagende ervaringsplek met veel verantwoordelijkheden binnen een ondernemende omgeving.

  • Een unieke kans om een belangrijke basis van het sales vak te leren;
  • De kans om direct bij te dragen aan het succes van onze uitbereiding naar Amerika;
  • De kans om ervaring op te doen bij een snelgroeiend, internationaal opererend bedrijf;
  • Een goed salaris;
  • Mogelijkheid om na je studie door te groeien tot accountmanager USA.

Ben je enthousiast? Mooi! We horen graag van je! Stuur je sollicitatie naar Maarten Snoek via de " ik ben geïnteresseerd button".

Wie wij zijn:
Public Outdoor Creations brengt onder 2 verschillende merken (POC en PicnixX) een hoogwaardige collectie (straat) buitenmeubilair op de markt en is actief in de Benelux, UK, Ierland, Duitsland, Zwitserland en Oostenrijk. Sinds de oprichting in 2014 hebben wij een groot aantal nationale en internationale projecten gerealiseerd.

Om onze sterke internationale groei te faciliteren zijn wij opzoek naar een werkstudent (parttime) die een database gaat opbouwen van Amerikaanse prospects (landschapsarchitecten) als eerste en belangrijke stap voor onze Amerikaanse expansie.

jobs.title: Solar & Energy Storage Estimator
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleAs a Solar & Energy Storage Estimator on our Development team, you’ll prepare detailed cost estimates and support the technical and financial evaluation of solar PV and battery energy storage (BESS) projects, including augmentation strategies.
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Solar & Energy Storage Estimator on our Development team, you’ll prepare detailed cost estimates and support the technical and financial evaluation of solar PV and battery energy storage (BESS) projects, including augmentation strategies. Working closely with engineering, development, and procurement teams, you’ll contribute to project optimization and help Madison bring competitive, well-structured bids to market. This role offers direct impact on project execution and meaningful exposure across the full project lifecycle.

What You’ll Own

  • Cost Estimation – Develop detailed cost estimates for solar PV and BESS projects; maintain cost databases and estimating tools to support accuracy and consistency
  • Technical Analysis – Analyze project drawings, specifications, and proposals; interpret engineering documents to identify scope and cost drivers
  • BESS Optimization – Support BESS optimization work including augmentation strategy development and lifecycle cost analysis
  • Bid & Procurement Management – Manage and conduct EPC bid processes using Procore; solicit and evaluate vendor and subcontractor pricing; assist in bid preparation and RFP responses
  • Value Engineering – Identify value engineering opportunities and track market pricing trends to inform competitive positioning
  • Cross-Team Collaboration – Partner with engineering, development, and procurement teams to support project development and execution

What Will Help You Succeed

You don’t need to check every box, but here’s what will help you thrive.

  • 1–5 years of relevant experience in solar, energy storage, or related infrastructure estimating; BESS estimating experience, including familiarity with augmentation strategies and lifecycle cost analysis (preferred)
  • Background in civil, mechanical, or electrical engineering
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings and specifications
  • Strong Excel skills and analytical ability
  • Strong communication skills; able to collaborate effectively across engineering, development, and procurement functions
  • Experience using Procore for EPC bids and familiarity with Bluebeam for estimating (preferred)
  • Exposure to ISO markets or dispatch modeling (preferred)
  • Familiarity with PVsyst or similar solar modeling tools (preferred)
  • Knowledge of EPC structures and C&I solar + storage markets (preferred)

Benefits

  • PTO and company holidays
  • Medical, dental, vision
  • Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, life insurance
  • 401(k) and company match
  • Professional development stipend
  • Strong culture of collaboration, performance, and personal growth
$100,000 - $150,000 a year
The actual salary offered may vary depending on job-related factors including, but not limited to knowledge, skills, experience and location.

How We Work

At Madison Energy Infrastructure, we believe in the power of clean energy infrastructure to drive real impact—for our customers, our partners, and the communities we serve. We’ve quickly emerged as a preeminent developer, investor, and operator of distributed generation, helping organizations across sectors meet their energy goals with certainty, speed, and trust. Our robust portfolio consists of over half a gigawatt of clean energy infrastructure projects across more than 25 states.
We’re building a team that thrives on ownership and ambition. As we expand into direct, end-to-end services for Fortune 500 companies, public entities, and nonprofits alike, we rely on collaborative thinkers who bring structure to complexity, energy to execution, and curiosity to every challenge.
Our environment is fast-paced and outcome-oriented—but grounded in the belief that how we work together matters as much as what we deliver. If you’re excited to shape the future of clean energy and be part of a high-performance, high-integrity team, we’d love to meet you.
Madison Energy Infrastructure is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

jobs.description:
We seek to move the world forward through innovative thinking.

Woolpert is an award-winning, global leader in architecture, engineering, and geospatial services. We blend design excellence with cutting-edge technology to deliver exceptional client value. Position Overview

Woolpert is hiring a Senior Electrical Engineer to join our dynamic team. This position would be aligned with one of our offices in the US and would support full-time in-person, hybrid, or remote working arrangements.

This position is responsible for leading engineering projects, supporting strategic and KPI goals, contributing to proposals, overseeing project scope, schedule, and fee, and ensuring effective resources are assigned to projects. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication skills, technical expertise, and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously. This role includes performing electrical engineering technical work on complex projects, mentoring staff, applying proficiency in designing, analyzing, and reviewing buildings electrical systems to ensure safety, sustainability, and compliance with industry standards. Joining Woolpert's engineering team means becoming part of a dynamic and supportive environment where growth and creativity are not just encouraged but are integral to the team's success and Woolpert’s broader mission.

We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must already possess work authorization in the country the job is located.

What You Will Do:

As a Senior Engineer at Woolpert, you will:

  • Lead electrical engineering technical work for complex projects.
  • Track project progress, including scope, schedule, and fee.
  • Oversee technical review and provide high quality deliverables.
  • In depth knowledge for team guidance of models, plans, details, and drawings of electrical engineering systems and components according to established standards and modeling techniques.
  • In depth knowledge for team guidance of electrical design for various systems including medium-voltage distribution, microgrids, photovoltaic, battery systems, building power systems, lighting design, and low voltage systems.
  • In depth knowledge for team guidance of electrical calculations including SKM analysis, arc flash, and photometric calculations (AGI or Elumtools preferred).
  • Support career development and technical skill advancement of team members.

Leadership & Project Management

At Woolpert you will use your technical skills to:

  • Motivate and inspire team members.
  • Communicate complex technical information to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Foster a collaborative team culture with a focus on innovation and excellence, where team members are encouraged to push boundaries and think creatively.
  • Manage project and staffing plans, adjusting them as necessary to meet changing project needs.
  • Oversee engineering project phases from initiation to completion, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and meet quality standards.
  • Serve as a technical expert and discipline representative at various meetings and events as required.
  • Deliver presentations at conferences, networking events, and professional organizations to highlight the distinctive and innovative services Woolpert offers to clients.
  • Conduct training sessions for internal employees when necessary.

Personal & Professional Growth

At Woolpert we place a high value on personal and professional growth, offering various opportunities for development within the engineering team:

  • Team members have access to continuous learning programs, including workshops, seminars, certifications, and participation in professional membership organizations. This allows our engineers to stay abreast of the latest industry trends and technologies, broaden their expertise, and network with industry peers.
  • Mentorship programs where senior engineers guide and support junior staff, providing invaluable insights and fostering a culture of knowledge sharing.
  • Career advancement through personalized career path planning and regular performance evaluations, ensuring that each team member's progress is recognized and rewarded.
  • Opportunities to take on new challenges, lead projects, and expand skill sets, further enhancing personal and professional capabilities.

What You Will Bring:

  • BA/BS or MA/MS in related field and fifteen (15) years related experience.
  • Registered Professional Engineer (PE) certification required.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience leading engineering projects.
  • Experience in building power systems, lighting design, medium-voltage distribution, SKM analysis, and photometric calculations (AGI or Elumtools preferred).
  • Experience with building electrical system design for commercial, mixed-use, aviation, hospitality, and/or high-rise preferred.
  • Experience designing sustainable building systems, including familiarity with LEED, Green Building Institute, or other sustainability credentialing.
  • Excellent presentation, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
  • Expert verbal and written communication abilities for both internal and external relationships.
  • Experience with discipline related software applications and calculation tools.
  • Substantial experience designing in Autodesk Revit 3-D modeling software and directing the preparation of construction documents.
  • Experience conducting and leading QAQC and coordination of design documents between disciplines.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex documents including scientific and technical journals, handbooks, and industry information.
  • Ability to provide effective responses to sensitive inquiries from clients, regulatory agencies, and/or members of the business community.
  • Able to write technical opinions, articles, and thought leadership social media using original or innovative techniques or style.
  • Willing to travel to project sites or offices, as needed.

Benefits You Will Love

Certified as a Great Place to Work, Woolpert is one of the fastest-growing architecture, engineering, and geospatial companies in the world. With over 75 offices and countless projects around the globe, you’ll work on meaningful assignments that improve quality of life around the world. In addition to offering competitive pay, we provide employees with a robust set of unique benefits, including:

  • Freedom to Work program: Set your own schedule and location (as appropriate).
  • Principal program: Earn the opportunity to become an owner of the firm.
  • Flexible paid time off/vacation: Take time off when it makes sense for you and your team.
  • Career development: Explore a wide range of learning and growth opportunities within and across industries.
  • Health, life, vision, and dental insurance: Cover all your medical bases.
  • Paid sick time, retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, pet insurance, identity protection, technology stipend, employee assistance program, and more!

SEO Content Marketer - Job Description

About the Role

We’re looking for a data-driven and creative SEO Content Marketer who can craft high-quality content while ensuring it ranks well on search engines. This role combines strategic content marketing with in-depth SEO expertise to drive organic traffic, conversions, and improve search visibility for our clients.

As an SEO Content Marketer, you’ll be responsible for creating, optimizing, and managing content that attracts, educates, and converts our audience.

We’re looking for an SEO Content Marketer who understands that ranking on page one is only half the battle, the real win is getting B2B SaaS buyers to take action.

More importantly, you know how to use AI tools to your advantage; to speed up research, spark ideas, and optimize content, but you don’t let them replace your creativity, strategic thinking, or human touch.

If you can turn complex SaaS topics into compelling, data-driven narratives that both Google and real people love, we want to talk to you. And if you cringe at the sight of a blog post starting with “In the dynamic world of…”, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Holistic SEO & Content Strategies

  • Develop a data-driven content strategy focused on high-intent B2B SaaS keywords.
  • Conduct keyword research, topic clustering, and competitor analysis to uncover ranking opportunities.
  • Own and manage the content calendar, ensuring a steady flow of optimized, insightful, and conversion-focused content.

SEO-Optimized Content Creation

  • Write and optimize blog posts, pillar pages, case studies, landing pages, and industry research reports, all with a focus on ranking and converting.
  • Balance technical accuracy with compelling storytelling. You know how to turn complex SaaS topics into digestible, high-value content.

  • Create content for blogs, social media platforms, email sequences, and ad copy.

On-Page SEO

  • Optimize internal linking to improve navigation and content discoverability.
  • Ensure content follows best practices for readability, mobile-friendliness, and structured data (schema markup).
  • Work with developers to identify SEO issues (site speed, indexing, crawlability).

Content Distribution & Link Building

  • Promote content through email, LinkedIn, and other channels.
  • Execute guest blogging and digital PR strategies to build authoritative backlinks.
  • Optimize for AIO, featured snippets, People Also Ask (PAA), and Google Discover.

Performance Tracking & Optimization

  • Monitor organic traffic, keyword rankings, and conversion metrics using Google Analytics, Search Console, HubSpot, and Semrush.
  • Continuously refresh and update old content to maintain rankings and relevance.
  • A/B test headlines, formats, and content structures to improve engagement.

Working in our team means embracing self-improvement. We don’t expect perfection, but attention to detail, endless curiosity, humility, and the desire to level up fast. We own our work by seeking responsibility and accountability for the ideas we create. We ask “Why?” a lot, and share our goals and experiences to challenge our thinking.   • Experience with CMS platforms like HubSpot, WordPress, and Webflow..
  • Ability to use AI writing tools strategically, but never let them dilute your originality.
  • Strong grasp of GA4 and Search Console for performance tracking.
  • A sharp eye for content trends in the B2B SaaS space (you know what resonates with b2b buyers).

Bonus Points (Nice-to-Have Skills)

  • Knowledge of YouTube SEO and video content optimization for SaaS brands.
  • Understanding of B2B SaaS sales funnels and marketing automation tools.

Unlike most agencies, we own the full spectrum. From marketing strategy and positioning to campaign management and website optimization. The CTC Engineering Division specializes in transforming cutting-edge technologies into real-world solutions. We harness the power of 3D printing, advanced joining techniques like friction stir welding, and cutting-edge design tools to tackle complex challenges for a diverse set of clients.

The Business and Financial Analyst provides professional business support and takes ownership of simple to moderately complex assignments. This position involves applying technical and operational proficiency to solve financial and business problems, contributing to the completion of projects and programs, and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders. The role requires independent judgment and the ability to lead small teams on lower-complexity project activities.

Key Responsibilities:

Proposal Development and Financial Support

  • Lead the preparation of cost proposals, ensuring compliance with solicitation requirements and company guidelines.

  • Conduct detailed profitability analyses for fixed-price and fixed-labor rate proposals, identifying risks and opportunities for improvement.

Budget Monitoring and Forecasting

  • Independently monitor project budgets using the company’s Forecast Tool (TM1), ensuring accuracy and adherence to financial guidelines.
  • Analyze budget forecasts to identify discrepancies and recommend corrective actions to maintain alignment with project goals.
  • Lead quarterly forecasting cycles for assigned programs and indirect budgets, ensuring timely completion and accuracy.

Financial Reporting

  • Prepare and review monthly financial reports, ensuring data accuracy and clarity for management decision-making.

Operational and Personnel Optimization

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as a liaison between technical teams, financial operations, and other departments to ensure alignment on project goals and financial objectives.

Our role will be to connect cutting-edge solutions from across industry and academia to the Navy's most pressing challenges, accelerating technology adoption and ensuring our nation's defense industrial base has the capacity and capability for decades to come.

This is a fast-paced, dynamic program where you will play a foundational role in its success. We are seeking talented professionals to join us in this exciting and impactful work.

jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The architect will lead both pre-contract technical solutioning and subsequent delivery, preserving continuity from proposal to production. Joining a small, senior practice means early client exposure, fast architectural decisions, hands-on implementation and direct influence over delivery standards and reusable assets. It also means varied, ambiguous work and occasionally creating the playbook; candidates seeking a tightly defined remit may not find the role suitable. Time is split approximately equally between client engagement and delivery, flexing with the pipeline. Typical work includes discovery workshops, target-state architecture, proposal estimates, code review, building a retrieval-augmented vertical slice, client enablement, steering-committee presentations and converting lessons into reusable patterns.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Solutioning and pre-sales

  • Shape technical approaches, challenge problem statements and facilitate discovery workshops.
  • Produce target-state architectures, build sequences, proposal assumptions, exclusions, risks and defensible estimates.
  • Design four-to-six-week proofs of concept and serve as technical peer to client architects, data leaders and CIOs.

Delivery and hands-on architecture

  • Own end-to-end architecture and, where required, lead delivery, scope, stand-ups and client technical
  • Remain hands-on, implementing demanding components and reference solutions.
  • Deliver Databricks lakehouses, including medallion layers, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, ingestion and orchestration.
  • Build production generative AI systems covering RAG, agents, evaluation, prompt/context engineering, cost and latency.
  • Set CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, testing, observability and cost standards; mentor client engineers and manage production readiness and handover.

Practice capability and intellectual property

  • Turn delivery experience into reference architectures, accelerators, templates and estimation models.
  • Contribute to Frontier Academy and maintain current recommendations across Databricks, Microsoft and Anthropic.
  • Help shape and eventually lead a small delivery team, including recruitment.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

Must Have:

  • About eight years in data/AI engineering and architecture, including three years with substantive design authority and senior client-facing consulting exposure.
  • Databricks: lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Spark/PySpark, Lakeflow or Delta Live Tables, orchestration, performance and cost optimisation.
  • Azure/Microsoft: Data Factory or Fabric, ADLS, Azure OpenAI or AI Foundry, Entra ID and networking
  • Generative AI: production RAG, vector stores, agents/tool use, evaluation, guardrails and prompt/context engineering, including Claude or an equivalent frontier model.
  • Strong production Python and SQL; sound data-modelling judgement across dimensional, data vault and wide denormalised approaches.
  • DevOps/MLOps fundamentals: version control, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containers and monitoring.
  • Excellent written and spoken English for executive proposals, decision records and presentations.

Desirable:

  • Databricks Professional or Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification.
  • Big Four, global systems integrator or specialist consultancy experience, including bids, statements of work and estimation.
  • Applied responsible AI governance and delivery experience in financial services, retail or travel.
  • Experience with Australian/APAC clients, Snowflake, dbt, Power BI or Fabric, and mentoring small engineering teams.

About Lokal :

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
  • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
  • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs)
  • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
  • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
    Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

We are looking for a Senior GRC Analyst with deep experience in GovRAMP, FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, and SOC 2 to join our growing security and compliance team. You'll take ownership of core elements of our GRC program—the documentation, vendor risk, and policy work that keeps Career EDGE audit-ready and trusted by the state agencies we serve. This is a senior, self-directed role for someone who knows what good looks like, raises the bar on what's already in place, and treats compliance documentation as a craft rather than a checkbox.

Why Join Us?

By joining this incredible company, you will be:

  • A senior individual contributor with real ownership over a defined portion of our GRC program.
  • Maturing the documentation backbone (SSPs, policies, POA&Ms, risk register, vendor program) that powers our GovRAMP, FedRAMP, and state authorization efforts.
  • Working on a product that directly helps thousands of individuals access workforce and educational services.
  • Partnering directly with security leadership, engineering, and executive stakeholders—no layers, no hand-holding.
  • Driving continuous improvement of policies, controls, and evidence collection across the organization.

Your Impact on Career TEAM's Success:

As a Senior GRC Analyst, your focus will be deeply hands-on and ownership-oriented:

Compliance Program Ownership
  • Maintain and continuously improve the System Security Plan (SSP), policies, procedures, and standards aligned to NIST 800-53 and SOC 2.
  • Own the Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) lifecycle: tracking, aging, remediation evidence, and monthly continuous monitoring deliverables.
  • Manage the control evidence catalog—what evidence exists, where it lives, when it was last refreshed, and what's coming up for renewal.
  • Coordinate with the U.S. security team and 3PAOs to support GovRAMP, FedRAMP, and state-level (TX-RAMP, ) authorization and continuous monitoring activities.
Risk, Vendor & Subcontractor Management
  • Run our third-party risk management program end-to-end: security questionnaires, due diligence, contract review, recurring reassessments.
  • Maintain the enterprise risk register, facilitate risk acceptance decisions, and translate technical risk into business language for executives.
  • Administer subcontractor flow-down obligations and PII safeguarding certifications across all relevant agreements.
  • Track contractual security obligations across state customer contracts and ensure we meet every commitment on schedule.
Policy, Training & Awareness
  • Maintain and version-control our policy library—written in plain English, not boilerplate.
  • Run our security awareness training program, phishing simulations, and Rules of Behavior administration.
  • Author tabletop exercise scenarios, facilitate exercises, and produce after-action reports with concrete remediation owners.
  • Partner with HR and IT on onboarding and offboarding security checklists, access reviews, and acceptable use enforcement.

What We're Looking For:

  • Located in the Philippines with night shift work hours (to overlap with U.S. team).

  • Demonstrated track record authoring SSPs, POA&Ms, and continuous monitoring deliverables for a successful authorization—not just contributing to someone else's work.
  • Deep working knowledge of NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, FIPS 199/200, SOC 2 (Type II), and the practical realities of audit evidence collection.
  • Self-starter who can walk into an existing program, identify what needs to mature, and deliver without daily direction. You'll know you're a fit if "figure it out and make it better" sounds like a feature, not a bug.
  • Exceptional written English—your documents will be read by state auditors, executives, and 3PAOs.
  • Experience running a third-party risk management program and managing vendor security reviews at volume.
  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related field; relevant certifications (CISSP, CISA, CRISC, CGRC/CAP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer) are a strong plus.
  • Bonus: experience with GRC tooling (Drata, Vanta, Hyperproof, ServiceNow GRC) and prior work with U.S. state government customers.

Our reputation is built on the expertise, dedication, and professionalism of our team, and we’re proud to foster a culture where talented people can do meaningful work and grow their careers.

Magna Legal Services is seeking a Director of Data Engineering to lead the continued development and maturation of our enterprise data platform. We have made meaningful investments in our Snowflake-based architecture and dbt modeling layer, and we are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can accelerate that momentum—raising the quality bar across our data models, expanding coverage into new business domains, and establishing the architecture, standards, and engineering practices that will support Magna’s continued growth.

As Director of Data Engineering, you will lead a team of data engineers while owning the technical roadmap for our cloud data stack across Snowflake, Azure, and dbt. You will partner closely with Analytics, Product, Operations, and other business stakeholders to translate business needs into reliable, scalable, and well-modeled data assets that teams can trust and build upon.

This is intentionally a hands-on leadership role. We are looking for a Director who can set platform strategy and develop engineers while remaining deeply connected to the technology. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable reviewing a dbt PR, designing a new data model, troubleshooting a pipeline, optimizing a Snowflake workload, leading an architecture discussion, and running a team planning session.

Primary Responsibilities

    Snowflake Platform

  • Serve as the internal technical authority on Snowflake architecture, performance tuning, cost governance, and security, including RBAC, data masking, and network policies.
  • Remain hands-on with Snowflake architecture and optimization, including investigating performance issues, reviewing query patterns, evaluating warehouse configuration, and identifying opportunities to improve cost and scalability.
  • Design and maintain a scalable, well-documented warehouse structure, including database, schema, and object hierarchy standards that engineers can consistently apply as new domains and workloads are introduced.
  • Drive thoughtful adoption of Snowflake capabilities such as Dynamic Tables, Snowpark, data sharing, Cortex, and emerging functionality.

    • dbt & Transformation Layer

  • Own the dbt project end-to-end and remain actively involved in its development and evolution.
  • Establish and enforce modeling conventions, testing strategies, documentation standards, and CI/CD practices.
  • Design and maintain a layered modeling architecture (staging → intermediate → marts) that downstream teams can confidently consume and self-serve.
  • Regularly review dbt pull requests and provide technical guidance around SQL, modeling decisions, incremental strategies, testing, performance, and maintainability.
  • Personally participate in the design of complex or business-critical data models when appropriate.
  • Partner with Analytics to establish trusted definitions and reusable models for key business metrics.

    • Azure Data Ecosystem

  • Lead the architecture, development, and operation of data pipelines on Azure, including Azure Data Factory.
  • Maintain sufficient hands-on involvement to troubleshoot pipeline failures, review pipeline designs, and guide engineers through complex ingestion and orchestration challenges.
  • Ensure reliable and observable data movement from source systems into Snowflake with clear SLAs, monitoring, alerting, retry strategies, and failure recovery.
  • Establish scalable patterns for integrating new source systems and acquired businesses into the enterprise data platform.

    • Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Own the technical roadmap for the Data Engineering function while remaining actively engaged in architecture and implementation.
  • Make and document key architectural decisions across Snowflake, dbt, Azure, data modeling, ingestion, orchestration, governance, and platform reliability.
  • Evaluate technical tradeoffs and make pragmatic decisions that balance scalability, reliability, engineering effort, cost, and business needs.
  • Proactively identify technical debt and platform investment opportunities and establish a roadmap for addressing them alongside the team.

    • Team Leadership

  • Manage, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers through regular 1:1s, performance management, technical coaching, and career development.
  • Own workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development for the Data Engineering function.
  • Build a culture where strong engineering fundamentals, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning are expected.
  • Use code reviews, architecture discussions, pairing, and hands-on technical coaching to raise the capabilities of the team.
  • Establish planning and prioritization processes that balance platform investment, technical debt, reliability, and business delivery.

    • Business Partnership

  • Partner closely with Analytics, Product, Operations, Technology, and other business stakeholders to understand their objectives and translate them into scalable data solutions and well-scoped, prioritized engineering work.
  • Participate early in business conversations to help stakeholders determine what data and capabilities are needed—not simply fulfill downstream requests.
  • Translate complex technical concepts, architecture decisions, risks, and tradeoffs for non-technical stakeholders and senior leaders.

    • Standards, Quality & Governance

  • Define and enforce organization-wide ETL/ELT best practices, naming conventions, documentation requirements, and code review standards.
  • Champion data quality, observability, lineage, and ownership across the platform.
  • Establish automated testing and quality gates, including dbt tests, freshness monitoring, reconciliation, and other appropriate controls.

Desired Background

    Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive data engineering in production environments.
  • Demonstrated success operating as a hands-on engineering leader/player-coach who remains technically involved while managing a team.
  • Deep, production-grade Snowflake expertise, including personally designing or significantly evolving warehouse architectures, diagnosing performance issues, optimizing queries and workloads, managing costs, and implementing enterprise security controls.
  • Extensive dbt experience, including building and maintaining projects at scale, designing data models, reviewing code, establishing testing and documentation standards, and implementing CI/CD.
  • Hands-on Azure Data Factory experience designing, building, operating, or troubleshooting production data pipelines.
  • Advanced SQL skills and strong proficiency with Python for pipeline development, automation, and data engineering.
  • Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, modern ELT architecture, data warehousing, data quality, lineage, observability, and governance.
  • Proven experience hiring, managing, mentoring, and developing data engineers, including 1:1s, performance management, goal setting, and career development.
  • Experience owning or significantly influencing the technical roadmap for a production data platform.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to move comfortably between detailed technical conversations with engineers and strategic discussions with non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into scalable technical solutions and prioritized engineering work.

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with data observability tooling such as Elementary, Monte Carlo, or similar.
  • Exposure to Snowflake Cortex, Snowpark ML, or other AI/ML capabilities within Snowflake.
  • Experience in a high-growth, acquisitive, or scale-up environment where data platforms and engineering standards were built or significantly matured.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Principal Data Lead to help lead the strategy, governance, and quality of data on one of our large-scale federal data platform programs. In this role, you'll own execution of the data strategy for a multi-year enterprise data platform, lead the data supply chain, and drive a multi-phase metadata maturity program that raises the bar for how data is documented, trusted, and reused across the platform. You'll govern how data is promoted from initial ingestion through validated, trusted status, set and maintain data quality standards, and serve as the connective tissue between the platform team and the many upstream source-system teams and business data owners who depend on it.

This is foundational work: the metadata and data quality practices you lead are what make it possible to safely expand governed self-service analytics and AI use cases. If you enjoy building durable data governance capability inside a live, high-stakes production environment — not just writing policy — we'd love to hear from you.

This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location:

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S., be able to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust clearance, and obtain a U.S. Federal Government client badge. Bixal does not sponsor employment visas or assume sponsorship of existing employment visas.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $160,000 – $200,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Own execution of the data strategy for a large-scale enterprise data platform, aligning day-to-day delivery with the organization’s broader data strategy and strategic goals.

  • Serve as the primary coordination point across multiple upstream source-system teams and business data owners, managing handoffs, ingestion readiness, and shared metadata standards across the ecosystem.

  • Lead the data supply chain — source onboarding, ingestion, and transformation — and drive a multi-phase metadata maturity program, treating metadata as an operational capability rather than a one-time cataloging effort.

  • Govern the promotion of data through a tiered catalog architecture (e.g., raw, source, and trusted layers), defining clear admission criteria and applying the model consistently across teams.

  • Set and maintain data quality standards across the platform, including completeness, conformance, freshness against SLAs, and defect/rework tracking.

  • Partner with engineering, product, and AI/platform teams to ensure metadata and data quality are sufficient to support expanding self-service analytics and AI use cases.

  • Establish and track measures of data quality, metadata coverage, and promotion/certification cycle time, and use them to prioritize remediation work.

  • Communicate data strategy progress, risks, and dependencies to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership.

  • Participate in Agile/SAFe delivery cadences, including planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified and trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, plus at least 10 years of related experience.

  • Strong track record coordinating across multiple stakeholder teams and data owners in complex, multi-system environments.

  • Demonstrated experience owning or leading a data strategy for a large, multi-source enterprise data platform.

  • Experience designing and operating metadata governance or maturity programs, including cataloging, ownership models, and promotion/certification criteria.

  • Experience with modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, or similar) and metadata/catalog tooling (e.g., Unity Catalog, Collibra, Alation, AWS Glue Data Catalog, Microsoft Purview).

  • Experience defining and enforcing data quality standards, including completeness, conformance, freshness, and defect tracking.

  • Working knowledge of distributed data processing concepts and common data programming or query languages (e.g., SQL, Python, Scala), sufficient to engage credibly with engineering teams on pipeline design and performance.

  • Experience defining and enforcing data quality standards, including completeness, conformance, freshness, and defect tracking.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical data concepts for non-technical audiences, including client leadership.

  • Professional certification in a cloud or data platform (e.g., AWS, Databricks), data governance (e.g., DAMA CDMP), or Agile delivery (e.g., SAFe).

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust security clearance.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in highly regulated federal data domains (e.g., healthcare, benefits, or financial data).

  • Familiarity with responsible AI governance and how metadata and data quality maturity gate the expansion of AI use cases.

  • Hands-on experience building, tuning, or troubleshooting data pipelines on a cloud lakehouse platform (e.g., Databricks or comparable).

jobs.title: You're Probably Not Looking. But Here You Are.

jobs.description:
We're not hiring right now. But we're always looking for great people.

And you didn't land here by accident. Maybe you've been watching us. Maybe someone on our team wouldn't stop talking about this place. Maybe your spidey-sense is telling you that your current situation has a shelf life.

Whatever brought you here, we want to hear from you.

At Third Octet, we're a small, sharp team of people who take IT seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We work with some incredible companies across Canada, solving real technology problems that actually matter to their business. And we do it as a tight crew where every single person has fingerprints on the outcome.

There's no hiding here. No "that's not my lane." No waiting for someone above you to make a decision you could've made better yourself.

This Isn't a Role. It's a Roster Spot.

We don't know exactly what we'll need next...technical, sales, operations, or something we haven't thought of yet. But we do know the type of person we want in our corner when the time comes.

You might be a fit if:

  • You do things without being asked, and you find it strange that this needs to be said
  • You're the person who figures it out, not the one who waits for instructions
  • You genuinely care whether the customer succeeds...not because it's in your job description, but because leaving someone stuck bothers you
  • You've always got a question, a better way, or a half-baked idea that usually turns out to be a great one
  • You thrive in ambiguity and treat a blank page like an opportunity, not a threat
  • You want to grow fast and you're not afraid to be uncomfortable while doing it

This probably isn't for you if:

  • You need a detailed playbook before you can move
  • "Not my problem" is a phrase in your vocabulary
  • You coast...even a little
  • You're looking for a place to settle in and go quiet

What You're Walking Into

Remote-first. Real flexibility. A 4.5-day work week...yes, you read that right. Benefits that are tailored to you, not a checkbox. A team that will challenge you, back you, and make you better.

But more than perks: you'll have a voice. We run Direction Checks...real, honest conversations where the team shapes where we're headed. Your opinion won't disappear into a suggestion box. It'll show up in how we operate.

And you'll grow here. Fast. Because when the team is small and the work is real, there's nowhere to hide, and nowhere to plateau.

Sound Like You?

We'd love to get to know you before we need you. Submit your resume and tell us a little about who you are. No cover letter templates. No corporate speak. Just be a human.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary with personally tailored benefits (health, vision, dental, paramedical).
  • Flexibility in how, when, and where you work across a 4.5-day workweek with a vacation policy that is well above standards.
  • Focus windows to permit deep and uninterrupted work.
  • Broad exposure to technology solutions through client engagements and lab environments
  • Funded lifelong learning through an immersive education platform, vendor training, and soft skills development.
  • Career development paths and planning.
  • Wellness support, including access to an employee wellness platform and wellness allowance.
  • Open voice to shape the company's direction with leadership who serves your best interests.
  • Work. Life. Balance.

At Third Octet, we aim to empower businesses with innovative IT solutions while fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and growth. We believe in creating a supportive environment where every team member has the opportunity to contribute, thrive, and make a meaningful impact.

Please Note: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we can only contact candidates being considered for a position. We appreciate your understanding and interest in working with us. If you are selected for further consideration, one of our recruiters will be in touch.

At Third Octet, we use artificial intelligence (AI) to support - not replace - our people in the hiring process. AI tools help streamline certain steps, like organizing applications or surfacing relevant insights, but every decision is made by real humans. Our goal is to use AI to amplify our team’s ability to thoughtfully and fairly evaluate every candidate.

Thank you for considering a career at our company. We look forward to reviewing your application!
