Understanding the virtualization space, developer ecosystem, Apple ecosystem, enterprise productivity landscape, and partner routes-to-market will be a strong advantage.

Why This Role Matters

Search is not going away. It remains one of the most important ways customers discover, compare, and choose technology products.

But search is changing.

Customers are increasingly moving from keyword searches to AI-assisted recommendations, conversational answers, and generated product comparisons. That makes SEO more important, not less - because strong technical foundations, authoritative content, structured knowledge, and trusted third-party signals are also what help AI systems understand and recommend a brand.

This role exists to help Parallels win across both dimensions: the proven SEO channels that drive growth today and the emerging GEO channels that will shape customer discovery tomorrow.

What You Will Do

Lead the Integrated SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Own Parallels global organic discovery strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Set the roadmap for SEO and GEO initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes, including qualified traffic, conversion, pipeline influence, brand authority, and AI search visibility.
  • Balance near-term SEO performance with long-term GEO leadership as discovery behavior evolves.
  • Establish Parallels operating model for how SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Content, Engineering, PR, Channel, and Analytics work together.
  • Lead prioritization, planning, reporting, and executive communication for SEO and GEO initiatives.

Build Parallels GEO Leadership

  • Define and operationalize Parallels Generative Engine Optimization strategy.
  • Improve how Parallels products are surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended in AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Monitor Parallels presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and emerging AI assistants.
  • Build strategies around entity authority, semantic relevance, structured knowledge, citation visibility, AI retrievability, and recommendation share-of-voice.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Communications to increase high-quality third-party mentions, citations, and category authority.
  • Develop practical measurement frameworks for GEO where attribution is still evolving.
  • Identify how AI-driven discovery is changing customer journeys, competitive positioning, and purchase consideration.

Strengthen SEO as a Core Growth Engine

  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, structured data, and international SEO.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure SEO requirements are embedded into product launches, site changes, and platform decisions.
  • Drive content SEO strategy across priority audiences including prosumers, developers, power users, gamers, small and mid-size businesses, enterprise buyers, and channel partners.
  • Improve organic acquisition through better intent mapping, content quality, conversion pathways, and authority building.
  • Ensure Parallels continues to perform strongly in traditional search while preparing for the future of AI-mediated discovery.
  • Diagnose and resolve SEO performance issues across large-scale web properties.

Drive Content, Authority & Discoverability

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities, launches, roadmap themes, and use cases into discoverable narratives.
  • Build topic authority across virtualization, Windows on Mac, Apple enterprise adoption, developer workflows, gaming, productivity, managed devices, and cross-platform work.
  • Create content and information architecture that serves both human buyers and AI retrieval systems.
  • Support digital PR and partner/channel content strategies that increase trusted references to Parallels across the web.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate research, content optimization, competitive analysis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Help simplify complex technical messages into clear, compelling stories for customers, partners, and search/discovery platforms.

Lead Measurement, Experimentation & Executive Communication

  • Define clear KPIs for both SEO and GEO, including traffic, rankings, conversions, technical health, content performance, brand visibility, AI citations, and recommendation presence.
  • Build test-and-learn frameworks for GEO experiments.
  • Translate complex changes in search and AI discovery into clear business implications for executives.
  • Use data to prioritize investments and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Manage SEO/GEO tools, vendors, agencies, and reporting systems as needed.

What You Bring

Required

  • 6+ years leading SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or discoverability programs.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise with a proven record of improving organic growth at scale.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy, authority building, information architecture, and search intent.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience with AI-driven discovery, GEO, LLM-powered search, or emerging search experiences.
  • Ability to define a new discipline while continuing to operate and improve a mature SEO function.
  • Experience influencing Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Content, Analytics, Communications, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reporting frameworks where measurement is imperfect.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Looker/Tableau, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Botify, Conductor, BrightEdge, Similarweb, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives across teams and time zones.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in SaaS, developer tools, virtualization, enterprise productivity, managed devices, or infrastructure technology.
  • Understanding of Apple, Windows, Mac, developer, SMB, enterprise, and partner/channel ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with semantic search, entity optimization, structured data, knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, and AI citation behavior.
  • Experience working with GEO tools that monitor AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, and recommendation share-of-voice across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
  • Experience using modern AI tools for research, content analysis, workflow automation, and experimentation.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, or distributed teams.
  • Comfort working in a global, remote-first environment with asynchronous collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, this leader will:

  • Maintain and improve SEO performance as a major organic acquisition channel.
  • Establish a clear GEO strategy, measurement model, and operating rhythm.
  • Improve Parallels visibility and recommendation presence across AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Strengthen technical SEO foundations and content authority across priority product and audience segments.
  • Build durable collaboration between SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Engineering, Content, Communications, Channel, and Analytics.
  • Create a repeatable experimentation framework for AI-driven discovery.
  • Position Parallels to win as traditional search and AI-driven discovery continue to converge.

About Parallels

Parallels is a global leader in cross-platform solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to access and use the applications, files, and workflows they need on any device or operating system.

Parallels helps customers get the best out of the technology they choose - whether that is Windows, Linux, macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, or the cloud. Our products serve individuals, developers, power users, small and mid-size businesses, enterprises, public sector organizations, and educators who need simple, reliable, and cost-effective ways to work across platforms.

Parallels is best known for making complex technology feel simple. We solve deep engineering and user-experience challenges so customers can run the applications they need, where and how they need them - from Windows on Mac to managed enterprise environments and flexible hybrid work setups.

We have millions of users globally and decades of innovation behind us. Today, Parallels is focused on helping customers stay productive in a world where work happens across devices, operating systems, clouds, and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We offer a fully remote workspace and flexible hours because we believe great work can happen anywhere. Our team is global, collaborative, and built around motivated people who care about solving meaningful customer problems.

Exemple de missions

  • Création d’une plateforme servicielle pour la régie publicitaire d’un groupe media : définition de la vision stratégique, cadrage et pilotage d’un appel d’offres (RFP).

Votre rôle au sein du cabinet

Au-delà des missions, vous jouerez un rôle actif dans le développement du cabinet :​

  • Contribution à la rédaction de réponses à appel d’offres sous la supervision d’un manager.

Julhiet Sterwen s’engage : tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

  • Vous serez diplômé(e) d’une grande école de management et/ou d’ingénieur (Bac+5) et recherchez un stage de fin d’études.
  • Vous disposez d’une solide culture générale et technologique (IA, data, RPA…) et êtes sensibilisé(e) aux enjeux de transformation digitale.

  • Vous travaillez couramment en anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Julhiet Sterwen s’engage : tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Nous croyons au bien-être et à l’épanouissement de nos collaborateurs au travail. Nous proposons donc à chacun :

  • Une politique de télétravail raisonnée
  • Des jours de RTT en plus des cinq semaines de congés payés
  • Une prime de vacances
  • Des avantages du CSE Julhiet Sterwen
  • Un onboarding et un parcours de formation sur mesure
  • Une politique de parentalité
  • Une salle détente avec table de pingpong

Julhiet Sterwen, conseil en transformation, a été créé sur une conviction forte : pour générer des résultats durables, les stratégies et les transformations nécessitent d’aborder simultanément les dimensions business, people et environnement. Ce positionnement original et unique, parfaitement aligné sur les besoins du marché, a permis à Julhiet Sterwen de devenir un des leaders du conseil.

Fort d’un collectif de 750 consultants, le cabinet accompagne plus de 2500 clients de tous secteurs et de toutes tailles dans leur adaptation aux mutations économiques, numériques, écologiques, sociales et sociétales.

Entreprise à Mission, et porté par son engagement Consulting for Good, Julhiet Sterwen a pour ambition de générer un impact positif et durable dans toutes ses actions et toutes ses réflexions.

Notre cabinet se distingue par un modèle organisationnel transversal, favorisant une synergie des savoir-faire dans un cadre de collaboration ouverte. Nous encourageons l'initiative collective et l'autonomie à travers des projets innovants impulsés par nos consultants.

Job Title

Contractor Interior Design Content Developer

Job Description

About Us

Kaplan is one of the world’s largest and most diverse education providers. With 80+ years of history, Kaplan has been a beacon for expanding educational access and a leader in instructional innovation.

Role

We are looking for a remote Subject Matter Expert who will assist Kaplan's engineering team in developing material to prepare students for the NCIDQ Interior Design Certification examination. This is a remote opportunity with flexible hours (up to 20 per week).

Responsibilities

The responsibilities of the Contractor may include:

  • Writing quiz questions & practice exam questions in the style of NCIDQ examinations.

  • Writing study materials for any of the three separate NCIDQ exam sections: Fundamentals Exam (IDFX), the Professional Exam (IDPX), and the Practicum Exam (PRAC).

  • Quality assurance reviews, technical reviews, and erratum correction.

  • Contributing to suggested study plans, and providing feedback on customer expectations for study and preparation.

Skill Requirements

The candidate must:

  • Have excellent command of the English language - both verbal and written.

About Us

Simprints is a nonprofit tech company with a mission to radically increase transparency and effectiveness in global development. We build ethical, inclusive digital ID powered by biometrics to verify that health, aid, and services truly reach people. Simprints partners with organizations like Gavi to boost immunization rates in developing countries, Ministries of Health like Ghana on pandemic response, and NGOs like BRAC to deliver maternal healthcare. Studies have shown Simprints increases impact through real-time, precision data, for example increasing maternal health visits by 38% in Bangladesh or accurate HIV tracing by 62% in Malawi. Today we’ve worked in over 17 countries helping deliver health, aid, and finance to >3M people. Our goal is to transform the way the world fights poverty, ensuring that every vaccine, every dollar, and every public good reaches the people who need them most.

Department Overview

Primary Function: The Product and Engineering department at Simprints is focused on developing innovative biometric solutions to help solve the problems of our users. We take a product-centric approach, ensuring our technology drives social impact through close collaboration and user-focused design.

Key Goals:

  • Enhance Biometric Solutions: Continuously improve our biometric products to ensure they are adaptable, reliable, and meet the diverse needs of our users.
  • Drive Cross-Company Product Development: Promote collaboration across the entire company to accelerate the delivery of impactful, user-focused features.
  • Ensure User Success: Go above and beyond to ensure our users benefit from our technology by providing ongoing support, troubleshooting, and guidance, while actively participating in decision-making and project implementation.

Join Our Product & Engineering Talent Pool at Simprints

Are you passionate about building technology that drives real-world impact? At Simprints, we’re always looking for talented product and engineering professionals to join our mission of transforming global development through cutting-edge technology. Whether you specialise in software engineering, product management, UX/UI design, or data science, we want to hear from you!

What We Do in Product & Engineering

Our team is responsible for designing and building scalable, user-centered solutions that work reliably in some of the world's most challenging environments. We work on projects that integrate biometrics, mobile applications, and cloud services to help NGOs, governments, and social enterprises deliver aid more efficiently and equitably.

Who We’re Looking For

We know that these are uncertain times for many professionals in the international development space, and we truly appreciate your interest in joining Simprints.

While we may not have an immediate role that aligns with your experience, we are always looking to connect with talented individuals who are passionate about using technology for social impact. By submitting your CV, you allow us to keep your details on file, and should a relevant opportunity arise, we will reach out to explore a potential fit. Thank you for considering Simprints, we appreciate the important work you do, and we hope to stay in touch.

We welcome professionals at all levels with experience in:
✔ Software Engineering (Front-end, Back-end, Full-stack, DevOps, Mobile)
✔ Product Management (Technical or Non-Technical)
✔ UX/UI & Human-Centered Design

✔ Data Science & AI/ML for Social Impact

Experience in international development, social impact tech, or working with NGOs is a huge plus! If you're excited about using technology to solve global challenges, submit your CV today—we’d love to explore how you can be part of the Simprints journey. 🚀

Requirements

What You Could Work On

  • Scalable Tech Solutions: Design and implement robust, scalable systems that support projects across multiple countries.
  • Collaboration & Development: Work alongside engineers, data scientists, and product managers to develop reliable, maintainable, and high-performing software.
  • User-Centered Innovation: Translate complex user needs from the field into intuitive, impactful product solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Projects: Collaborate with field teams, partners, and researchers to ensure our technology aligns with real-world challenges.
  • Reliability in Tough Environments: Build and optimise systems that function effectively in areas with unreliable internet and limited infrastructure.

Benefits

5 Reasons to Join Simprints

Life is short. We believe work should be inspirational, meaningful and fun. At Simprints, we’re taking on global development’s biggest challenges, powered by an amazing culture and incredible people. Work with us, and you will grow faster, learn more, and take on great responsibilities with the potential to make lasting change.

1. Genuine Impact. Work directly with our partners and users to deliver technology that has the potential to impact millions of lives across the globe. At Simprints, you’ll be part of a team that is passionate about driving real change.

2. An incredible, diverse team. Our work is at the intersection of technology and global development, and we’ve managed to build an amazing team drawn from all over the world. But don’t take our word for it—we’re an externally recognized Great Place to Work, part of the Flexa Top 100 Most Flexible Companies and a 2022 Best Workplace for Women.

3. Mutual Flex. We champion a work culture where autonomy and trust are paramount, steering clear of mere face-time metrics. Whether it's managing life's essentials like healthcare appointments or adapting work hours to match your peak productivity times, we've got you covered. In return, we count on your reciprocal flexibility when mission-critical moments arise, like stepping up for a crucial client discussion on a Friday or tackling unexpected technical glitches beyond regular hours.

4. Ultimate work-life balance.

    1. We offer a 4-day workweek, meaning everybody has the option to have Fridays off.
    2. We also offer unlimited annual leave, which allows you to prioritize your well-being

As long as you're driving results and fostering teamwork, we encourage you to strike that perfect balance between your professional and personal life. Our commitment to this model's success is solidified through semi-annual productivity assessments with our board, ensuring that our high standards of performance are consistently met.

5. Professional development. We promote continual learning and put our money where our mouth is with development plans and access to global experts through the GLG network

We also have a generous professional development budget for each colleague – “Eduprints”. Is there some training you’d like, or maybe you could benefit from professional coaching? Simply provide a business case that shares your aspirations and the resources you need, and we'll do our best to support you.

We care about both your development in Simprints and your holistic long-term career goals. Simprints Alumni have gone on to work for Google, USAID, Gavi the vaccine alliance, Save the Children, and other top players.

jobs.title: VP Product - Sidetrade Pay
jobs.excerpt: Are you a product leader who has turned payments into a revenue engine inside B2B software?
jobs.description:
Are you a product leader who has turned payments into a revenue engine inside B2B software? Sidetrade is looking for a VP Product, to build and lead the development of our global payments business.

Reporting to the CPO, this is a newly created product leadership role at the centre of one of Sidetrade's biggest strategic bets. Hundreds of billions of dollars of B2B invoice value flow through Sidetrade platforms every year, and only a very small percentage is monetised through payment acceptance today. Your mandate is to change that: to take Sidetrade Pay from programme to product, and from product to a thriving payments business spanning our enterprise base on the Sidetrade platform and our SMB and mid-market base under the ezyCollect brand, across North America, the UK, Europe, and Australia and New Zealand.

About Sidetrade:

Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us.

Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion: Aimie Video

Requirements

What you will do:

  • Own Sidetrade Pay end to end: Define the vision, strategy, roadmap, and commercial model for embedded payments across both business lines globally, and be accountable for payments revenue as a distinct line of business.
  • Payment monetisation: Design the pricing and packaging architecture across card acquiring, direct debits, and account-to-account rails, balancing merchant value, buyer experience, and Sidetrade margin, and evolving it as adoption scales.
  • Payment partner leadership: Own the relationship with our payment service provider partner(s): commercial terms, joint roadmap, performance against SLAs, and the decision framework for a future multi-provider architecture.
  • Adoption and activation: Build the engine that converts our installed base into paying merchants: ICP segmentation, activation playbooks with Sales and Customer Success, buyer-facing checkout experiences, and the levers that shift payment mix toward monetisable rails.
  • Embedded product experience: Ensure payments are woven natively into Sidetrade's Order-to-Cash workflows and ezyCollect's collection journeys, embedded, not bolted on.
  • Embedded finance roadmap: Sequence the expansion beyond acceptance into virtual cards, working capital, business accounts, and emerging agent-initiated payments, in step with partner capabilities and market readiness.
  • Risk, compliance, and trust: Partner with Legal, Security, and Finance on scheme rules, regulatory change across our four regions, chargeback and insolvency exposure, and the controls that let the business scale safely.
  • Team building: Hire and develop the payments product team, product managers, payments operations, and commercial analysts, and set the standard for product craft.
  • Executive alignment: Report progress and economics to the payments steering group and executive committee, with clear metrics on penetration, payment mix, take rate, and net revenue.
  • Market intelligence: Track the embedded payments and B2B payments landscape, PSPs, orchestrators, schemes, and regulation, and feed it into strategy and differentiation.

What you will bring:

  • Payments monetisation, proven: You have built or scaled an embedded payments business inside a B2B SaaS company and can speak first-hand to take rates, attach rates, payment mix, and the P&L mechanics of payfac, reseller, and referral models.
  • B2B payments depth: Fluency in card acquiring economics (interchange++, scheme fees, Level 2/3 data) and, critically, bank rails: ACH, SEPA, BACS, and real-time payments, because B2B invoices are won on more than cards.
  • PSP partnership experience: You have negotiated with and managed acquirers or payment service providers, and know how to hold them to commercial and roadmap commitments.
  • Commercial ownership: Experience carrying a revenue number or P&L for a payments or fintech product line, with the analytical habits to model penetration, mix, and margin credibly.
  • Enterprise and SMB range: You have shipped payment experiences for large enterprise merchants and high-volume SMB bases, and understand how the two motions differ.
  • Multi-region awareness: Working knowledge of the regulatory landscape across North America, the UK, the EEA, and ideally Australia (PSD2/SCA, surcharging rules, money transmission, safeguarding).
  • Cross-functional leadership: Proven ability to align Engineering, Design, Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Finance behind a payments vision, without owning them all.
  • Strong communication and influence: Exceptional storytelling for executive stakeholders, partners, and customers, with comfort presenting at board and C-suite level.
  • Team builder: Experience hiring and developing product managers, with a coaching mindset and high standards.
  • O2C or AR domain knowledge: Familiarity with Order-to-Cash, accounts receivable, or collections workflows is highly advantageous.

Benefits

  • Full remote – work from home.
  • Health & wellness – medical coverage, life insurance, 401k matching and other wellness programs.
  • Time off – competitive paid holidays plus public holidays.
  • Career growth & compensation – competitive salary, equal opportunities, learning & mentorship programs, and advancement support.

Because when you thrive, we all succeed!

We’re committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive experience for every candidate.

If you need any accommodation during the hiring process, just let us know.

Agencies

Only applications from invited agencies through the Workable portal will be accepted. Unsolicited CVs sent directly to managers or HR will not incur any fees.

jobs.description:
The Credentialing Specialist is responsible for managing the credentialing and re-credentialing processes for healthcare providers to ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory standards. This role involves the verification of provider credentials, licenses, and professional qualifications, as well as maintaining accurate records and databases. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized, and skilled in managing documentation and deadlines.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Credentialing & Re-credentialing:
    • Conduct thorough credentialing and re-credentialing processes for new and existing providers, verifying qualifications, licenses, certifications, education, work history, and other relevant credentials.
    • Ensure compliance with regulatory, accrediting, and internal requirements for credentialing documentation.
    • Track and manage all credential expirations and renewals to maintain up-to-date provider files.
  • Verification & Compliance:
    • Verify credentials through primary source verification, including contacting educational institutions, licensing boards, and previous employers.
    • Ensure credentialing activities adhere to standards set by accrediting bodies (e.g., NCQA, URAC, Joint Commission) and state/federal regulations.
    • Identify and resolve any discrepancies or potential compliance risks during the credentialing process.
  • Database & Record Maintenance:
    • Maintain accurate provider information in credentialing databases and systems, ensuring records are current and organized.
    • Track credentialing status, license expirations, and renewals, and document updates in the database.
    • Regularly audit credentialing files to ensure compliance with policies and maintain a high standard of record accuracy.
  • Communication & Coordination:
    • Act as the main point of contact for providers during the credentialing process, answering questions, providing guidance, and offering status updates.
    • Collaborate with internal teams, such as recruitment, HR, and medical staff services, to support a smooth onboarding and credentialing process.
    • Communicate effectively with external organizations, including licensing boards, educational institutions, and accreditation agencies, for timely verifications.
  • Reporting & Documentation:
    • Prepare and maintain reports on credentialing metrics, such as application status, processing times, and compliance rates.
    • Document all credentialing activities, communications, and decisions in line with regulatory requirements and company standards.
    • Assist in updating credentialing policies and procedures to improve processes and ensure compliance.

Qualifications:

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 2+ years of experience in credentialing, medical staff services, or a related role in a healthcare setting.
  • Knowledge of credentialing standards (NCQA, URAC, Joint Commission) and federal and state regulations.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams and external contacts.

Preferred Skills:

  • Certification as a Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist (CPCS) or Certified Professional in Medical Services Management (CPMSM) is a plus.
  • Experience in the Dental Industry
  • Familiarity with credentialing software or systems (e.g., CAQH, Echo, Healthstream, or symplr).
  • Background in healthcare administration or medical office experience.
Salary - $65,000-$75,000
This is a remote position.

Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Today, Abridge captures the clinical conversation across 300+ health systems and helps clinicians document in real time. Clinical Decision Support (CDS) is the next step: a chat-based assistant clinicians can turn to before, during, and after the visit — to prepare for their day, get evidence-based answers during the visit, and wrap up tasks afterward. It draws on the patient's chart, the medical literature, and the conversation itself, surfacing guidance without interrupting care.

We're hiring a Product Lead to own CDS end to end: strategy, the in-workflow experience, and the content and partnership strategy behind what we surface and when. You'll take CDS from early access to broad adoption across web, mobile, and EHR-embedded surfaces, while driving new capabilities and expansion opportunities. Doing this in a way that earns clinician trust means guidance that's genuinely useful and safe, without adding alert fatigue. You'll work across clinical science, ML, engineering, design, and commercial teams.

What You'll Do

  • Own CDS strategy and roadmap. Define the vision, sequencing, and success metrics for CDS — from answering clinicians' questions on demand to proactively surfacing the right evidence. Decide what we build, license, or partner for.

  • Own the content and evidence strategy. Partner with Clinical Science on evidence quality and clinical validity, and decide what we surface — across guidelines, journals, and reference sources — and what we won't ship until the quality bar is met.

  • Go deep with clinicians. Conduct hands-on user research: shadowing clinicians in exam rooms, observing them interact with our products, understanding the friction they face across specialties and care settings. Turn those insights into product conviction.

  • Ship high-quality in-workflow experiences. Partner with engineering, design, and ML to surface guidance that's timely, trustworthy, and easy to act on. Sweat the details of when and how it appears.

  • Integrate deeply with EHR environments. Work across Epic and other EHR surfaces so CDS fits seamlessly into existing clinical routines, using chart context (labs, meds, prior notes) to make guidance relevant. Understand the constraints and opportunities of embedded vs. standalone experiences.

  • Define metrics and drive outcomes. Establish clear KPIs across adoption, engagement, and clinical quality and safety, and use data to evaluate what's working. Build a culture of measurement and iteration on your team.

  • Navigate ambiguity and move fast. Create structure and clarity in areas where the right answer isn't obvious. Form hypotheses, test them quickly, and update your approach when the data says you're wrong.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of product management, with significant ownership of complex, high-stakes, or AI products. This is a senior IC role.

  • Track record of shipping 0 to 1 products and taking them to real adoption and revenue.

  • Strong product taste and user empathy. You build for real user workflows — you know the difference between an answer that's technically correct and one a clinician actually trusts and acts on.

  • Comfort working with clinical, scientific, or evidence-based content, and a high bar for accuracy in domains where being wrong has real consequences.

  • Strong technical fluency. You can hold your own with engineering and ML on tradeoffs like quality, latency, reliability, and what's feasible.

  • Ability to make build vs. buy vs. partner decisions and defend them.

  • Clear communication. You explain complex tradeoffs simply and get clinical, engineering, and business partners aligned on a decision.

Bonus Points If…

  • You have clinical, healthcare, or medical informatics experience, or have shipped EHR-integrated clinical workflow products.

  • You've built agentic or assistant-style products — systems that reason, retrieve, and act across tools.

  • You've worked with medical content, knowledge bases, or evidence retrieval and grounding systems (e.g., RAG).

  • You've worked in regulated environments with a high compliance bar.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

You bring strong analytical rigor, produce consistently high-quality outputs, and influence outcomes across teams without formal authority.

jobs.excerpt: About ImmunefiABOUT IMMUNEFIImmunefi is the world’s leading crowdsourced security platform for the digital economy.
jobs.description:
About Immunefi

ABOUT IMMUNEFI

Immunefi is the world’s leading crowdsourced security platform for the digital economy. We protect over $180 billion in onchain assets by connecting the most skilled ethical hackers on the planet with the protocols that need them. Our products — Bug Bounty Programs, Managed Triage, and Audit Competitions — are the de facto security infrastructure for serious blockchain protocols worldwide.

We are the dominant player in Web3 security, and we’re now extending into the broader enterprise market — financial services, fintech, and large regulated businesses — where the security problems are as acute and our capabilities directly applicable. This hire owns our commercial engine and helps open that next chapter.

The Opportunity

This is a rare role for someone who has scaled a marketing function from zero to one at a startup, who understands how to build trust and demand with deeply technical, skeptical audiences, and who is ready to step into a leadership position where they can build something of their own.

You'll architect the "Immunefi Engine": the AI-leveraged systems, category narrative, and product GTM that turn Immunefi's credibility into compounding demand. You'll report to the VP of Delivery, with a dotted line to the CEO on brand narrative and token strategy. You'll set the strategy, build the systems, and execute directly, using AI-powered workflows to compress what would take a large team into what one exceptional person can drive.

We're not looking for someone who will figure it out on the job. We're looking for someone who already knows how to scale marketing from 0 to 1 in a lean, high-ownership environment, who has genuine intuition for marketing to technical buyers, and who uses AI tools and agent networks as a natural extension of how they work.

What You Will Champion

Zero-to-One Marketing Ownership

You'll own the marketing function end-to-end, the way a founder would. That means being comfortable operating without a large budget or team from day one: you are the budget. You'll build the operations, systems, and strategy from the ground up rather than inheriting an existing playbook, and you'll do it with the resourcefulness of someone who has done it before and knows it can be done alone.

Marketing Systems & Infrastructure

Build the AI-powered operating layer that makes one person capable of running what would traditionally require a team. This means designing and deploying agent-based workflows, automation systems, and reporting infrastructure that compound output over time. You're not just a user of AI tools, you're the architect of the systems.

GTM and Product Marketing

Own go-to-market strategy across our core products: Bug Bounty Subscriptions, Managed Triage, and Audit Competitions, as the distinct buying motions they are, plus GTM for emerging products as we launch them. This includes defining ICPs, building messaging architecture, and translating complex technical security value into language that resonates with founders, protocol teams, and enterprise buyers to drive top-of-funnel demand, qualified pipeline, and MQLs for Sales.

Category Narrative & Brand

Own how Immunefi shows up in the market: a consistent identity and differentiated story as the trust layer of Web3 security. High-stakes public brand and voice changes are made in partnership with the CEO; you'll own the day-to-day execution and evolution of the brand within that.

Content, PR, Events & Social

Set the quality bar and build the systems that turn researcher expertise, security events, and product news into authoritative, organic-first content and thought leadership.

Researcher-Community Activation

Own the programs that turn our security-researcher community into a marketing asset: activation, crowdsourcing, and advocacy at the community level (elite researcher relationship management sits with our RM team).

Token Marketing & Ecosystem Activation (from ~3-6 months in)

Once the core engine is running, you'll take on positioning and ecosystem activation for our token narrative, working closely with the CEO. Deep token marketing experience isn't a prerequisite for this role, it's a skill we expect you to build quickly once the fundamentals above are in place, but comfort with Web3 community dynamics (Discord, Telegram, X) is a plus from day one.

Success Profile (Who You Are)

  • A Zero-to-One Builder: You have real experience scaling a marketing function from nothing, with no dedicated team or corporate-scale budget behind you. You've operated as the budget and the team, and you're energized by that constraint rather than limited by it.
  • Native Intuition for Technical Audiences: You've marketed to developers, engineers, or a technical/security buyer before or you have a comparable technical background yourself and you understand viscerally why proof, credibility, and organic reach outperform paid advertising with this audience.
  • A Hands-On Systems Architect: As a hands-on builder of AI-powered marketing systems, you actively design and deploy AI-powered, agent-based workflows and automation pipelines. You're the architect of the system, not just an operator of tools.
  • Strong Product Marketing Fundamentals: You've defined ICPs, built messaging architectures, and shipped GTM programs with outsized, leveraged results in fast-moving, technical industries.
  • High Agency, Thorough, and Async-Strong: You operate independently, chain your work to measurable business outcomes, and hold yourself accountable to them. We run async-first, and much of our evaluation process reflects that. Your written thinking and takeaway work matter as much as how you present live.
  • Resilient & Direct: You flourish in high-stakes environments. You believe in Radical Truth and clarity. You view feedback as a gift that protects the team's time and focus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Comfort with Web3 community platforms and token-based network effects (not required to start, but a plus)
  • Experience marketing to a technical, skeptical, or expert buyer where organic proof mattered more than paid promotion
  • Background in crypto audits, cybersecurity, blockchain infrastructure, or developer tools marketing or a technical/engineering background that transitioned into marketing
  • Established network in the Web3 ecosystem
  • Hands-on experience in content programs, PR execution, and event marketing

Operational Requirements

  • Fully remote; globally distributed team
  • Must maintain 4+ hours of daily overlap with US/EU business hours

Why Join Immunefi

  • Ownership: You'll own the roadmap and the results for a function you build from the ground up.
  • Purpose: We're on a mission to secure the next trillion dollars onchain. You're the person who makes the world believe it's possible.
  • Founding scope: You're not inheriting someone else's playbook. You're writing it, the systems, the narrative, the engine, with no limits on how creative you can be.
  • Lean, focused team: Elite team, high standards, zero bureaucracy. The kind of environment where your best work actually ships.

If you are a hands-on marketing leader who has built from zero, who knows how to earn trust with technical, skeptical audiences through proof rather than promotion, and who builds with AI as naturally as you think in campaigns - we want to hear from you.

Working at Immunefi

Immunefi is the foremost security platform in the crypto / Web3 space facilitating the protection of billions of user funds. We aim for excellence in all we do and want to build a world class team of highly skilled professionals who can help us to scale & develop our company. If you are successful in joining the team, you will be working in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment where ideas, input & communication are prized. By necessity, the work pace here is rapid and we need people who are able to immerse themselves quickly. As a fully remote and geographically dispersed team, we require everyone to be capable of autonomous & self-driven work in addition to being able to manage communication across global timezones.

Our Core Values

At Immunefi, we operate by three principles:

  • Secure the Outcome. Our mission is to secure the next trillion dollars onchain, and every decision we make serves that goal. The job is done when the outcome is secured, not when the task is checked off.
  • Act with High Agency. We are builders and problem solvers operating at the frontier of Web3 security. We take full ownership of challenges, find solutions, and drive outcomes forward. Blocked is not a final status.
  • Constant Vigilance. The stakes in Web3 are real and the cost of failure is high. We think like owners, never trade safety for speed, and protect the trust that the onchain ecosystem places in us.

What We Offer

  • 100% remote-first work environment, flexible schedule
  • Autonomous work environment with trusting, smart, reliable team members
  • An opportunity to be building an early-stage company in a dynamically evolving market and industry
  • An opportunity to build your own path in the company as we continue to evolve and grow
  • A global market (it’s fun to meet people from all over the world every day!)
  • A chance to make impact and participate in building and securing the ecosystem for smart contracts and the future of money (we’re protecting over $100B in user funds)

jobs.companyName: Global Fund for a New Economy
jobs.description:
Purpose of the role

The Legal and Compliance Operations Consultant supports the Chief Operating Officer on the legal and compliance needs of the organization. This is an execution-focused role: the person is assigned varied legal and compliance tasks connected to GFNE's work and carries each through to completion with precision and reliable follow-up. This role requires the ability to coordinate, organize, and execute across a global organization, and to work closely with external counsel where specialist input is required.

Scope of work

The central function of this role is to provide direct, ongoing support to the Chief Operating Officer across GFNE's legal and compliance needs. The work is varied and largely responsive: the Consultant takes on assigned tasks as they arise, prioritized by the COO, and carries each through to completion with careful, consistent follow-up.

These tasks fall across the areas below. The points under each are illustrative of the kind of work involved rather than an exhaustive list.

1. US and Swiss nonprofit compliance

  • Track and maintain GFNE's compliance obligations across entities, keeping a live view of filing dates, renewals, and regulatory deadlines.
  • Support adherence to US 501(c)(3) requirements, including the boundaries around political activity and lobbying, and coordinate the administration of related disclosures.
  • Coordinate statutory and regulatory filings across both jurisdictions, routing matters to counsel and finance where specialist input is needed.
  • Support the compliance and governance requirements of GFNE's entities.
  • Track compliance requirements early and coordinate the timely executions of various compliance needs.
  • Support GFNE's data protection and privacy obligations at a coordinating level, working with counsel on GDPR and equivalent requirements, with particular relevance for the European entity, and flag privacy considerations that surface in day-to-day operations.
  • Prepare and organize documentation for audits and regulatory information requests.

2. International grantmaking compliance

  • Support the compliance checks around GFNE's international grantmaking, coordinating grantee due diligence with counsel and finance, including sanctions and watchlist screening.
  • Help administer expenditure responsibility and equivalency determination processes where grants require them, maintaining the supporting records and tracking reporting deadlines.
  • Prepare and organize documentation for grant due diligence and funder information requests.

3. Board and governance support

  • Prepare board and committee materials, coordinate meeting logistics, and produce accurate minutes and resolutions.
  • Maintain the governance calendar, tracking meeting cadence, committee cycles, and statutory deadlines such as the Form 990 and Swiss or European equivalents.
  • Administer the conflict of interest and disclosure processes, including collecting, tracking, and safely maintaining declarations.
  • Act as custodian of GFNE's governing documents, keeping bylaws and board-approved policies current, version controlled, and properly filed.

4. Legal coordination and cross-functional support

  • Serve as the coordination point between GFNE and its external legal counsel in the US, Europe, and any other region where the organization operates.
  • Scope and brief legal questions clearly, gather the background counsel needs, and track matters through to resolution.
  • Help identify and engage counsel in new jurisdictions as GFNE's footprint grows.

Nature of the engagement

This is a consultancy of approximately 80 hours per month, structured as a blend of ongoing availability and defined monthly deliverables. Work is assigned and prioritized by the Chief Operating Officer. The role suits someone who is self-directed and highly organized, and who is comfortable moving across a varied set of tasks and shifting priorities within a remote, globally distributed team.

Required skills and experience

  • Around 7 or more years of relevant experience across a blend of nonprofit compliance, paralegal, and legal operations work.
  • A legal qualification is not required, but would be an added advantage.
  • Demonstrated experience in the nonprofit or philanthropy sector. (Essential.)
  • Comfort working within a remote, globally distributed team across multiple time zones. (Essential.)
  • Strong communication, coordination, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work smoothly across teams and regions. (Essential.)
  • A strong learning ethos and the acumen to navigate US and Swiss nonprofit and philanthropic environments. Direct familiarity with US 501(c)(3) and European nonprofit frameworks is an advantage, not a requirement.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a disciplined approach to follow-up and follow-through. This is an execution-heavy role, and dependability on the detail is central to it.
  • Self-directed and well organized, able to manage varied tasks with minimal oversight.
  • Comfort operating across cultures and time zones, and with the ambiguity that comes with a young, growing organization.
  • Sound judgment and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential legal and people matters.
  • Ability to translate complex legal and regulatory guidance into clear, practical language for colleagues without a legal background.

Equity and inclusion

GFNE is committed to building a diverse team and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and locations. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of nationality, background, age, beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, health, or disability. Applications from under-represented and marginalized groups are strongly encouraged.

Confidentiality

The role involves regular contact with sensitive organizational, legal, and personal information. The Consultant is expected to handle all such information with discretion and to maintain strict confidentiality throughout and after the engagement.

Job Description Summary:

Medical Coding Auditors are responsible for ensuring that coding performed on behalf of ModMed BOOST clients is in compliance with all published federal, state and payer-specific coding guidelines.

The Medical Coding Auditor conducts coding reviews and quality assurance audits to verify that all applicable guidelines associated with ICD-10 CM, HCPCS, CPT procedural coding, and modifier usage are followed by the BOOST coding team and the global coding teams. The Medical Coding Auditor also performs as a denial management coder, which reviews and analyzes coding denials and provides needed corrections of these claims when applicable, and performs quality assurance on global denial coding teams processes.

Medical Coding Auditors must maintain continuous contact with the BOOST internal and global coding teams to provide statistical and qualitative feedback on the coding quality and aid in education and guidance consistent with established coding and compliance guidelines. They will perform duties under the supervision of the Medical Coding and Auditing Manager.

Essential Functions of Medical Coding Auditor

  • Responsible for analyzing, reviewing and providing feedback when performing quality assurance activities and completing QA audits, including but not limited to:
    • Ensuring all federal and state coding guidelines and regulations are met as well as payer guidelines
    • Provide effective feedback to the global coding teams to aid in their successful coding of BOOST clients
    • Maintaining a communication log to show successful training of the global coding team when coding trends or issues are found
    • Report all coding trends and issues to department lead as they are identified
  • Review target cases per month based on the ModMed Quality Assurance SOP
  • Accurately document their daily audit results in the Daily Audit Log and communicate coding resolutions to the BOOST or global coding teams
    • This would include monthly assistance in maintaining QA audit logs summary pages which details the global coding teams monthly coding accuracy levels
  • Collaborate with the global coding teams on inquires, clarifications, QA rebuttals and training requests
  • Work alongside coding leadership in regard to global coding teams training of coding processes as well as attending remote coding sessions with the global coding teams
    • This would consist of coding, documentation, coding guideline training and overall QA findings resolutions
  • Help with other daily communications between the internal BOOST RCM teams and the Auditing team in regards to other coding inquiries or issues
    • This would include any sync calls pertaining to assigned clients or ModMed committee calls pertaining to assigned specialties
  • Perform BOOST special Quality Assurance audits on the global coding teams
    • Such as on their assignment accuracy, coding appeals accuracy and all other coding scopes
  • Perform BOOST or Compliance audits when requested by BOOST or other ModMed staff which help to determine coding compliance or client documentation issues
  • Support in the review, appeal and follow up of third party (RAC, CERT, etc.) audits
  • Assist in review and maintenance of coding guidelines, coding scrub edits and/or practice coding instructions and assist with continuous quality improvement by helping with the process of implementation and carry through of coding protocols and procedures
  • Collaborate with fellow coding/auditing team members to maintain department compliance and effectiveness
  • Responsible for obtaining continuing education units (CEU) for maintaining coding certification(s)

Position Overview:

The TigrignaVideo-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Tigrigna and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**

Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.

  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.

Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist

Remote | Personal Injury | Part-Time, 30 hours/week initially | $6.5/hour

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and personable Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist to support a growing personal injury medical practice.

The immediate priority for this role is addressing a significant backlog of patient follow-up calls. You will conduct outbound outreach, document patient recovery progress, support attorney and legal documentation requests, and help ensure that tasks are completed accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate combines strong medical assistant experience with excellent communication, persistence, accuracy, and the ability to handle sensitive patient and legal information with a very high level of attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Follow-Up & Outreach

  • Contact patients approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit to check on their recovery and current condition.

  • Conduct consistent outbound outreach through calls, texts, or other approved channels while remaining professional and respectful.

  • Follow up persistently when patients are difficult to reach without becoming overly aggressive or pushy.

Symptom Tracking & Documentation

  • Complete structured follow-up questionnaires regarding symptoms such as headaches, dizziness, and other reported concerns.

  • Record patient responses accurately in the practice's dedicated symptom tracking database.

  • Maintain complete and organized documentation so the physician can easily review patient recovery progress.

Legal Records & Billing Requests

  • Respond to requests from attorneys and law firms for patient evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation.

  • Compile the correct records and ensure all requested information is complete before sending or uploading it.

  • Handle legal and medical documentation with extremely high accuracy because errors can directly affect personal injury cases.

Portal & Task Management

  • Upload completed evaluations, records, bills, and other requested documentation into designated attorney or client portals.

  • Track outstanding requests and completed tasks so documentation does not fall through the cracks.

  • Maintain organized records across the clinic's internal systems and external portals.

Reporting & Operational Reliability

  • Provide End-of-Day reports summarizing completed calls, outreach attempts, pending follow-ups, and finished tasks.

  • Maintain consistent follow-through on assigned responsibilities and communicate quickly when an issue could affect completion.

  • Prioritize accuracy and reliability, particularly when handling patient records, legal requests, and time-sensitive documentation.

Cross-Training & Practice Support

  • Learn the Scheduling & Intake Specialist's core workflows, including scheduling, patient intake, and patient communication.

  • Provide backup coverage when the other VMA is unavailable or when patient volume increases.

  • Assist with incoming calls, emails, patient questions, or administrative work when additional practice support is required.

Required Qualifications

  • Fully fluent in English and Spanish.

  • Previous experience as a Medical Assistant, Medical Receptionist, Virtual Medical Assistant, or similar healthcare support professional.

  • Strong understanding of medical terminology and patient communication.

  • Exceptional attention to detail when entering records or managing documentation.

  • Strong telephone communication skills with a warm, conversational, and patient-centered approach.

  • Comfortable performing frequent outbound patient calls and follow-ups.

  • Highly organized and capable of independently tracking multiple open tasks.

  • Able to work consistently during Mountain Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience working with personal injury practices.

  • Experience communicating with attorneys or law firms.

  • Experience fulfilling medical records or billing documentation requests.

  • Familiarity with legal, clinic, or attorney portals.

Tools & Systems

  • Internal Clinic Symptom Database for documenting standardized patient follow-up responses and recovery symptoms.

  • External Law Firm/Clinic Portals for uploading completed evaluations, medical records, bills, and other requested documentation.

  • GoLean Productivity Tool and GoLean Private Network for productivity monitoring and secure access to practice systems and patient information.

What Success Looks Like

  • The existing patient follow-up backlog is steadily cleared, with patients contacted approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit and their recovery information documented accurately.

jobs.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

Wesper is seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and process-driven Junior Data Analyst to support our healthcare improvement project aimed at closing the diagnosis gap for Obstructive Sleep Apnea.

This role is critical to the initiative’s success, acting as the bridge between raw clinical data and actionable insights. You will work closely with our Program & Implementation Lead and our administering partner (Health Management Associates) to collect, validate, and visualize data from participating primary care clinics. You will help us track our "Model for Improvement" (PDSA) cycles, ensuring our run charts and Statistical Process Control (SPC) charts are accurate and up-to-date.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about using data to improve patient outcomes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Data Collection & Validation: Gather patient-level screening and diagnostic data from partner primary care clinics, ensuring strict adherence to HIPAA and data-sharing agreements.
  • Performance Tracking: Assist in building and maintaining run charts and Statistical Process Control (SPC) charts to track screening rates, referral conversion, and diagnostic yield.
  • Reporting Support: Prepare monthly and quarterly data summaries for the project team, our administering partner (HMA), and our sponsor.
  • AI-Enhanced Workflow Optimization: Utilize AI tools and LLMs to automate data cleaning, synthesize qualitative feedback from clinical staff, and accelerate the generation of insights from screening trends.
  • Workflow Support: Partner with the clinical team to support PDSA (Plan-Do-Study-Act) cycles, helping to document and measure the effectiveness of screening process changes in real-time.
  • Data Integrity: Maintain rigorous standards for data accuracy, identifying and flagging anomalies in site-reported data.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a point of contact for clinic staff to facilitate smooth data transmission and resolve reporting bottlenecks.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Health Informatics, Business, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Experience: 1–3 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or healthcare operations.
  • AI Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to leverage AI-powered analytics tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, or domain-specific health AI) to streamline data interpretation, summarize findings, and enhance analytical productivity.
  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (Pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data visualization/charting).
  • Analytical Mindset: Ability to synthesize complex datasets into clear, understandable trends for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: Exceptional accuracy in record-keeping; experience with clinical or sensitive data is highly preferred.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal skills; comfortable communicating with clinic staff and internal project leads.
  • Agility: Comfortable working in a remote-first, startup environment where priorities can shift as we iterate on processes

OUR TEAM—Built for Good

We pride ourselves on transparent communication—open discussion is critical to our performance and growth. We focus on accountability, humility, and constant learning. We believe in finding a better way through data and attention to detail. We work toward making sleep medicine easy, and we do it for our users.

ABOUT WESPER

Mission-driven startup aiming to make accurate sleep testing more convenient, affordable, and accessible.

Sleep disorders are a hidden epidemic that reduce quality and length of life for more than 10% of the population. The difficulty in diagnosing and monitoring sleep conditions is a major obstacle to the health of 100Ms of people worldwide.

Wesper is transforming the sleep industry by shrinking an entire sleep lab to a single wearable patch, helping millions live better, longer lives. Our platform delivers consumer comfort with clinical performance by using cutting-edge sensor design, a cloud-native suite of state-of-the-art algorithms, and a sleek mobile app, creating a seamless experience for both patient and doctor.

Opportunity

We are seeking a highly organized and results-driven Project Manager to lead the execution and ongoing coordination of our new OSA Healthcare Improvement Initiative. This role is the central hub for the program, responsible for ensuring that our PDSA-driven (Plan-Do-Study-Act) screening workflow is successfully implemented across 8 primary care sites.

You will serve as the primary bridge between Wesper leadership, our healthcare-improvement partner, and the participating clinical sites, ensuring all milestones are met and program outcomes are successfully tracked and reported. This is a contract role scheduled for a 1 year project with the possibility of extension and conversion to full time if the project moves into additional initiatives.

This is a remote opportunity.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Program Coordination & Roadmap Execution: Own the program roadmap (Phases 1–5), ensuring the initiative stays on track from the initial setup and baseline data collection to final scale, sustainment, and readout.
  • Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the primary point of contact for clinical site improvement teams, internal leadership, and our administering partner, ensuring clear, consistent communication of progress, hurdles, and successes.
  • Quality Improvement Oversight: Partner with the administering partner to facilitate practice improvement coaching, support weekly PDSA huddles at pilot sites, and maintain alignment across the cross-site learning collaborative.
  • Measurement & Reporting: Coordinate the collection and verification of performance data. Oversee the maintenance of run charts and SPC dashboards to track progress against our aim statement and priority measures, ensuring timely and accurate quarterly reporting.
  • Deliverable Management: Organize and track program deliverables, including the playbook, training curricula, and patient/staff education materials.
  • Operational Readiness: Manage site onboarding documentation, partnership agreements, and HIPAA/data-sharing compliance processes to ensure all sites are prepared to launch screening workflows.

Experience & Skills

  • Project Management Expertise: 3+ years of experience managing complex, multi-site healthcare projects or quality improvement initiatives.
  • Clinical/Quality Improvement Knowledge: Familiarity with clinical environments, primary care workflows, and Quality Improvement (QI) methodologies (e.g., PDSA, RE-AIM, run charts).
  • Strong Communicator: Exceptional ability to synthesize complex clinical and technical information and translate it into actionable plans for both clinical and non-clinical audiences.
  • Accountability-Driven: Proven ability to work independently, manage competing priorities in a fast-paced startup environment, and meet rigorous milestone-based deadlines.
  • Software Proficiency: Proficient in project management tools (Jira, Asana, etc.) and Google Workspace.
  • Educational Background: A degree in healthcare administration, public health, project management, or a related field.

OUR TEAM—Built for Good

We pride ourselves on transparent communication—open discussion is critical to our performance and growth. We focus on accountability, humility, and constant learning. We believe in finding a better way through data and attention to detail. We work toward making sleep medicine easy, and we do it for our users.

ABOUT WESPER

Mission-driven startup aiming to make accurate sleep testing more convenient, affordable, and accessible.

Sleep disorders are a hidden epidemic that reduce quality and length of life for more than 10% of the population. The difficulty in diagnosing and monitoring sleep conditions is a major obstacle to the health of 100Ms of people worldwide.

Wesper is transforming the sleep industry by shrinking an entire sleep lab to a single wearable patch, helping millions live better, longer lives. Our platform delivers consumer comfort with clinical performance by using cutting-edge sensor design, a cloud-native suite of state-of-the-art algorithms, and a sleek mobile app, creating a seamless experience for both patient and doctor.
