Customer Success Manager – HVAC & Plumbing | Inbound Sales & Scheduling | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Customer Success Manager with hands-on HVAC and/or plumbing industry experience to manage inbound customer calls, convert service inquiries into booked appointments, coordinate scheduling, and deliver an excellent customer experience.

This is not a passive customer support role. Your performance will directly impact appointment bookings, revenue, membership sales, and customer retention.

As the first point of contact for customers needing HVAC or plumbing services, you’ll quickly understand their needs, communicate appropriate options, create confidence and urgency when necessary, and get the right service scheduled.

If you understand the home services industry and know how to turn inbound calls into booked appointments without sacrificing customer experience, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Inbound Calls & Appointment Booking

  • Handle high-volume inbound HVAC and plumbing service calls
  • Convert customer inquiries into confirmed service appointments
  • Assist customers with:
    • Emergency service requests
    • Repairs and maintenance
    • Scheduling inquiries
    • General service questions
  • Ask effective questions to understand customer needs and service urgency
  • Build appropriate urgency and confidence to maximize booking rates
  • Guide customers toward clear next steps
  • Maintain a professional, helpful, and solutions-focused experience on every call

Scheduling & Dispatch Coordination

  • Schedule service appointments accurately based on customer needs and technician availability
  • Coordinate with dispatch and field teams to maintain an efficient schedule
  • Categorize service requests correctly
  • Capture complete customer, property, and appointment information
  • Follow scheduling and dispatch procedures consistently
  • Help minimize scheduling conflicts and missed opportunities
  • Communicate schedule-related updates clearly to customers and internal teams

Membership Sales & Upselling

  • Introduce HVAC and plumbing maintenance memberships when appropriate
  • Recommend relevant additional services based on customer needs
  • Clearly explain membership features and benefits
  • Handle common sales objections professionally
  • Identify opportunities to increase customer value without being overly aggressive
  • Contribute toward membership, booking, and conversion targets

Customer Experience & Retention

  • Provide empathetic, solutions-focused customer service
  • Handle frustrated or concerned customers calmly and professionally
  • Ensure customers feel heard, informed, and supported
  • Resolve routine concerns while escalating more complex issues appropriately
  • Follow up on open customer requests when necessary
  • Help create an experience that encourages repeat business and long-term loyalty
  • Take ownership of customer interactions through resolution

CRM & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate records of:
    • Customer information
    • Service requests
    • Appointment details
    • Call notes
    • Follow-up requirements
  • Keep CRM and scheduling records complete and current
  • Follow established call scripts, workflows, and documentation standards
  • Ensure accurate information is available to dispatch, technicians, and operations teams

Requirements

  • Previous HVAC and/or plumbing customer service experience is required
  • Proven experience converting inbound calls into booked service appointments
  • Strong phone communication and active listening skills
  • Experience with CRM, scheduling, dispatch, or customer service systems
  • Strong appointment scheduling and coordination skills
  • Experience with upselling or membership/service-plan sales
  • Confident objection-handling ability
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Comfortable handling high-volume inbound customer interactions
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Ability to work reliably during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience working directly with a U.S.-based HVAC or plumbing company
  • Experience in broader home services environments
  • Familiarity with HVAC maintenance plans or service memberships
  • Experience coordinating with technicians and dispatch teams
  • Experience working in a KPI-driven call center or customer service environment
  • Experience tracking booking, conversion, and membership sales performance

Tools & Technology

CRM Systems | Scheduling Platforms | Dispatch Systems | Customer Service Software | VOIP/Phone Systems | Digital Communication Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Understand how HVAC and plumbing service calls work
  • Are comfortable handling a high volume of inbound calls
  • Can confidently guide customers toward booking
  • Are persuasive without sounding scripted or pushy
  • Stay calm when customers have urgent service problems
  • Balance excellent customer service with sales and conversion goals
  • Are comfortable introducing memberships and additional services
  • Work quickly while maintaining accurate records
  • Follow up consistently and take ownership through resolution
  • Understand that every customer interaction can impact both retention and revenue

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing open customer requests, scheduled appointments, and any follow-ups requiring attention.

Throughout the day, you’ll answer inbound HVAC and plumbing calls, identify customer needs and urgency, convert inquiries into booked appointments, and coordinate technician availability with dispatch.

You’ll also introduce maintenance memberships and relevant services, handle customer objections or concerns, update CRM records, and coordinate with operations teams to keep service requests moving.

You may finish by reviewing outstanding requests and monitoring booking and conversion performance.

In short: you turn inbound service inquiries into booked appointments, satisfied customers, and recurring revenue.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Call-to-booking conversion rate
  • Total appointments booked
  • Membership sales and close rate
  • Customer satisfaction and call quality
  • Scheduling accuracy and efficiency
  • CRM documentation accuracy
  • Response and call-handling times
  • Customer retention and repeat-service opportunities
  • Follow-up completion rates

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on both customer experience and company revenue
  • High-ownership role with clear, measurable performance goals
  • Opportunity to combine customer service, inbound sales, scheduling, and home services operations
  • Stable full-time remote position
  • Exposure to fast-paced U.S. HVAC and plumbing operations
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Customer Service Team Lead
    • Senior Customer Success Manager
    • Dispatch / Scheduling Lead
    • Home Services Operations Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have HVAC or plumbing customer service experience, know how to convert inbound calls into appointments, and enjoy balancing customer care with sales performance, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and take direct ownership of bookings, membership sales, customer experience, and revenue performance within a fast-paced U.S. home services environment.

About Teletask

Teletask powers public sector communication. Government and public health agencies use our automated text, voice, and email outreach to reach the families they serve. Our largest footprint is WIC (Women, Infants & Children) nutrition programs, where Teletask messaging drives appointment attendance for over 6 million participants across 35+ US states.

Teletask is at an inflection point, and we are building a commercial engine to match the product. Teletask is looking for it’s first trailblazing sales hire to own the GTM function for the team. You will own the revenue motion outright, from first inbound inquiry through RFP, award, and renewal. Expect an entrepreneurial, fully remote environment with high visibility and real autonomy.

What You'll Actually Do

Drive New Business & Product Education

  • Qualify & Consult: Field inbound inquiries, assessing technical use cases, integration needs, and expected platform volume to ensure a strong mutual fit.
  • Showcase the Value: Schedule and lead engaging, 30-minute virtual demonstrations (via Zoom) tailored specifically to WIC agencies and public-sector prospects.
  • Lead Targeted Outreach: Design and execute strategic email messaging campaigns to nurture public sector prospects, generate outbound pipeline, and keep our solution top-of-mind during long government buying cycles.
  • Structure Deals: Educate prospects on platform capabilities and plan limits, draft accurate initial quotes, and negotiate optional features to align with client goals.

Master the RFP & Contracting Process

  • Win the Bid: Spearhead Request for Proposal (RFP/RFR) responses. You’ll answer technical capability questions, craft compelling proposal narratives, and package the final winning bid.
  • Close the Deal: Finalize the commercial scope of work and seamlessly route agreements for signature.

Ensure Seamless Deployments & Account Health

  • Bridge Sales to Success: Gather essential documentation (POs, Letters of Authorization) and immediately create onboarding tickets in Zoho so our Implementation team can hit the ground running.
  • Partner with Finance: Step in strategically to leverage your strong client relationships if a payment gets stalled.
  • Drive Renewals & Expansion: Proactively monitor upcoming contract end dates and analyze platform usage data. You’ll lead renewal conversations, present updated volume tiers, and secure upsells.

Required Qualifications

  • 2 - 5+ years of B2B sales or account management experience selling to government or enterprise clients
  • Demonstrated full-cycle ownership. You have carried deals from first touch to signature to renewal without an SDR or sales engineer behind you
  • Relationship Builder with a track record winning competitive bids, including writing the technical and narrative sections of RFP responses yourself
  • Strong technical writing and communication skills. You can explain an integration requirement to a procurement and make the commercial cases apparent
  • Fluency with CRM platforms, e-signature tools, and virtual meetings polished enough to hold a public sector audience
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel (utilizing pivot tables and vlookups)
  • Excellent problem-solving skills to navigate the unique challenges and requirements of government contracts

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep understanding of government procurement processes, regulations, and compliance requirements; direct WIC programs exposure is a nice-to-have
  • Experience running outbound cadences in a sales engagement platform (Zoho Campaigns, Outreach, Apollo, or similar)
  • Zoho CRM and Zoho books experience is an asset
  • Familiarity with cooperative purchasing vehicles, sole-source justifications, or state term contracts is a plus

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • Complete onboarding and training on the company's products, services, and target market
  • Develop proficiency with attention to detail in the renewal and quote process.
  • Begin building relationships with key stakeholders in Marketing, Product, and Customer Success
  • Learn the key features, benefits, and use cases of the software platform
  • Lead at least 5 sales calls or demos with assistance and create quotes for them.
  • Regularly assess your own understanding and comfort level with core processes and concepts.
  • Proactively seek out additional learning resources or training opportunities to fill knowledge gaps.
  • Keep a running list of questions and topics to review with the trainer during available sessions.

Who You'll Work With

You will report to Teletask's executive leadership team and serve as the company's primary voice in the public sector market. A given day might mean an agency demo in the morning, an RFP narrative at noon, and a procurement portal submission with Contract & Billing Operations in the afternoon.

What We Offer

  • Full ownership of the public sector revenue motion, not a slice of a territory on a larger sales team
  • An entrepreneurial, fully remote environment with high visibility and autonomy
  • Exposure to the Solen Software Group portfolio company network and operating model

Intuition Machines builds enterprise security products with an AI/ML focus. We apply our research to systems that serve hundreds of millions of people, with a team distributed around the world. You are probably familiar with our best-known product, the hCaptcha security suite. Our approach is simple: low overhead, small teams, and rapid iteration.

We’re looking for a Lead Machine Learning Engineer with strong software engineering skills and a creative mindset for ML-focused problem-solving.


Using AI: Coding agents are indisputably useful tools. We provide access to the top 3 models, and were early adopters of evals-first development flows. Familiarity with coding using agents is part of all interviews. However, reliability and correctness are critical for us. You will need to read and understand every line of code with your name on it, and it will be reviewed by both people and machines.


What you will do here:

  • Lead large-scale ML projects and products from inception to production, overseeing the entire lifecycle from design and implementation to deployment and maintenance.
  • Make key architectural decisions to ensure solutions are scalable, efficient, and maintainable while balancing business and technical constraints.
  • Drive collaboration across ML and engineering teams to ensure product success, influencing technical discussions and decisions at all levels.
  • Design and implement state-of-the-art machine learning pipelines and models that impact millions of users and generate real business value.
  • Set technical standards and lead the development of scalable, testable, and high-performance applications.
  • Provide leadership and mentorship to other ML engineers, fostering the growth of a strong Machine Learning Engineering organization.


What you will learn:

  • Work on systems that affect millions of users daily, scaling machine learning systems with billions of data points and millions of inferences per second.
  • Gain experience in architecting and scaling advanced ML solutions for real-world challenges, moving beyond standard approaches from research papers.
  • Have the opportunity to define technical strategy, contribute to significant ML advancements, and guide the future direction of ML systems at scale.


What we are looking for:

  • 7+ years of experience building and maintaining large-scale production ML systems, with a focus on performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Proven experience as the owner or significant contributor to products used by tens of thousands of customers, with the ability to make complex design decisions.
  • Expertise in machine learning algorithms, productionizing ML models, and scaling systems to handle large data volumes.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with creative approaches to overcoming technical challenges.
  • Experience leading technical discussions, driving decisions, and setting technical standards for a team.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with modern orchestration platforms (Kubernetes, containerization, microservice design) and distributed systems.
  • Ability to identify, define, and segment complex research problems and drive innovative solutions that align with business and technical goals.


What we offer:

  • Fully remote position with flexible working hours.
  • An inspiring team of colleagues spread all over the world.
  • Pleasant, modern development and deployment workflows: ship early, ship often.
  • High impact: lots of users, happy customers, high growth, and cutting edge R&D.
  • Flat organization, direct interaction with customer teams.

We celebrate equality of opportunity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. Join us as we transform cybersecurity, user privacy, and machine learning online!

jobs.excerpt: About Revolution Prep Revolution Prep is a high-growth, performance-driven company committed to transforming education while remaining true to our social mission.
jobs.description:
About Revolution Prep

Revolution Prep is a high-growth, performance-driven company committed to transforming education while remaining true to our social mission.

Our people define the Revolution. Revolutionaries are talented, resourceful, and tenacious. To be a “Revolutionary” means to come to work ready to collaborate, achieve, and to inspire. As a result, passion and energy feed into a collegial, entrepreneurial, and fast-paced culture that permeates throughout our workspace.

Full-Time Professional Online Tutor – SAT/ACT & Academics

Remote | Full-Time W-2 | $25/hr Starting Pay | Paid Training & Prep | Benefits

Make a Difference. Build a Career. Tutor from Home.

Make a meaningful impact on students’ academic journeys—all from the comfort of your home. Join Revolution Prep as a full-time tutor and enjoy the stability, benefits, and support of being a full-time W-2 employee—not an independent contractor.

We provide a dynamic, in-house curriculum and a wealth of teaching resources, so you can spend less time creating lesson plans and searching for materials and more time doing what you do best: helping students learn and succeed.

You’ll also receive paid training and prep time, along with a supportive community of fellow tutors who are passionate about education. Whether you’re helping a student master a challenging concept, build confidence, or reach an important academic goal, your work makes a real difference.

Schedule Requirements

This role requires a consistent weekly schedule and a minimum of 38 hours of availability, including evenings and weekends.

  • The goal is 30+ hours of tutoring per week, though actual hours may vary based on student demand and your subject expertise.
  • At least 8 hours of weekend availability required
  • Availability must remain consistent from week to week
  • Schedules are posted in 2-6 hour blocks and extend 9+ months into the future
  • Time-off requests should generally be submitted at least 4 weeks in advance
  • Minimum one-year employment commitment

Prime-time availability:

  • Monday–Thursday: 3–11 PM ET
  • Friday: 3–7 PM ET
  • Saturday: 9 AM–7 PM ET
  • Sunday: 9 AM–10 PM ET

What You'll Teach

  • SAT and ACT test preparation
  • High-school mathematics through Algebra II
  • Executive function skills such as organization, planning, time management and study strategies
  • Additional subjects based on your expertise and Revolution Prep's needs

What You'll Do

  • Lead engaging online tutoring sessions using Revolution Prep's curriculum and resources
  • Help students understand challenging concepts and develop effective learning strategies
  • Prepare for sessions using company-provided materials
  • Communicate with students and families about academic progress
  • Build supportive relationships that motivate students to reach their goals
  • Participate in paid training and ongoing professional development
  • Collaborate with Faculty Leaders and fellow tutors to continuously improve your teaching

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • At least 1 year of professional teaching or tutoring experience
  • Comfortable teaching math through Algebra II
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to explain challenging concepts clearly and patiently
  • SAT/ACT tutoring or test-preparation experience is a plus
  • AP STEM subject expertise is a plus
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Authorized to work in the U.S. and currently residing in the U.S.

Why Join Revolution Prep?

  • Full-time W-2 employment
  • $25/hour starting rate for tutoring
  • Opportunity to earn up to $29/hour after the 90-day review, based on performance and subject coverage
  • Paid prep and training time
  • Health insurance
  • 401(k) options
  • Bonus opportunities
  • Paid onboarding and ongoing professional development
  • Proven curriculum and subject-specific materials provided
  • No need to compete for tutoring hours; hours are allocated based on availability and subject expertise
  • Support from experienced Faculty Leaders
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on students' academic and personal development

Technology Requirements

You'll need:

  • A Mac or PC desktop/laptop
  • Reliable high-speed internet with an Ethernet connection
  • At least 4GB available RAM
  • A quiet, professional workspace suitable for online instruction

Revolution Prep can provide a technology kit for tutors who need one, including a webcam, headset, ring light, green screen and annotation tablet.

Our Hiring Process

After submitting your application, candidates will receive a link to a required approximately 30-minute assessment.The assessment helps Revolution Prep evaluate subject knowledge and overall fit for the Professional Tutor role.

Candidates who advance in the process will also complete a comprehensive background check.

Q&A

Q: Are there additional responsibilities?

A: In addition to tutoring, you'll communicate with families about student progress and prepare for sessions using company-provided materials. Both collectively make up around 10% of your workload and are paid time. We also offer ongoing professional development which is paid.

Q: How flexible is the time-off policy?

A: Requests for time off must be submitted at least 4 weeks in advance. We understand emergencies happen, so we have systems in place for coverage in those events.

Q: Is ongoing training part of the role?

A: Yes, ongoing professional development is required – we offer 24 hours of paid training per year after the initial onboarding.

Connect With Us

Company Website, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube

Job Description:

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. The CMM program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AO) in developing a modern cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States.

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The UI/UX Human Centered Design Specialist ensures dashboards, reporting tools, predictive analytics screens, and AI/ML interfaces are intuitive, accessible, and aligned with Judiciary user workflows, supporting the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team in delivering data-driven decision-support tools in alignment with strict federal compliance requirements.

This role supports the Reporting, Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) deliverables by shaping user-centered visual designs for the Reporting & Analytics Capability and the Measurement Definitions and Decision-Support Package. By applying human-centered design (HCD) best practices to visualizations, navigation patterns, and decision-support experiences, this role enhances adoption and interpretability while ensuring designs meet Section 508, WCAG 2.1 AA, and federal digital service standards for accessibility, performance, and security.

The UI/UX Human Centered Design Specialist will execute the following responsibilities:

Reporting & Analytics

  • Design intuitive, accessible dashboards, self-service reporting interfaces, and predictive analytics screens for the CMM Reporting & Analytics Capability, applying Human-Centered Design (HCD) and usability best practices.
  • Translate UX research, personas, and journey maps into high-fidelity prototypes, wireframes, and interface design specifications for development teams.
  • Partner with BI Architects, data engineers, product owners, and developers to align visual designs with data models, KPIs, and reporting requirements.
  • Conduct usability testing, including heuristic evaluations, card sorting, and A/B testing, on dashboards and visualizations, and apply findings to refine designs each sprint.
  • Define and maintain visualization, navigation, and interaction design standards to ensure reports and dashboards are consistent, interpretable, and support adoption.
  • Design the user experience for the Measurement Definitions and Decision-Support Package, ensuring metrics and KPIs are presented in a clear, decision-ready format.
  • Evaluate designs for Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance across all reporting and analytics interfaces.
  • Support rapid prototyping and iterative validation of dashboard and reporting designs within Agile sprint cycles.
  • Drive user adoption of dashboards and reporting tools by aligning navigation patterns and visual hierarchy with Judiciary user workflows.
  • Contribute standardized UI components and templates to the shared CMM design system for reuse across reporting products.

AI/ML Capabilities

  • Design intuitive, explainable interfaces for AI/ML-driven predictive analytics and decision-support features, ensuring model outputs are interpretable to end users.
  • Apply HCD principles to the presentation of AI/ML model outputs, confidence indicators, and recommendations to support responsible AI adoption.
  • Collaborate with AI/ML and data science teams to translate model capabilities into user-facing workflows aligned with federal responsible-AI requirements for transparency, fairness, and risk mitigation.
  • Conduct usability evaluations of AI/ML interfaces and incorporate feedback into iterative design refinements.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • MA/MS degree, or Bachelor's/Master's degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Design, or a related field, with 10+ years of general experience in information systems and 8+ years of specialized experience in UI/UX design, including 5+ years in a Human-Centered Design (HCD) role supporting enterprise or government applications.
  • Experience may be considered in lieu of degree as follows: HS (16+ years), AA/AS (14+ years), BA/BS (12+ years), Doctorate Degree/Ph.D. (9+ years).
  • Expertise in usability testing methodologies, such as heuristic evaluations, card sorting, and A/B testing, and proficiency in design and prototyping tools (Figma, Sketch, Axure, Storybook, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of Agile/SAFe delivery, iterative design integration, and DesignOps/UX governance practices.
  • Familiarity with HTML5, CSS3, and responsive UI behavior to collaborate effectively with front-end developers.
  • Experience designing for federal systems, with practical knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.

COMMUNICATION & ORGANIZATIONAL

  • Excellent presentation and communication (oral and written) skills.
  • Consultant mindset with the ability to work with high level customer stakeholders and build excellent customer relationships.
  • Experience identifying and applying industry tools, solutions, methods best practices, and emerging technologies.
  • Strong analytical skills and problem-solving skills with the ability to formulate and communicate recommendations for improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively, independently, and as part of a team.

CERTIFICATIONS (Preferred)

  • Certified Usability Analyst (CUA) or Certified HCD Professional
  • SAFe Agile Practitioner (SPC or SSM)
  • Section 508 Trusted Tester Certification
  • UX Design or HCD Certification (NN/g, IDEO, or HFI)

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

Our Identity Verification Process:

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Product Designer (UX/UI) to own the end-to-end user experience across modern web and mobile SaaS applications.

This role goes beyond creating beautiful interfaces. You’ll combine user research, product thinking, UX strategy, interface design, and scalable design systems to build intuitive digital experiences that improve usability, engagement, retention, and customer satisfaction.

Working closely with Product Managers and Engineers, you’ll transform user insights into elegant, production-ready designs while ensuring consistency across the entire product ecosystem.

If you think in **user journeys, workflows, and systems—not just screens—**this role is built for you.

What You’ll Own

UX Research & Product Discovery

  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and behavioral analysis.
  • Translate research into:
    • User personas
    • Journey maps
    • User flows
    • Information architecture
    • Product requirements
  • Identify friction points and recommend UX improvements.
  • Use product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel and Amplitude to support design decisions.

UX/UI Design

  • Design wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity user interfaces.
  • Create responsive experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
  • Design intuitive workflows that improve usability and task completion.
  • Deliver polished SaaS experiences aligned with modern UX best practices.

Design Systems & Component Libraries

  • Build and maintain scalable design systems.
  • Create reusable UI components and design patterns.
  • Establish standards for:
    • Typography
    • Color systems
    • Spacing
    • Interaction patterns
    • Accessibility
  • Ensure visual consistency across all product experiences.

User Experience Optimization

  • Conduct usability testing and collect customer feedback.
  • Run A/B tests on:
    • Layouts
    • User flows
    • Navigation
    • Interaction patterns
  • Improve:
    • User engagement
    • Retention
    • Feature adoption
    • Conversion rates
  • Iterate designs using research findings and product analytics.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineers throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Participate in product planning, discovery sessions, and design reviews.
  • Deliver developer-ready designs using:
    • Figma Dev Mode
    • Zeplin
    • Design documentation
  • Provide clear interaction specifications and implementation guidance.

Accessibility & Design Quality

  • Design experiences aligned with WCAG accessibility standards.
  • Ensure usability across browsers, devices, and screen sizes.
  • Advocate for user-centered design principles throughout the organization.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Strong product-thinking mindset with a passion for solving user problems.
  • Excellent visual design skills with high attention to detail.
  • Comfortable balancing user needs with business objectives.
  • Collaborative, receptive to feedback, and eager to iterate.
  • Data-driven approach to design decisions.
  • Able to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 2+ years of Product Design or UX/UI Design experience.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating:
    • Product thinking
    • UX problem-solving
    • User-centered design
    • Responsive web and mobile design

Core Skills

  • Proficiency with:
    • Figma
    • Adobe XD
    • Sketch
  • Experience creating:
    • User flows
    • Wireframes
    • Interactive prototypes
    • Design systems
  • Strong understanding of:
    • UX principles
    • Accessibility
    • Responsive design
    • Usability testing
    • Interaction design

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience designing:
    • SaaS platforms
    • B2B software
    • Enterprise applications
    • Consumer products
  • Experience maintaining scalable design systems.
  • Familiarity with:
    • Mixpanel
    • Amplitude
    • Product analytics tools
  • Basic front-end knowledge:
    • HTML
    • CSS
    • JavaScript
  • Experience working in Agile product environments.

Tools & Technologies

  • Figma
  • Adobe XD
  • Sketch
  • Mixpanel
  • Amplitude
  • Zeplin
  • Product Analytics Platforms
  • Collaboration & Project Management Tools

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Conduct user research and analyze product insights.
  • Design wireframes, prototypes, and polished user interfaces.
  • Build and refine scalable design systems.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers on new features.
  • Run usability tests and improve user journeys.
  • Deliver developer-ready assets and documentation.
  • Iterate designs using customer feedback and analytics.

In short: You’ll design intuitive, scalable product experiences that improve usability, engagement, and customer satisfaction while helping shape the future of the product.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Improved usability and customer satisfaction.
  • Increased user engagement and feature adoption.
  • Higher product retention.
  • Reduced UX friction across key workflows.
  • Consistent implementation of scalable design systems.
  • On-time delivery of high-quality design assets.
  • Strong collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.

Why Join Us?

  • Own the end-to-end product design experience.
  • Make a direct impact on product usability and customer outcomes.
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering leadership.
  • Help build and scale modern design systems.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexibility.
  • Clear growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Product Designer
    • Lead Product Designer
    • Design Manager
    • Head of Design

Interview Process

  1. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  2. Portfolio Review
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Rather than repeating your experience across multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your UX/UI design background, walk through your product design process, highlight relevant SaaS projects, and explain how you’ve approached user research, design systems, and cross-functional collaboration. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the portfolio review and client interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about designing intuitive user experiences, solving complex product challenges, and building scalable SaaS products that users love, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape exceptional digital experiences that make a real impact.

This role develops executive-level relationships across the private equity ecosystem, identifies acquisitions, carve-outs, buy-and-build, modernization, and other investment events that create opportunities for Epicor, and builds scalable pipeline across assigned firms and portfolios. The Senior Principal is the direct seller for designated carve-out opportunities and a strategic sales overlay for other portfolio-company opportunities, operating with a high degree of autonomy and accountability for individual revenue and pipeline objectives.

What you will be doing:

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans for assigned private equity firms using portfolio mapping, install-base analysis, vertical and buy-and-build priorities, whitespace identification, and relationship-development strategies to prioritize expansion, cloud-transition, and new-logo opportunities.

  • Build multi-threaded relationships with operating partners, heads of value creation, portfolio technology leaders, investment professionals, portfolio executives, and other decision-makers, positioning Epicor as a strategic technology partner across the investment lifecycle.

  • Translate sponsor value-creation priorities, including EBITDA improvement, working-capital release, standardized reporting, integration, carve-out execution, and exit readiness, into differentiated narratives for both the PE sponsor and the portfolio-company economic buyer.

  • Identify acquisition, carve-out, divestiture, platform-consolidation, modernization, and on-premises-to-cloud transition events that create opportunities for Epicor solutions; use relevant product-support or innovation milestones as timely, evidence-based entry points.

  • Own the full sales lifecycle for designated private equity carve-out opportunities, including prospecting, discovery, systems-readiness assessment, solution alignment, deal strategy, negotiation, forecasting, and close.

  • Serve as a strategic sales overlay for non-carve-out portfolio opportunities, partnering with territory, account, channel, and solution teams to develop deal strategies, navigate sponsor relationships, and advance qualified portfolio-company pipeline.

  • Build a referral and influence network with technology-diligence advisors, value-creation partners, systems integrators, and other ecosystem participants; orchestrate cross-functional resources across Sales, Solutions, Channel, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Services.

  • Develop portfolio-wide commercial approaches, including preferred-vendor or master-service-agreement frameworks, standardized statements of work, implementation models, and repeatable sales plays that support multiple portfolio companies.

  • Maintain disciplined CRM management and forecast accuracy while measuring PE-sourced and PE-influenced pipeline separately; share portfolio intelligence, competitive trends, benchmark insights, and results that improve sales effectiveness across the Revenue organization.

  • Establish and manage practical leading and outcome measures for the PE motion, including sponsor engagement, referral activity, assessments, portfolio agreements, qualified opportunities, sourced and influenced pipeline, and closed-won results.

What you will likely bring:

  • Advanced enterprise software or SaaS sales capability with demonstrated success developing and closing complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities and consistently delivering against revenue targets.

  • Strong understanding of private equity business models and transaction stages, including acquisitions, diligence, carve-outs, buy-and-build strategies, portfolio value creation, operating-partner relationships, hold-period economics, and exit readiness.

  • Advanced strategic account planning, portfolio analysis, pipeline generation, consultative selling, executive engagement, systems-readiness discovery, negotiation, and deal orchestration capabilities.

  • Strong commercial and financial acumen with the ability to connect technology investments to EBITDA, working capital, operational improvement, growth, profitability, integration, and investment outcomes.

  • Exceptional cross-functional influence, communication, and relationship-building skills, including the ability to establish referral partnerships, lead complex initiatives without direct authority, and operate independently as a senior individual contributor.

What will could you apart:

  • 10+ years progressive experience in enterprise software, SaaS, technology, or complex solution sales.

  • 4+ years of experience selling to or working with private equity sponsors, private equity-backed companies, strategic enterprise accounts, or similarly complex investment-driven customer environments.

  • Demonstrated history of achieving or exceeding individual sales targets, generating significant new-business pipeline, and converting strategic relationships or ecosystem referrals into measurable revenue outcomes.

  • Experience navigating executive-level relationships and complex sales cycles involving multiple internal and external stakeholders, including portfolio-company and sponsor constituencies.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

About Epicor

At Epicor, we’re truly a team. Join 5,000talented professionals in creating a world of better business through data, AI, and cognitive ERP. We help businesses stay future-ready by connecting people, processes, and technology. From software engineers who command the latest AI technology to business development reps who help us seize new opportunities, the work we do matters. Together, Epicor employees are creating a more resilient global supply chain.

We’re Proactive, Proud, Partners.

Whatever your career journey, we’ll help you find the right path. Through our training courses, mentorship, and continuous support, you’ll get everything you need to thrive. At Epicor, your success is our success. And that success really matters, because we’re the essential partners for the world’s most essential businesses—the hardworking companies who make, move, and sell the things the world needs.

jobs.excerpt: About UsSince 1989, SHI International Corp.  has helped organizations change the world through technology.
jobs.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Senior Director, Digital Workplace is accountable for the success, growth, and strategic direction of SHI's Digital Workplace organization within Microsoft Services. This leadership role brings together Collaboration, Workplace Platform, and Change Management under a single leader to ensure workplace technology, user adoption, and business outcomes are designed, delivered, and measured as one connected experience rather than as separate service lines.

This role leads the organization as a business, with ownership of service maturity, solution development, headcount planning, utilization, delivery quality, capacity, pipeline support, and measurable client outcomes across collaboration platforms, workplace modernization, identity and endpoint services, migrations, adoption, and organizational change. The Senior Director manages a team of managers and practice leaders responsible for Collaboration, Workplace Platform, and Change Management and remains accountable for their effectiveness, development, and delivery performance.

Aligned to Microsoft's Work IQ investments, this role connects how employees communicate, collaborate, access information, use workplace technology, and adopt new ways of working. The Senior Director ensures SHI helps clients deploy, secure, adopt, and realize value from Microsoft 365, Copilot, collaboration, identity, and endpoint capabilities across the full digital employee lifecycle.

This role sits at the center of SHI's Microsoft Services growth plan, turning Work IQ alignment into a working operating model that builds stronger solutions, improves delivery execution, develops talent, increases adoption, and creates repeatable paths for growth.

This is a remote position with a Home Office setup based in New York City, Charlotte, Chicago, Atlanta, Austin, Denver, Los Angeles, San Francisco, or Seattle.

Role Description

Strategic Leadership and Practice Development

  • Set and execute a unified direction for Digital Workplace, connecting Collaboration, Workplace Platform, and Change Management through one operating model.

  • Translate Microsoft's Work IQ, Microsoft 365, Copilot, identity, endpoint, and employee experience investments into a clear SHI services roadmap, capability plan, and investment agenda.

  • Establish clear ownership, decision rights, handoffs, delivery standards, and quality expectations across the organization.

  • Build modular, repeatable offerings that connect workplace technology, secure access, employee adoption, and value realization around defined client outcomes.

  • Use portfolio, pipeline, delivery, adoption, and capacity data to prioritize investments, manage tradeoffs, and improve practice health.

People Leadership Through Managers and Directors

  • Lead, coach, and develop the leaders responsible for Collaboration, Workplace Platform, and Change Management.

  • Set measurable expectations for customer experience, delivery quality, utilization, capability development, financial performance, adoption outcomes, and team health.

  • Build leadership depth through regular one-on-ones, development planning, succession planning, and clear career paths.

  • Own workforce planning across the organization, including hiring, onboarding, retention, skills development, and capacity alignment to backlog and pipeline.

  • Create a culture of shared accountability in which technical and change teams solve for the full customer outcome rather than optimize separate workstreams.

Technical Direction Across Workplace Technology, Change, and Security

  • Maintain a platform-aware perspective across Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Power Platform, Microsoft 365 Copilot, tenant migrations, identity modernization, Microsoft Intune, Windows 365, endpoint experience, and change enablement.

  • Guide the integration of Microsoft Entra, Conditional Access, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, and Defender for Office 365 into workplace solutions that protect users, devices, identities, messaging, and collaboration.

  • Ensure workplace solutions address user experience, accessibility, security, compliance, operational readiness, communications, training, adoption, and value realization from the beginning.

  • Sponsor reusable reference architectures, delivery frameworks, statements of work, work breakdown structures, migration patterns, adoption methods, templates, and accelerators.

  • Rely on practice leaders and principal architects for deep technical and change leadership while maintaining alignment across disciplines.

Delivery Excellence and Client Outcomes

  • Provide executive oversight for complex, multi-workstream engagements that span collaboration, tenant migrations, identity, endpoint, security, adoption, and change management.

  • Hold leaders accountable for scope quality, staffing readiness, delivery methodology, risk management, timelines, budgets, customer communication, and adoption outcomes.

  • Review project health, utilization, realization, margin, capacity, quality, adoption, and customer experience signals and act early when performance moves off plan.

  • Protect customer trust by ensuring teams make supportable commitments, manage business disruption, address security dependencies, and prepare customers to operate successfully after delivery.

  • Serve as an executive sponsor and trusted advisor for strategic clients, connecting workplace investments to employee productivity, business readiness, and measurable value.

Business Growth and Market Development

  • Grow Digital Workplace services revenue by improving solution relevance, supporting strategic pursuits, expanding enterprise client relationships, and developing repeatable offers.

  • Partner with Solution Architecture, Sales, Project Management, AI + Infrastructure, and Managed Services to shape opportunities and deliver connected customer outcomes.

  • Manage utilization, capacity, backlog, pipeline health, and delivery performance to improve profitability and support sustainable growth.

  • Build strong relationships with Microsoft field, engineering, and partner teams to align priorities, improve co-sell execution, and strengthen SHI's market credibility in Work IQ and Digital Workplace.

  • Capture customer evidence, references, adoption results, and measurable outcomes that support retention, expansion, and market recognition.

Executive and Cross-Functional Communication

  • Serve as an executive advisor to enterprise clients, connecting business priorities to Microsoft workplace, collaboration, identity, endpoint, Copilot, and change strategies.

  • Communicate practice priorities, portfolio health, performance, risks, and investment needs to senior leadership, including the Vice President, Microsoft Services.

  • Run a consistent operating cadence across leaders that covers pipeline, staffing, project health, financial performance, capability development, customer experience, and adoption outcomes.

  • Turn operating data and customer feedback into decisions and actions rather than reporting activity without accountability.

  • Escalate delivery, capacity, security, adoption, and customer risks early, with clear options and recommended actions.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking: Can analyze complex situations, drive organizational transformation, and adapt strategies to changing market conditions.

  • Leadership: Can lead strategic team initiatives, inspire others to take leadership roles, and foster a culture of shared responsibility and continuous improvement.

  • Communication: Can lead and model exceptional communication at all levels of the organization, develop and implement communication strategies, and coach others to improve their communication skills.

  • Collaboration: Can lead complex team projects, inspire others to collaborate effectively, and foster a culture of mutual respect and shared purpose.

  • Problem-Solving: Can lead strategic problem-solving initiatives, inspire others to improve their problem-solving skills, and foster a culture of proactive problem-solving.

  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Can lead strategic initiatives focused on improving the overall customer experience. Inspires and mentors others to adopt a customer-centric approach, fostering a culture of customer focus throughout the organization.

  • Results Orientation: Can inspire a culture of results-orientation across the organization, setting high standards and holding everyone accountable for achieving results.

  • Adaptability: Can drive strategic transformations, inspire others to embrace change, and foster a culture of continuous adaptation.

  • Strategic Implementation: Can lead the development and execution of comprehensive strategic plans, inspire and guide teams, and drive organizational change to achieve strategic objectives.

  • Continuous Improvement: Can lead others in identifying and implementing major improvements and proactively drive continuous improvement across the organization.

Skill Level Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical, business, organizational development, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 10 or more years of progressive leadership experience in technology services, consulting, digital workplace, organizational change, or related Microsoft practices.

  • 5 or more years leading managers, directors, senior technical leaders, or multi-discipline delivery organizations with accountability for people, delivery, and business performance.

  • Demonstrated success building or scaling professional services capabilities, repeatable offerings, and complex enterprise delivery motions.

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Exchange Online, OneDrive, Power Platform, Copilot, Entra, Intune, Windows 365, endpoint security, tenant migrations, and adoption and change management.

  • Experience managing utilization, capacity, staffing, delivery quality, portfolio health, adoption outcomes, and financial performance.

  • Ability to engage enterprise executives, translate business priorities into workplace technology and change roadmaps, and guide complex decisions.

  • Track record of partnering across sales, presales, project management, managed services, technology teams, and business stakeholders to grow customer relationships.

  • Relevant certifications may include Microsoft 365, Teams, Endpoint Administrator, Identity and Access Administrator, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Prosci, CCMP, or comparable workplace and change management credentials. Equivalent experience and demonstrated leadership may substitute for specific certifications.

  • Candidates should not self-select out if they do not meet all of these qualifications.

Your Success at SHI

People who are successful in this role tend to demonstrate:

  • Strong ownership of a multi-discipline services organization, connecting technical direction, employee experience, change leadership, and business performance.

  • The ability to connect collaboration, workplace platforms, secure access, and change management into practical solutions that clients can adopt and operate.

  • A talent development mindset that grows managers and practice leaders into confident, accountable leaders.

  • Comfort using portfolio, delivery, adoption, and customer data to guide staffing, coaching, investment, and escalation decisions.

  • Strong collaboration across Solution Architecture, Delivery, Project Management, AI + Infrastructure, Managed Services, Sales, and Microsoft.

  • A genuine commitment to customer experience, delivery quality, employee adoption, security, and the long-term growth of SHI's Microsoft Services practice.

Other Requirements

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with executives, managers, technical leaders, sales teams, and customer stakeholders.

  • Ability to travel to support client engagements, Microsoft alignment, leadership meetings, and internal enablement, up to 25%.

  • Commitment to continuous learning as Microsoft workplace, Copilot, identity, endpoint, security, and employee experience capabilities evolve.

  • Strong ethical standards with disciplined attention to privacy, governance, compliance, security, and responsible AI.

Kinetic is the global market leader in enterprise software for student housing, residence life, conferencing, events, and campus operations. We've been doing this since 1998. More than 350 institutions across the world run on our platform. We are trusted, proven, and battle-tested at scale.

And yet, in the United States, most residence life and housing teams have never heard of us.

That's the opportunity.

There are only two vendors in the world capable of handling the deep, complex operational demands of large-scale student housing at the enterprise level. We are one of them. This role is about closing. Once you close, you hand over to a dedicated customer delivery and success team who take ownership of the relationship — so you can stay focused on hunting. But make no mistake: the partnerships you create are permanent. Kinetic is part of Volaris Group and Constellation Software, a buy-and-hold acquirer — we will never be sold. The institutions that choose us are choosing a partner that will be there for the long haul, investing in their success year after year. What you win, we keep — and we build on — forever.

If you're a top-tier new logo closer who wants to do meaningful work — not just hit a number — this role was built for you.

Who We Are

Kinetic is part of Volaris Group, a division of Constellation Software Inc. — one of the largest software companies in the world. Constellation is a buy-and-hold acquirer. We are never sold. We grow, we invest, and we build for the long term alongside other global market leaders in education technology and beyond.

We are a high-performance business — and we mean that in the truest sense. Not pressure for its own sake, but a thriving environment where everyone is pushing forward together, challenging each other, and delivering for colleagues and customers alike. We span multiple countries. We don't do silos.

We ask, we listen, and we work to understand what's holding them back — and then we help remove their barriers. That's the culture we bring to every relationship, internal and external.

We also believe in having fun. Genuinely. A thriving business is an enjoyable one, and we work hard to make sure this is a place people love to be.

Our values are leadership, community, student success, and the KxFactor. The KxFactor is the hardest of those to define — and perhaps the most important. Hello potential future Oatly employee. It’s us, the original oatmilk company that started in Sweden back 25 or so years ago and has since expanded to the U.S. where we’ve continued growing at a rate such that we need more brilliant minds to come work with us to keep the momentum going and the oatmilk flowing.

Sustainability, health, and transparency are the core values that guide everything we do. Basically, we exist to help people live a healthier life without recklessly taxing the planet’s resources in the process, and to change the food system for the better. We drive that change through the power of oats and through a significant reduction in cow’s milk consumption. If any of this resonates with you, then maybe you’d like to work for Oatly, too. Now onto the formal stuff.

We are looking for a Demand Planner to join our team. This role will be responsible for delivering accurate demand forecasts for the North American markets to ensure optimal product availability and efficient supply chain operations. The role is critical in balancing customer service levels, inventory levels, and business objectives within a fast paced CPG environment at Oatly. The demand planner is also responsible for analyzing market trends and providing key inputs to the market commercial review as part of the monthly integrated business planning cycle as well as ensuring efficient coordination between market and central supply chain functions.

Here are the things we want to hire you to do:

Demand Forecasting and Analysis:

  • Develop and maintain short-, medium-, and long-term demand forecasts using statistical models and market intelligence

  • Analyze historical sales data, market trends, and promotional plans to improve forecast accuracy

  • Host consensus meetings monthly to align commercial input such as promotional and seasonal factors as well as new listings and new product introductions

  • Support in preparation for the Commercial Review as part of the monthly IBP process

Collaboration & Communication:

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Finance to incorporate business insights into demand planning

  • Lead the monthly demand review meetings as part of the market commercial review within the company’s S&OP/IBP process

  • Work closely with central logistics, planning and fulfillment teams to ensure smooth E-2-E supply chain operations towards markets

  • Provide actionable insights & recommendations to the management team as a key stakeholder within the local commercial review

Systems & Tools

  • Utilize and evolve advanced analytics (Anaplan/BI) to enhance planning accuracy and decision-making

  • Responsible for monitoring & improving market specific KPI´s and reports such as sales forecast accuracy/bias and overall supply & delivery performance

  • Ensure data integrity and maintain master data for forecasting systems

Here are the things we think you need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business Administration or a related field preferred

  • 2-3 years of supply chain experience in either Anaplan or other advanced planning solutions

  • Collaborative with a passion for cross-functional teamwork within different parts of the organization

  • Deep understanding of the corporate mission and strategic objectives

  • Agile and adaptable, able to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

  • Results-oriented with a focus on delivering value and achieving business objectives

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels within the market

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and provide actionable insights

  • Proficiency in planning and forecasting software, ERP systems, and advanced analytics tools

  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities

  • Strategic thinker with a problem-solving mindset and attention to detail

And here’s another list of qualities we think make a good Oatly team member:

  • You feel connected to our mission of encouraging health, sustainability, and transparency

  • You are a self-starter who doesn’t need direct supervision to motivate you for success – we believe strongly in building a culture of individual accountability and ownership and need partners that can embrace that mentality

  • You are ready to make your mark in a smaller, growing brand leveraging your experience to deliver amazing results and build an outstanding company

  • You have an entrepreneurial spirit in that you’re comfortable with ambiguity and are energized by the process of building something lasting from the ground up

  • You enjoy sharing your quirkiness and talents with your coworkers

Another bulleted list felt a bit too…bullet-y. So we wrote this long, awkward sentence to let you know all the ways we sweeten the deal when you work with us, like flexible vacation (take it when you need it), really great benefits (yes, pet insurance is in there), paid volunteer days off throughout the year (doing good is fun), free six packs of...(drumroll)…oatmilk, and you’ll also get genuinely great coworkers who are rooting for each other and the company to thrive. Oh, one more short but very important sentence: We are nimble and agile (not chaotic) in how we work, and we’re grounded in a long company history dating way back to the last century.

The salary for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to geographic location, internal equity, experience, education, specialty, and training. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. Compensation may also include bonus, commission, or equity as applicable. Our good faith estimate for base salary is $100,000.

jobs.description:
The Manager, Information Security Assurance Services is responsible for leading the design, build, and continuous maturation of the program. This role requires a proven track record of establishing and scaling information security assurance capabilities, including control frameworks, regulatory compliance, and audit readiness, information security awareness, policy governance, third-party risk management, and Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards (PCI DSS).
This leader will oversee a team accountable for executing and evolving assurance processes, with a clear mandate to drive automation, standardization, and gain operational efficiency across all Assurance Services products and services. The role partners closely with business, technology, and regulatory stakeholders to ensure controls are effectively implemented, measured, and aligned to organizational risk tolerance and regulatory requirements.
The ideal candidate brings demonstrated experience building GRC programs from the ground up and advancing them to a mature, technology-enabled function, leveraging automation, integrated tooling, and data-driven insights to reduce manual effort, improve control effectiveness, and enhance transparency. This role will be responsible for executing the strategic direction, establish scalable processes, and ensure the team delivers consistent, high-quality outcomes that strengthen the organization’s overall security posture and resilience.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Program leadership across assurance domains —Lead and continuously mature governance, controls design and testing, audit and regulatory response, security awareness, policy governance, third-party/vendor risk management (TPRM), and the PCI DSS program, with full accountability for adherence to established controls, policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Hands-on subject matter expertise — Serve as the team's go-to expert across information security assurance disciplines. Step in as an active contributor on control narratives, audit walkthroughs, regulator engagements, and remediation plans when program needs demand it.
  • Control framework ownership — Build, maintain, and continuously improve the control framework, ensuring alignment with NYDFS Part 500, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls, HIPAA, FDIC, PCI DSS v4.x, and other applicable standards. Maintain control libraries, control-to-framework mappings, and a defensible evidence model.
  • Audit and regulatory response — Direct the end-to-end response to internal audits, external audits, regulatory examinations, and PCI engagements. Personally review high-risk responses, evidence packages, and management responses prior to submission.
  • PCI DSS program oversight — Provide senior oversight and governance of the PCI DSS v4.x program, including scope validation, strategy, control implementation, ISA coordination, AOC/ROC readiness, compensating controls, and establish a clear multi-year roadmap to support enterprise goals.
  • Third-party risk management — Mature the TPRM program including inherent risk tiering, due diligence depth-of-review, contractual security requirements, ongoing monitoring, fourth-party visibility, and concentration risk reporting.
  • Policy governance — Own the enterprise information security policy governance (policies, standards, procedures, guidelines), including a defined lifecycle, exception management, ownership accountability, and executive committee approval cadence.
  • Security awareness — Direct the strategy, content, and measurement of the enterprise information security awareness program, including annual training, role-based training, phishing simulations, and Cybersecurity Awareness Month (CSAM) campaigns and activities.
  • Executive translation and stakeholder partnership — Translate strategic priorities, regulatory expectations, and informal executive conversations into structured roadmaps, OKRs, deliverables, sprint commitments, and team execution plans. Partner with business, technology, regulatory stakeholders, and third parties to communicate complex issues, drive alignment on contentious topics, and advocate for business-aligned outcomes.
  • People leadership and talent development — Manage, coach, and develop a multi-disciplinary team of assurance professionals. Set clear expectations, establish accountability, conduct performance management, and build a high-performing and high-trust team.
  • Continuous improvement and automation — Drive process maturity, automation of evidence collection and control testing, improved reporting routines, reduced manual effort, and effective use and management of GRC/IRM platforms (e.g., ServiceNow IRM) to scale the program and sustain operations.
  • Metrics and reporting — Define and operationalize KPIs/KRIs across each assurance domain. Deliver board-ready and executive-ready dashboards, and narrative reporting that articulate program health and remediation trajectory.
  • Decision-making and influence — Make and own operational and strategic decisions with significant impact to program effectiveness, and guide senior leaders through informed recommendations, best practices, and trade-off discussions.

Required Job Qualifications

Required Experience:

  • Minimum 10 years of progressive experience across GRC, information security, technology risk, internal/external audit, controls, cybersecurity assurance, or closely related disciplines.
  • Minimum 5 years of direct people leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, workforce planning, and talent development.
  • Demonstrated experience operating within or directly supporting PCI DSS environments, including scope definition, control design, testing, remediation, evidence management, and QSA/ISA interaction.
  • Strong working knowledge of governance and control frameworks including NYDFS Part 500, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls, and PCI DSS, with the ability to design and defend control rationale to auditors and regulators.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, testing, and remediating IT general controls (ITGCs) and application-level controls.
  • Proven ability to communicate complex risk and control topics clearly to executive audiences, audit committees, regulators, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Ability to operate independently under limited direction, prioritize competing demands, and consistently deliver results in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience implementing or operating ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM) or comparable GRC platforms (e.g., Archer, AuditBoard, OneTrust, MetricStream).
  • Experience operating within a Product Operating Model, including roadmap planning, backlog grooming, sprint-based delivery, feature commitment management, and metrics-driven execution.
  • Experience in financial services, banking, or other highly regulated industries, including direct interaction with regulators such as state banking authorities, the OCC, FDIC, or NYDFS.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, CRISC, CGEIT, or CIA.
  • Demonstrated success improving control automation, continuous control monitoring, assurance testing efficiency, audit-readiness practices, and evidence-as-code approaches.

Other Critical Factors

Skills:

  • Strategic ownership — Sets multi-year vision for the assurance portfolio; does not wait for direction to identify gaps or propose roadmaps.
  • Executive presence — Comfortable engaging directly with the CISO, CIO, General Counsel, Chief Risk Officer, business unit leaders, audit committee members, and external regulators. Presents findings with confidence and influences decisions without escalation dependence.
  • Decision ownership — Makes defensible decisions on control design, risk acceptance recommendations, exception treatment, and resource allocation. Documents rationale and owns outcomes.
  • Talent multiplier — Develops individual contributors into the next generation of assurance leaders through structured coaching, stretch assignments, and clear feedback.
  • Outcome bias — Holds the team accountable to measurable outcomes (audit results, exemption rates, control coverage, completion velocity), not activity.
  • Hands-on when needed — Models the way. Willing to personally write the control narrative, sit through the examiner walkthrough, or draft the board bullet when the situation requires senior-level execution.

The GTM Strategy & Operations team for Splunk is the strategic engine behind Splunk's go-to-market motion, partnering directly with the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) organization to shape sales strategy, planning, and executive decision-making. We translate market dynamics, business performance, and sales data into the frameworks and recommendations that guide how Splunk goes to market.

The team operates at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and operations - developing GTM frameworks, running independent analyses, and delivering executive-ready recommendations that directly influence CRO-level priorities and investment decisions.

Our team members are trusted advisors to senior leadership: independent, analytically rigorous, and comfortable owning ambiguous problems end-to-end. We value clear thinking, sharp executive communication, and a collaborative approach to solving cross-functional business challenges.

Your Impact

As the Strategy & Planning Lead on the GTM Strategy & Operations team, you will lead strategic projects supporting Splunk's CRO organization largely independently, with light guidance from your manager. You will build direct, trusted relationships with senior executives, translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, and develop the GTM frameworks that shape strategic decisions across the sales organization.

You bring strong analytical rigor, executive presence, and a track record of owning complex strategic work from framing through recommendation - and you're comfortable moving between deep quantitative analysis and polished executive storytelling.

● Independently lead strategic GTM projects end-to-end - from problem framing and analysis through executive-ready recommendations - requiring minimal day-to-day direction.

● Build and manage relationships with senior executives and cross-functional leaders, serving as a trusted strategic partner to the CRO organization.

● Develop and apply GTM frameworks and models to evaluate market opportunities, sales strategy options, and business performance.

● Conduct deep quantitative and qualitative analyses, synthesizing sales, pipeline, and business data into clear, actionable executive insights.

● Build and deliver polished, executive-ready presentations and business models (Excel, PowerPoint) for CRO and senior leadership reviews.

● Partner cross-functionally with sales, marketing, finance, product, and, operations to align GTM priorities and drive execution against strategic plans.

● Own analysis, reporting, and materials for recurring strategic planning cycles and executive business reviews.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution, or a minimum of 4 years of professional work experience.
  • Minimum of 7 years of professional experience in Global Transformation Management (GTM) strategy, business operations, sales operations, strategic planning, or management consulting.
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on professional experience using Microsoft Excel to build financial or business models, and Microsoft PowerPoint to create slide decks delivered to leadership.
  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience leading cross-functional strategic projects from initial scoping to final deliverable presentation.
  • Minimum of 2 years of professional experience delivering verbal presentations or written communications and reports directly to vice-president-level leadership or corporate officers.
  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience performing quantitative data analysis and translating data sets into strategic recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Possession of an advanced degree (such as an MBA) from an accredited institution.
  • Experience utilizing SQL, Salesforce (SFDC), and/or Tableau for data extraction and analysis.
  • Experience developing Global Transformation Management (GTM) or strategic planning frameworks used to guide executive decision-making.
  • Prior professional background in management consulting, corporate strategy, or sales/business operations.
  • Professional experience managing stakeholder relationships at the C-suite or executive level.
  • Familiarity with enterprise B2B software business models, sales motions, or Cisco/Splunk GTM frameworks.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
