Account Executive – Digital Marketing Sales & Closing | GoHighLevel | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Time (ET) Business Hours
Industry: Digital Marketing Agency

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients, a digital marketing agency serving U.S.-based businesses, is hiring an experienced Account Executive to manage the sales process from the first conversation through close.

This is a consultative sales role, not a scripted sales position. You’ll engage inbound leads, conduct discovery calls, uncover business challenges, recommend relevant digital marketing solutions, handle objections, negotiate, and take full ownership of qualified opportunities through closing.

You’ll also manage your pipeline directly in GoHighLevel (GHL), maintaining accurate records and consistent follow-up so qualified opportunities continue progressing.

If you’re a confident closer who understands how to lead discovery conversations, identify real business pain points, and turn inbound interest into new clients, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Inbound Sales & Lead Qualification

  • Respond promptly to inbound leads across phone, email, and other channels
  • Qualify prospects based on their needs, challenges, and fit
  • Conduct structured discovery and sales calls
  • Ask effective questions to uncover:
    • Business goals
    • Current challenges
    • Marketing pain points
    • Growth priorities
  • Understand what prospects are trying to accomplish before recommending a solution
  • Determine which opportunities should progress through the sales process
  • Maintain a professional and responsive experience from the first interaction

Consultative Selling & Closing

  • Lead consultative sales conversations rather than relying on rigid scripts
  • Recommend appropriate digital marketing solutions based on prospect requirements
  • Clearly communicate the value of services including:
    • SEO
    • Paid advertising
    • Web development
    • Related digital marketing solutions
  • Handle objections confidently and professionally
  • Navigate negotiations with qualified prospects
  • Maintain momentum throughout the sales process
  • Take ownership of opportunities through final close
  • Help prospects understand how proposed solutions address their specific business challenges

Pipeline Management

  • Own opportunities from initial contact through close
  • Maintain consistent follow-up with active prospects
  • Identify stalled opportunities and determine appropriate next steps
  • Re-engage prospects when appropriate
  • Prioritize leads based on:
    • Urgency
    • Fit
    • Sales readiness
    • Likelihood to close
  • Maintain visibility into upcoming follow-ups and active opportunities
  • Ensure qualified prospects do not fall through the cracks
  • Consistently move opportunities toward a clear outcome

GoHighLevel CRM Management

  • Manage the sales pipeline in GoHighLevel (GHL)
  • Maintain accurate:
    • Lead information
    • Contact notes
    • Sales activities
    • Follow-up tasks
    • Pipeline stages
  • Track conversations and next steps
  • Keep CRM records current after prospect interactions
  • Maintain accurate sales activity and pipeline reporting
  • Use GHL consistently as the source of truth for sales opportunities
  • Ensure no qualified opportunity is overlooked due to incomplete CRM management

Client Communication

  • Build strong relationships with prospective clients
  • Communicate confidently with U.S.-based business owners and decision-makers
  • Clearly explain digital marketing services in business-focused language
  • Understand prospect concerns and respond with relevant solutions
  • Build credibility throughout the sales process
  • Maintain professional communication across calls, email, and follow-ups
  • Create a strong prospective-client experience from discovery through close

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in inbound sales, business development, account executive, or a similar closing role
  • Proven experience conducting consultative sales conversations
  • Demonstrated ability to close qualified opportunities
  • Experience handling objections and negotiations
  • Hands-on GoHighLevel (GHL) experience – required
  • Strong discovery and qualification skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills
  • Ability to independently manage a sales pipeline
  • Comfortable communicating with business owners and decision-makers
  • Comfortable working remotely in a fast-paced sales environment
  • Ability to take ownership of opportunities without constant supervision
  • Availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

Ideal Experience & Skills

  • Experience selling digital marketing services
  • Previous experience selling:
    • SEO
    • Paid advertising
    • Web development
    • Related marketing services
  • Experience working for a digital marketing agency
  • Experience selling to U.S.-based businesses
  • Experience managing inbound leads from multiple channels
  • Strong understanding of agency-style consultative sales
  • Experience managing opportunities from discovery through negotiation and close

Tools & Technology

GoHighLevel (GHL) | CRM & Pipeline Management | Phone | Email | Digital Communication Tools | Sales Reporting & Follow-Up Systems

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are a confident salesperson who knows how to lead a conversation and close
  • Prefer consultative selling over reading from a rigid script
  • Know how to ask strong discovery questions
  • Can uncover the business problem behind a prospect’s initial inquiry
  • Understand how to connect client pain points with relevant solutions
  • Are comfortable handling objections and negotiations
  • Communicate confidently with U.S.-based business owners
  • Are persistent with follow-up without losing professionalism
  • Take full ownership of your pipeline
  • Keep your CRM organized and up to date
  • Can manage multiple active opportunities independently
  • Are motivated by measurable sales results

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing new inbound leads and pipeline priorities in GoHighLevel, followed by responding to prospects who have recently expressed interest.

Throughout the day, you’ll conduct discovery and sales calls, qualify prospects, uncover business challenges, and recommend appropriate digital marketing solutions.

You’ll also follow up with active and stalled opportunities, handle objections, negotiate with qualified prospects, and update GHL with accurate notes, activities, and next steps.

In short: you turn inbound interest into qualified opportunities and guide prospects through a consultative sales process from discovery to close.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Speed and consistency of inbound lead response
  • Qualified opportunities generated
  • Discovery calls completed
  • Lead-to-opportunity conversion rate
  • Opportunity-to-close conversion rate
  • Closed deals and sales performance
  • Consistent follow-up across active opportunities
  • Pipeline progression and deal velocity
  • Accurate and current GHL records
  • Effective re-engagement of stalled prospects
  • Strong objection handling and negotiation
  • Consistent achievement of sales targets

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Focus on inbound opportunities rather than purely cold outbound prospecting
  • Full ownership of opportunities from discovery through close
  • Consultative sales environment rather than rigid scripted selling
  • Sell digital marketing solutions to U.S.-based businesses
  • Hands-on use of GoHighLevel
  • Exposure to SEO, paid advertising, and web development services
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Account Executive
    • Senior Sales Executive
    • Sales Team Lead
    • Sales Manager
    • Business Development Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Initial Screening with Pavago
  4. Client Interview
  5. Final Selection & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Account Executive or Sales Closer with strong consultative selling skills and hands-on GoHighLevel (GHL) experience, we’d love to hear from you.

If you also have experience selling SEO, paid advertising, web development, or other digital marketing services to U.S.-based businesses, you’ll be especially well positioned for this opportunity.

jobs.excerpt: About vidIQvidIQ builds software to help YouTube creators achieve their goals.
jobs.description:
About vidIQ

vidIQ builds software to help YouTube creators achieve their goals. Our mission is to advance the creator's journey with actionable data-driven insights and AI-powered tools. We are dedicated to our values of being creator-obsessed, lean and fast, and scientific. Having already supported millions of creators, we invite stunning new co-workers to join us in reaching millions more.

Imagine a product that reached over a million users without a traditional sales team. This product stands at the forefront of career evolution, where everyone can be their own brand with unlimited growth potential. That's the opportunity at vidIQ—an infinite market, a large and highly engaged customer base, and the chance to help scale the platform that delivers insights to millions of creators.

Discover more about vidIQ firsthand at www.vidiq.com.

About the Team

Our vision is to build a personal copilot for every YouTube creator. We work in small, focused teams where people are expected to understand the problem, make decisions, and take ownership of the outcome.

We value people who are strong in their craft, communicate clearly, challenge ideas with respect, and follow through from problem to production.

We’re also an AI-native team. We build AI into our product and use it every day in how we work—from writing and reviewing code to debugging, testing, prototyping, and exploring new ideas.

About the role

vidIQ meets creators where they are, through a web app, mobile apps, and browser extensions. Our frontend is built with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind. We use a range of AI models to power creator-facing features such as ideation, metadata generation, and content insights.

This is a frontend-leaning role, but you won't stop at the frontend. You'll own entire product surfaces from end to end: the UI, the APIs behind it, the data it depends on, and how it performs in production. We expect you to understand the problem, decide what to build, and ship it.

You'll shape how millions of creators experience vidIQ, and you'll help define how our engineering team builds software now that AI is a real collaborator.

This is a remote position open to candidates worldwide. Employment classification and engagement structure will be determined based on location, legal requirements, and mutual fit.

What you will do:

  • Own product surfaces end to end. You'll be the go-to owner for key parts of vidIQ, we serve over 1M daily active creators. You'll set their direction, track how they perform, and decide what to improve next.

  • Work across the stack. You'll build and change backend APIs, services, and data flows when a feature needs it, instead of waiting on another team.

  • Drive your own roadmap. You'll spot opportunities in user feedback, data, and the codebase, turn them into proposals, align with product and design, and deliver without needing to be managed closely.

  • Modernize the frontend. You'll lead the refactor of key features from JavaScript to TypeScript to improve performance and maintainability, using AI-assisted tooling where it speeds up the work without lowering the bar for quality.

  • Build AI-powered product experiences. You'll ship LLM-driven features across the stack, from model integration and prompts on the backend to streaming responses, error handling, and clear UX when model output is unpredictable.

  • Fix architecture and performance problems. You'll find bottlenecks and weaknesses anywhere in the request path, frontend or backend, and leave the system better than you found it.

  • Make AI part of how the team works. You'll use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot every day, share what works, and help set team practices for using AI responsibly.

  • Improve durability. You'll test important workflows, add useful monitoring and error reporting, and own what you ship after it's live, whether you wrote every line or reviewed and refined AI-generated code.

  • Raise the bar through review and mentorship. You'll review code from other engineers, AI-assisted or not, and give feedback that helps others grow.

Requirements

  • About You

    • You have at least 5 years of professional software development experience.

    • You're strongest on the frontend, but you're comfortable on the backend. You can design an API, write server-side code, work with databases, and debug problems that cross the client-server boundary.

    • You're self-driven. You don't need a detailed spec to get started, and you're happy making decisions, asking the right questions, and moving work forward on your own.

    • You act like an owner. When something you're responsible for breaks, underperforms, or confuses users, you notice and fix it before anyone asks.

    • You've led projects from concept to completion, including documenting the work and teaching others about it.

    • You care about product quality and leave codebases in better shape than you found them.

    • You write and speak clearly, and you can explain technical concepts to non-technical people.

    • You're confident with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vite, and Tailwind.

    • You're a heavy, thoughtful user of AI tools. AI coding assistants and agents are part of how you plan, build, debug, test, and review every day. You know where they save you hours and where they fail, and you check AI output as carefully as you'd check a teammate's pull request.

    • You keep up with the fast-moving AI landscape and like trying new models, tools, and workflows.

Nice to have

  • Backend experience with , Scala, and/or Python, plus relational databases, caching, and queues

  • Experience with Redux, Redux Saga, and/or Zustand

  • Experience building LLM-powered features, such as streaming UIs, model APIs, prompt design, or evals

  • Experience with agentic coding workflows, such as running AI agents on multi-step tasks, writing custom rules or context files, or using MCP servers

Perks and Benefits

  • Work Remotely: Embrace the freedom to choose your ideal workspace anywhere in the world.

  • Flexible Time Off: We support a flexible vacation policy allowing you to take time off when you need to recharge.

  • Communication Stipend: Enjoy a monthly stipend to cover your phone and internet expenses, helping you stay connected effortlessly.

  • Global Impact: Join our diverse team that’s shaping the future of the creator economy across the globe.

  • Competitive Compensation: vidIQ believes in offering competitive compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and contributions. We ensure fairness through internal equity and geo-location based pay, with the upper range reserved for individuals demonstrating exceptional job knowledge and skills.

Our Commitment

At vidIQ, we dedicate ourselves to enabling creators of all kinds to succeed. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and fostering an environment that encourages collaboration, creativity, and personal growth. We are committed to building a company and a community where individuals thrive by being true to themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day.

If you share our enthusiasm for empowering creators, we would love to hear from you. Click the “Apply” button below to start your journey with us.

Plug & Play Systems

Remote Workforce

Winning Spirit

We bring a creative solutions mindset to problem-solving. No defeat, be optimistic. Pretty much everything is fixable, and most decisions are reversible.

Bunts & Singles

Give up on hitting Grand Slams with a billion dollar TAM. Narrow down the market to a specific customer that we can be the best at serving, and grow from there.

Our Thesis

There are intelligent entrepreneurs globally that are adept at identifying and building great software. Once these companies reach product-market-fit, it’s not uncommon for the company to grow beyond the founders’ core competencies.

By infusing capital and adding infrastructure, we can enable businesses to realize their full potential while continuing to scale the revenue profitably.

Our Focus

Outbound Performance & Client Success Lead – Cold Email | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Time Zone Overlap Required

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Outbound Performance & Client Success Lead to own client performance, retention, and cold email campaign success inside a fast-growing outbound agency.

This is not a passive account management role. You’ll manage 20–30 active client accounts and be directly accountable for ensuring campaigns are technically sound, reaching inboxes, generating qualified meetings, and continuously improving.

You’ll combine client success, cold email strategy, deliverability, copywriting, campaign optimization, and operations to drive measurable results.

If a campaign underperforms, you diagnose the problem and help fix it. If a client is at risk, you identify it early and take ownership.

What You’ll Own

Client Success & Retention

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for 20–30 active clients
  • Lead client check-ins, strategy calls, and performance reviews
  • Build strong relationships centered around measurable outcomes
  • Monitor account health and proactively identify churn risks
  • Step in early when performance or client satisfaction declines
  • Clearly communicate campaign results, deliverability health, pipeline impact, and optimization plans
  • Set realistic expectations and maintain alignment around results
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen and grow client accounts

Cold Email Performance & Optimization

  • Own campaign performance across assigned client accounts
  • Ensure campaigns are properly configured before launch, including:
    • Domains and inboxes
    • Deliverability setup
    • Targeting
    • Sequencing
    • Messaging
  • Monitor reply rates, inbox placement, sender reputation, and overall campaign health
  • Diagnose underperforming campaigns and identify root causes
  • Improve targeting, personalization, messaging, and conversion performance
  • Write and optimize cold email copy
  • Test subject lines, hooks, CTAs, offers, and sequences
  • Run structured experiments to improve replies, meetings booked, and pipeline generated
  • Focus on real business outcomes rather than vanity metrics

Deliverability & Outbound Infrastructure

  • Monitor inbox placement and deliverability health
  • Understand sender reputation, domain health, and outbound infrastructure
  • Identify technical issues affecting campaign performance
  • Troubleshoot deliverability problems independently where possible
  • Coordinate with outreach and technical teams when deeper infrastructure changes are needed
  • Ensure outbound campaigns follow strong deliverability practices

Systems, SOPs & Operational Scaling

  • Improve campaign delivery systems and operational workflows as the company scales
  • Maintain organized tracking for:
    • Client health
    • SLAs
    • Campaign performance
    • Retention
    • Risks and escalations
  • Build and improve internal SOPs, playbooks, and documentation
  • Create repeatable processes for campaign optimization and client management
  • Use AI and automation to improve reporting, workflows, and operational consistency
  • Identify inefficiencies and proactively implement improvements

Founder & Team Collaboration

  • Work directly with the founder and outbound team
  • Provide clear visibility into client health, campaign performance, risks, and retention trends
  • Surface potential problems before they escalate
  • Share optimization insights and operational recommendations
  • Coordinate with outreach and technical teams to resolve campaign issues
  • Support long-term client growth and operational scalability

Must-Have Experience & Skills

  • Experience managing client accounts within a cold email agency, outbound lead generation agency, or outbound-focused startup
  • Strong hands-on understanding of:
    • Cold email campaigns
    • Deliverability
    • Inbox placement
    • Sender reputation
    • Outbound infrastructure
  • Proven experience diagnosing and improving underperforming outbound campaigns
  • Strong cold email copywriting and messaging skills
  • Experience optimizing targeting, personalization, and sequences
  • Experience using outbound tools, automation platforms, CRMs, and reporting dashboards
  • Practical experience using AI tools to improve outbound workflows and operations
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Confidence communicating directly with clients, founders, and executives
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously
  • Availability during U.S. time zone overlap

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing 20+ client accounts simultaneously
  • Startup or high-growth agency experience
  • Experience creating SOPs, playbooks, and operational systems
  • Familiarity with deliverability monitoring tools
  • Experience supporting revenue-focused outbound programs
  • Familiarity with platforms such as Instantly, Smartlead, Clay, Apollo, HubSpot, Zapier, or Make

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership rather than waiting for direction
  • You understand both the technical and messaging sides of cold email
  • You can diagnose why a campaign is struggling and develop a clear solution
  • You stay calm and solution-focused when performance is under pressure
  • You communicate confidently with founders, executives, and clients
  • You care about qualified meetings, pipeline, and retention — not vanity metrics
  • You proactively identify problems before they become escalations
  • You thrive in fast-moving startup environments where systems continuously evolve

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by reviewing campaign metrics and inbox health across your client portfolio, identify accounts requiring optimization, and determine whether performance issues are coming from deliverability, targeting, messaging, or campaign setup.

From there, you might rewrite an underperforming sequence, lead client performance calls, coordinate campaign fixes with the outreach team, update client-health dashboards, and improve an internal SOP.

In short: you own campaign performance, client retention, and outbound delivery quality while helping build the systems that allow the business to scale.

  • Unique blend of client success, outbound strategy, cold email deliverability, and performance optimization
  • Direct impact on retention, pipeline, and revenue
  • Remote flexibility with long-term growth potential

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Spark Hire Video Interview
  3. Founder Interview

  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you understand cold email and outbound performance deeply, enjoy solving campaign problems, and can confidently take ownership of client relationships and retention, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help build outbound campaigns that consistently generate qualified opportunities while delivering an exceptional client experience.

Staff Cloud Architect

APPLICATIONS FROM OUTSIDE CANADA & THE US WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE

6 month contract

Company Overview

Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.
We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Staff Cloud Architect to lead the design and delivery of complex, multi-domain systems spanning cloud, data, and AI. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who can define technical strategy, own end-to-end architecture for major engagements, and provide technical leadership across teams.

In this role, you will work as a delivery-embedded technical leader on cross-functional teams, defining architecture across cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and AI/ML workloads. You’ll act as a technical escalation point on complex challenges, mentor mid-level engineers, partner with leadership on technical direction, and ensure systems are scalable, secure, and built to last.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Define technical strategy and lead architectural design across cloud, data, and AI/ML systems for end-to-end engagements
  • Architect scalable cloud-native solutions, including multi-cloud and hybrid strategies (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes)
  • Design data architectures including warehouses, data lakes, and pipelines for batch and streaming workloads (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Spark, Kafka)
  • Design AI/ML systems including model serving, MLOps pipelines, feature stores, and LLM-based applications (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, MLflow, Hugging Face)
  • Define infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and DevOps standards across engagements (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions)
  • Drive performance, scalability, cost, and reliability optimization across deployed systems
  • Ensure architecture meets security, governance, and compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Lead cloud migrations and platform modernization initiatives
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude, Cursor, and other modern AI assistants to ship higher-quality work at pace

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with leadership and clients on technical direction, translating business goals into architectural decisions
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders alike
  • Engage closely with engineering, data, AI, and product teams to align architecture with broader business priorities
  • Develop and maintain architecture documentation, standards, and guidelines

Leadership & Influence

  • Establish architectural standards and best practices that lift quality and consistency across the team
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, helping them grow their architectural thinking and craft
  • Act as a technical escalation point on complex architectural and integration challenges
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend tools, frameworks, and patterns that improve architecture over time

What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 3 years in architecture or technical leadership roles
  • Deep expertise in cloud platforms and cloud-native architectures (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Strong background in microservices, serverless, containers, and event-driven systems (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker, Lambda, EventBridge)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure as code and CI/CD (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, GitHub Actions)

  • Hands-on experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, dbt)
  • Strong experience designing AI/ML systems for production, including LLMs, MLOps, and model serving (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, MLflow, Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow)
  • Solid understanding of networking, security, identity, and access management in cloud environments
  • Experience with governance, compliance, and observability frameworks
  • Strong software engineering skills (Python, APIs, containerization)
  • Demonstrated leadership and technical mentoring experience
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate technical depth across audiences
  • Demonstrable usage of AI-forward tools such as Claude and Cursor
  • Multi-cloud architecture experience, AI ethics or responsible AI experience, or enterprise architecture certifications (e.g., TOGAF, AWS/Azure/GCP) is a plus

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.

  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.

  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

jobs.excerpt: A DAY IN THE LIFE As a Lead Engineer – Instrumentation & Controls within the Gas Power Generation Team, you will serve as the subject matter expert for instrumentation and controls design for the gas plant (reciprocating engines and gas turbines) and associated Balance of Plant (BOP) Systems and Equipment.
jobs.description:
A DAY IN THE LIFE

As a Lead Engineer – Instrumentation & Controls within the Gas Power Generation Team, you will serve as the subject matter expert for instrumentation and controls design for the gas plant (reciprocating engines and gas turbines) and associated Balance of Plant (BOP) Systems and Equipment. A typical day involves developing or reviewing instrumentation and controls design, collaborating with OEM and Owners on design, designing controls for BOP systems, and mentoring junior engineers. You will collaborate with internal project teams, utilities, vendors, and third-party engineering firms to deliver instrumentation and controls designs that are safe, reliable, and compliant with company, state, and federal regulations.

The Lead Engineer – Instrumentation & Controls will develop metrics and set objectives related to equipment protection and controls engineering obligations.

STEP INTO THE ROLE

  • Understand client design criteria and intent, and determine how clients and the energy market are evolving on design trends, philosophy, and criteria on gas generation plant design.
  • Will travel to Client office and/or project sites as required to foster client relationships, idea propagation, and problem solving.
  • Travel will increase for construction and commissioning evolutions.
  • Root cause analysis support for Engineering and Instrumentation and Controls items of the Company.
  • Ensures safety standards are adhered to for the gas generation Engineering program and Company by verifying equipment controls and protection are implemented per design and employing Management of Change (MOC) as needed.
  • Ensures projects are implemented in compliance with all applicable and prudent industry standards, including those provisions specific to reciprocating engine and combustion turbine installations and fuel gas systems.
  • Verifies the design basis for all power block instrumentation and controls via commissioning processes and documentation. Supports development of commissioning processes and documentation.
  • Collaborates and ensures integration with Blattner Business Units responsible for electrical design and commissioning. This includes protection and generation control, generator step-up and auxiliary transformers, medium voltage switchgear and collection, generator protection and synchronizing, station service and emergency power, grounding and lightning protection, cable and raceway systems, and lighting.
  • Reviews electrical interface design for balance of plant equipment, including fuel gas conditioning and compression, inlet air and filtration systems, lube oil and cooling systems, water treatment, emissions control equipment, fire protection and detection, and plant control system integration.
  • Stays current on new technologies and industry practices. Seeks opportunities to add value to projects with application of best available technology for specific projects.
  • Supports creation and maintenance of library of design basis documents for all segments within Company. Must ensure Managers of Procurement are current with design basis for client and scope of work prior to kick-off meeting of estimating new project.
  • Be an available technical resource to support engineering leads review of owner, contractor, and company scopes for completeness, and note gaps or overlaps, with particular attention to the interface points between the generating equipment supplier, balance of plant vendors, and company scope.
  • Supports constructability reviews of engine and turbine power block layouts, modular and skid-mounted equipment, and pre-assembled cable and conduit systems to reduce field labor and improve installation quality.
  • Supports the onsite instrumentation and controls requirements of plant startup, first fire, synchronization, and performance testing, and ensures commissioning requirements are understood and adhered to. Reviews all commissioning documents.
  • Verifies complete equipment protection and controls for power block and BOP.
  • Acts as the escalation point for instrumentation and controls commissioning issues, including protection and control settings, monitoring systems, controls testing, and controller interfaces.
  • Preliminary engineering to final review of design, installation, and commissioning for power generation block and BOP instrumentation and controls.
  • Review design for redundancy of instrumentation, controls hardware, and logic design
  • Review winterization for instrumentation and control devices
  • Review Control Loop Diagrams
  • Review Instrument Loop Diagrams
  • Review Controls narratives and logic
  • Owner of all controller communication protocol and interface implementation, including distributed control system (DCS) at power block level and OEM controllers.
  • Verification of data historian configuration and representation of available data points, including internally configured points. This includes ensuring DCS provides points for historian.
  • Mentors junior engineers and supports the development of internal Instrumentation and Controls engineering standards and design practices.
  • Reads and understands the instrumentation and controls scope of projects in early project phases. Develops plans incorporating redundancy, reliability, and cost efficiency into each proposal.
  • Works with internal and external stakeholders to develop a clear and concise instrumentation and controls scope of work. Reviews implications of changes, provides recommendations, and serves as a technical resource for Preconstruction and Operations teams throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Provides contract and subcontract review, including suppliers, and comments related to instrumentation and controls scope, and identifies opportunities for streamlining work and reducing waste.
  • Adheres to the company’s cultural basics and the National Society of Professional Engineer’s code of conduct. Must prioritize ‘We’ over ‘Me.’
  • Position is estimated to require travel up to 25% of the time pre-construction and 70% during construction to project sites, client offices, and utility offices, subject to fluctuations as needs dictate.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • 10+ years of progressive engineering experience in instrumentation and controls design for industrial projects, with strong preference for power generation.
  • 5+ years experience with instrumentation/controls/communications specification, procurement, install, and commissioning.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, or related field, from an ABET-accredited college required, or relevant equivalent industry experience.
  • A Professional Engineering (PE) license is preferred but not required.

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Knowledge of reciprocating engine and gas turbine equipment and the associated balance of plant equipment and their applications.
  • Knowledge of multiple communication protocols and integration of same – MODBUS, Profi-Bus, Foundation Field-Bus, etc.
  • Familiarity with computer tools/programs used for instrumentation and controls programming and commissioning of BOP equipment – communications protocols, vibrations monitoring, instrumentation programming and calibration, transformer monitoring.
  • Familiarity with Continuous Emissions Monitoring Systems (CEMS) specifications, regulatory protocols, equipment, commissioning, and certification.
  • Familiarity with Emissions Control Systems – primarily Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) specifications, regulatory requirements, equipment, controls design, commissioning, and safety compliance.
  • Familiarity with engineering standards/best practices related to power generation.
  • Interpersonal skills – ability to influence and persuade groups toward common objectives.
  • Effective communication skills (oral, written, listening, presentation) to work with owners, vendors, and employees.

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

  • Competitive pay

  • 100% employer paid HDHP insurance premiums for employees

  • 401(k) with company match

  • HSA and FSA options

  • Dental and Vision insurance

  • Education Assistance (Tuition Reimbursement)

  • Work/Life balance

  • Employee/Family focused culture

  • Gym on site

  • And more!

$121,680.00 - $176,436.00 Individual Compensation to be determined based on the applicant's applicable experience and qualifications balanced against internal equity.

With more than 115 years of construction experience, Blattner has played a vital role in building America’s critical infrastructure, ranging from railroads and highways to dams and mines. Since 1997, the company has focused on renewable energy solutions and is responsible for some of the most significant solar, wind and storage projects in the U.S. Today, Blattner has installed over 20% of America’s utility-scale wind, solar and energy storage capacity. jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is looking for a Senior Technical Lead – IAM Data Integration and Migration who will will oversee the existing Identity and Access Management (IAM) data environment while leading the planning, engineering, validation, and migration of identity data to a modern IAM solution. This role ensures that identity, account, role, entitlement, policy, and access data remains accurate, secure, and auditable throughout the migration life-cycle.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on expertise in data migration engineering, identity data analysis, database engineering, and security-minded architecture, with experience supporting AWS GovCloud, enterprise IAM modernization in federal or highly regulated environments, Oracle and DB2 environments, and legacy IBM IAM platforms.

What will you do:

IAM Migration Leadership

  • Lead the data migration strategy from the legacy IBM IAM solution to the new target IAM platform.
  • Develop and maintain the end-to-end data migration roadmap, including discovery, profiling, cleansing, mapping, transformation, test migration, validation, cutover, rollback, and post-migration support.
  • Define source-to-target mappings between IBM IAM data structures and new target data models.
  • Preserve identity-to-account, account-to-entitlement, group-to-role, role-to-policy, and user-to-access relationships throughout migration.
  • Design repeatable and auditable migration pipelines using SQL, scripting, ETL tools, APIs, or platform-native migration utilities.
  • Support integration with enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform components, including directory services, federation services, access management, authorization, and multi-factor authentication (MFA) solutions, as applicable.
  • Ensure migrated data supports authentication, authorization, federation, provisioning, governance, access reviews, and Zero Trust-aligned access control models.

Security, Compliance, and Data Protection

  • Ensure identity data is protected throughout extraction, staging, transformation, migration, and validation.
  • Support data retention, data storage, data encryption, and secure handling of sensitive identity data, including PII and privileged account information.
  • Align data migration and IAM modernization activities with federal and enterprise security requirements, including NIST, FISMA, FedRAMP, DISA STIG, Zero Trust, and agency-specific controls.

Technical Leadership and Project Execution

  • Oversee systems engineering and data engineering activities across multiple concurrent workstreams with strict deadlines.
  • Lead technical planning, cost/schedule input, execution planning, technical performance metrics, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Coordinate across IAM, database, cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, application, testing, and business teams.
  • Manage technical risks related to data loss, incorrect access assignments, migration defects, cutover timing, security exposure, and operational disruption.
  • Support Agile/Scrum teams by assessing how enhancements, defects, data issues, or migration requests impact the IAM architecture and downstream systems.
  • Communicate technical progress, risks, dependencies, and decision points clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Legacy IAM Operations and Data Oversight

  • Oversee engineering and operational support for the IBM IAM solution, including identity repositories, account data, entitlement data, access control data, and associated database platforms.
  • Support the stability, integrity, and efficient operation of existing IAM systems, data bases, directories, integrations, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Analyze existing identity data models, schemas, attributes, roles, groups, entitlements, privileged accounts, and access relationships.
  • Identify data quality issues, duplicate identities, orphaned accounts, inactive accounts, stale entitlements, missing attributes, and broken role or group mappings.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance
  • Bachelor’s Degree and 12 years of experience, or a High School diploma or equivalent and 16 years of experience
  • 10+ years supporting Information Technology in enterprise environments.
  • 7+ years hands-on with IBM products, Oracle products, and cloud-based products.
  • Training and certification (mandatory) in target IAM database products preferred, especially Oracle and DB2.
  • Strong technical knowledge of IT systems, IAM, and AWS GovCloud services.
  • Demonstrated experience with the planning, management, leadership, and coordination of multiple concurrent tasks with strict deadlines for large-scale, highly available systems integrated with business-critical platforms.
  • Demonstrated expertise in data encryption, data storage, and retention policies in secure federal environments.
  • Proven ability to perform complex technical tasks in a highly secure environment.
  • Strong understanding of software development, enhancement, and maintenance life-cycles.
  • Experience with agile/scrum methodologies.
  • Expert knowledge of recent advances in computer science and engineering.

Preferred Skills

  • Prior experience with federal IT programs, regulatory compliance, and federal acquisition documentation.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust Architecture principles, federal mandates (OMB M-22-09, EO 14028), and enterprise data governance and security frameworks (NIST, FISMA, FedRAMP).
  • Knowledge of cloud-native database and data warehousing technologies on AWS GovCloud.
  • Experience supporting ATO processes, System Security Plans (SSPs), and continuous monitoring activities.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

$146,000 - $234,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Job Description:

Own your opportunity to turn data into measurable outcomes for our customers’ most complex challenges. As a Data Architect Principal at GDIT, you’ll power innovation to drive mission impact and grow your expertise to power your career forward.

This role exists to design the infrastructure that turns new Partner data, as it lands in a multi-billion-record, multi-payer healthcare claims warehouse (the HFPP Trusted Third Party), into automated fraud, waste, and abuse (FWA) alerts.

You'll own the technical standards that infrastructure gets built and extended against, with real sign-off on the pipeline's architecture and technology choices, and you'll build the hardest parts of it yourself while working alongside a Data Engineer responsible for building and monitoring this pipeline.

Fraud-signal methodology stays with Data Science, and PII/PHI handling policy stays with a separate compliance function; your sign-off covers the pipeline architecture itself. You'll report through the analytic leadership and work alongside several technical and investigative teams.

HOW A DATA ARCHITECT PRINICPAL WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

  • Design the architecture for the event-driven pipeline that carries new Partner data from the HFPP warehouse into deployed fraud signals and out to Partner alerts: the data flow, the integration points with the warehouse and the HFPP Portal's analytics extension, and the AWS and Snowflake choices that hold it together.

  • Own sign-off on that architecture and any material change to it. If a new signal's requirements would strain the design, that decision runs through you.

  • Set the standards the pipeline is built to; how it absorbs a spike in Partner data, what happens when a signal's scoring job fails partway through, how a new signal gets onboarded without destabilizing the ones already live.

  • Build the hardest pieces yourself. Proof-of-concept integrations, the trickiest parts of the event-driven design, anything you don't want to hand off until the pattern's actually proven. This isn't a paper-architecture role.

  • Design within the data-security and PII/PHI constraints a separate compliance function sets for this claims data.

  • Work with Data Science on how an approved fraud signal's logic gets represented in the pipeline, and track the government review and approval cadence closely enough that the architecture can absorb new signals on schedule.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • 8+ years designing and owning production data architecture, including at least one event-driven or streaming pipeline you built and ran at real scale.

  • Deep hands-on experience with AWS and Snowflake, including designing event-driven ingestion patterns that reliably feed a warehouse-native scoring/analytics layer.

  • Strong Python and SQL, enough to build the pieces you design yourself rather than only diagram them.

  • Experience designing systems that operate under real data-security/compliance constraints (PII/PHI or comparable sensitive data), working with a separate security function rather than owning that policy.

  • A track record of setting or reviewing architecture standards other engineers are held to, including saying no to a design that misses the bar.

  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment with sign-off authority and no direct reports.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience with healthcare claims data or another highly regulated, high-scrutiny data domain.

  • Experience designing alerting/notification systems tied to a customer- or partner-facing portal.

  • Experience with fraud or anomaly-detection pipelines specifically, even outside healthcare.

  • Experience presenting architecture decisions to a government or compliance reviewer, such as a contracting officer's representative or an auditor.

At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

  • Experience working remotely.

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Senior Media Buyer to lead the strategy, execution, and optimization of paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts.

This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll own the full lifecycle of Facebook and Instagram (Meta) advertising campaigns—from campaign planning and creative strategy to optimization and scaling. You’ll collaborate with clients and internal teams to improve campaign performance, lower acquisition costs, and maximize return on ad spend (ROAS).

If you’re passionate about performance marketing, enjoy testing new ideas, and thrive on delivering measurable business results, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Campaign Strategy & Management

  • Build, launch, and manage Meta advertising campaigns from strategy through execution.
  • Manage multiple client accounts while ensuring each campaign achieves performance goals.
  • Optimize:
    • Campaign structures
    • Audiences
    • Placements
    • Bidding strategies
    • Budgets
  • Scale high-performing campaigns while maintaining profitability.

Performance Optimization

  • Monitor campaign performance daily.
  • Analyze key metrics including:
    • Cost Per Lead (CPL)
    • Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)
    • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
    • Click-Through Rate (CTR)
    • Cost Per Click (CPC)
    • Conversion Rate
  • Test:
    • New audiences
    • Offers
    • Ad creatives
    • Landing pages
    • Campaign strategies
  • Continuously optimize campaigns to improve lead quality and reduce acquisition costs.

Creative Strategy

Client Communication & Reporting

Growth & Innovation

  • Stay current with Meta platform updates and advertising best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and results.
  • Test new automation tools, optimization techniques, and advertising strategies.
  • Contribute ideas that improve agency performance and client outcomes.

What Success Looks Like

  • Campaigns consistently meet or exceed performance goals.
  • Advertising budgets scale profitably while maintaining strong ROAS.
  • Acquisition costs decrease through continuous optimization.
  • Clients receive strategic recommendations backed by data.
  • Creative testing drives measurable campaign improvements.
  • Client satisfaction and long-term retention remain high.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You combine creativity with strong analytical thinking.
  • You enjoy testing, learning, and optimizing campaigns.
  • You can confidently manage multiple client accounts simultaneously.
  • You make decisions based on data rather than assumptions.
  • You communicate campaign performance clearly to clients and internal teams.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment where ownership matters.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Meta (Facebook & Instagram) advertising campaigns.
  • Proven experience managing $10,000+ per month in advertising spend.
  • Experience managing five or more client accounts simultaneously.
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • Meta Ads Manager
    • Meta Business Manager
    • Meta Pixel
    • Conversion API (CAPI)
    • Event Tracking
  • Experience optimizing campaigns for:
    • Lead Generation
    • Customer Acquisition
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make optimization decisions.
  • Experience developing creative strategies and writing detailed creative briefs.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using:
    • GoHighLevel (GHL)
    • Close CRM
    • Similar CRM platforms
  • Experience working in a digital marketing agency.
  • Familiarity with:
    • Landing Page Optimization
    • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • Experience using AI tools to improve campaign performance and creative workflows.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients.

Tech Stack

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Meta Business Manager
  • Meta Pixel
  • Conversion API (CAPI)
  • GoHighLevel (GHL)
  • Close CRM
  • Google Analytics
  • Google Workspace
  • AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or similar)

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review campaign performance dashboards.
  • Monitor spend, ROAS, CPA, CPL, and conversion metrics.
  • Optimize audiences, creatives, placements, and bidding strategies.
  • Develop creative concepts and collaborate with designers.
  • Meet with clients to discuss campaign performance and recommendations.
  • Launch new campaigns and A/B tests.
  • Analyze results and implement optimization strategies.
  • Stay informed on Meta platform updates and emerging advertising trends.

In short: You’ll own the strategy, execution, optimization, and scaling of Meta advertising campaigns, helping clients achieve measurable business growth through data-driven paid social marketing.

  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Cost Per Acquisition (CPA).
  • Cost Per Lead (CPL).
  • Click-Through Rate (CTR).
  • Conversion Rate.
  • Client retention and satisfaction.
  • Campaign scalability and profitability.
  • Creative testing performance.

  • Lead high-impact Meta advertising campaigns for multiple client accounts.
  • Collaborate with clients and creative teams to deliver measurable business results.
  • Manage significant advertising budgets while driving continuous optimization.
  • Work with modern advertising tools and emerging AI technologies.
  • Fully remote work environment aligned with U.S. business hours.

    • Lead Media Buyer
    • Paid Media Manager
    • Performance Marketing Manager
    • Director of Paid Media

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating your experience across multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself and showcase your expertise in managing Meta advertising campaigns, optimizing performance, scaling ad spend, and improving ROAS across multiple client accounts. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

jobs.description:
Remote AI Automation Consultant (Contract/Freelance)

3rd Wave | Remote | Project-based

About the role

3rd Wave is a UK-based AI automation consultancy. We design and build AI agents and workflow automation for SMBs, connecting the systems they already use so information moves between them without manual effort.

We're building a pool of remote consultants to help deliver our pipeline of client projects. Work is project-based, so you'll pick up engagements that fit your skills and availability rather than committing to a single long-term role.

What you'll be doing

Every project is different, but the shape is consistent: you'll be integrating business systems (CRMs, job boards, document tools, spreadsheets, communication platforms) via APIs and browser automation, building orchestrated workflows, and layering in AI where it adds real value, always with a clear audit trail and a human able to stay in control.

Typical work includes:

  • Building automated workflows that connect two or more business systems end to end

  • Designing data pipelines that pull from external sources (APIs, scrapers, browser automation) and land clean, structured data somewhere useful

  • Building AI-assisted steps into a workflow (extraction, classification, drafting, summarisation) with human review built in

  • Producing clear handover documentation so non-technical clients can run and maintain what you've built

What we're looking for

We care more about how you think than which specific tools you've used. The common thread across our work is systems integration and automation, so you should be someone who genuinely enjoys wiring disparate tools together and making messy manual processes disappear.

You'll likely be a strong fit if you have:

  • Solid experience with a workflow automation platform (n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar) — n8n specifically is a big plus

  • Confidence working directly with REST APIs, webhooks, and authentication flows

  • Experience with no-code/low-code data platforms such as Airtable, Clay, or

  • A working understanding of how to bring AI into a workflow sensibly: prompting, extracting structured output, and knowing when a human needs to check the result

  • How to create one shot prompts for agent prompts

  • Comfort with browser automation tools (e.g. Apify, Airtop, or similar) for the sites and services that don't offer a clean API

  • Good diagnostic instincts — able to trace a broken pipeline back to its root cause rather than just patching symptoms

  • Clear written communication, since you'll often be producing documentation a non-technical client relies on

You don't need to tick every box above. We'd rather hear from someone with deep strength in a few of these than a shallow pass through all of them.

How we work

  • All projects are scoped in a detailed Statement of Work before work begins, so you'll always know the deliverables, timeline and assumptions upfront

  • Projects typically run 2 to 6 weeks, though some clients have longer multi-phase programmes

  • Remote and asynchronous by default, with discovery workshops and check-ins as needed

  • You'll usually be working directly with the client's team during discovery and testing phases, not just building in isolation

To apply

Tell us about a system integration or automation project you're proud of, what tools you used, and what made it hard.

Job Title: Georgian Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Video-Phone Interpreter

We Offer:

  • Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.

  • Interpreter support.

Position Overview:

The Georgian Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Georgian and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**

Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.

  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.

  • Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.

  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.

  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.

  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.

  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.

  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.

  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.

  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.

  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.

  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inGeorgian and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.

  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.

  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.

  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.

  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.

  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

jobs.description:
The role is about:

The Gateway Related Projects team is committed to designing, developing, and implementing payment solutions that guarantee stable and consistent payment processing. Our goal is to create successful products and establish a reputation as a dependable partner for our clients.

In this role, you will work in a fast-paced environment where system performance, scalability, and 99.9% reliability are critical to our core transaction flow.

  • Location: Remote from Portugal or Poland (Contractor arrangement)
  • Reporting to: Technical Lead

What you will do:

  • Dual-Track Engineering: Support and extend the existing Perl-based payment gateway while simultaneously designing and building high-performance microservices in Python.
  • System Modernization: Architect and implement scalable, distributed Python services to replace legacy components, ensuring reliability under high-load production environments.
  • High-Stakes Integrations: Integrate and manage complex third-party APIs and external payment services, ensuring seamless transaction flows and robust error handling.
  • Technical Leadership: Lead code reviews, drive engineering best practices, and identify system bottlenecks to continuously improve performance and scalability.
  • Architecture & Deployment: Collaborate with DevOps to improve CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) and architect solutions using AWS services (Lambda, ECS, etc.).
  • Product-Focused Delivery: Go beyond the "how" of the code—bring a product mindset to understand the business logic, user impact, and the "why" behind every feature you build.
  • Production Ownership: Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues in distributed systems, maintaining a "zero-downtime" mentality for our merchants.

What we need:

  • Python Mastery: 5+ years of backend engineering experience with deep Python expertise (FastAPI and AsyncIO preferred).
  • Polyglot Mindset (Perl): Experience with Perl is a major plus, but a genuine eagerness to learn and work within Perl production code is mandatory. We value engineers who can bridge the gap between legacy and modern systems.
  • Distributed Systems Expertise: Proven experience building and scaling microservices architectures and high-throughput systems (e.g., payments, trading, or real-time processing).
  • API & Reliability Guru: Deep understanding of integrating third-party APIs, specifically managing webhooks, callbacks, idempotency, and retry policies.
  • Cloud & Containers: Strong experience with Docker/Containerization and a solid grasp of AWS cloud infrastructure (Lambda, SQS/SNS, and cloud networking).
  • Engineering over "AI Vibe Coding": We value deep engineering logic over blind AI-generated snippets. You should be an advocate for clean, intentional code who can explain the reasoning behind every line you ship.
  • High-Load Architecture: Familiarity with event-driven architecture and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
  • Ownership & Mentorship: You have a track record of owning features from design to production and enjoy supporting/mentoring other engineers in the team.
  • English Proficiency: Strong English communication skills—both written and verbal—to collaborate effectively across our remote-first, multi-functional teams.

Hiring Process:

  • Step 1 – Thinking in Action (40 minutes) Your first conversation will be with our Talent Acquisition team. We'll explore your background, career journey, motivations, and overall fit for the role. As part of this discussion, you'll also complete a short technical screening that will be reviewed by our engineering team. This stage helps us understand both your experience and how you approach technical challenges.
  • Step 2 – Build in Production (60–90 minutes) Meet with the Team Lead and technical experts for a practical assessment. Depending on the role, this may involve a live coding exercise or a real-world scenario designed to evaluate your technical skills, problem-solving approach, and ability to work through challenges similar to those faced by our teams.
  • Step 3 – Final Interview (45 minutes) The final stage is a group interview with senior members of our Technology squad, which may include the CTO, CPO, and Team Lead. Together, we'll discuss team fit, collaboration style, expectations from both sides, and any remaining questions about the role, team, or technology domain. This is also an opportunity for you to learn more about our culture and ways of working.

The perks of being a payabl.er:

  • Grow with Us: Annual Learning Budget for professional development (eligible after probation)—because your growth is our growth.
  • Celebrate Together: We bring colleagues from all offices together for unforgettable company celebrations.
  • Global Collaboration & Events: Opportunities to participate in international company events and initiatives, connecting with colleagues from all regions and contributing to a truly global community

The contract set up type will be assessed subject to your location and discussed in the first interview with your Talent Acquisition Partner.

Sales Development Representative (SDR) – Accounting & Financial Services | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (EST)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to drive pipeline and revenue growth across accounting and financial services.

This is a high-ownership, full-cycle sales role that goes beyond traditional appointment setting. You’ll prospect for new business, execute multi-channel outreach, conduct discovery calls, present solutions, and close smaller deals independently.

The ideal candidate has experience selling accounting, bookkeeping, financial, or related professional services and understands how to communicate with SMB owners about their financial and operational challenges.

What You’ll Own

Prospecting & Lead Generation

  • Identify and research prospective customers across target verticals, including:
    • Churches
    • E-commerce
    • Construction
    • Home services
    • Trucking
    • Real estate
  • Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, directories, and prospecting platforms
  • Identify decision-makers and relevant buying signals
  • Understand industry-specific pain points and tailor outreach accordingly
  • Maintain a consistent pipeline of new prospects

Multi-Channel Outreach

  • Execute outbound prospecting through:
    • Cold email
    • Cold calling
    • LinkedIn
    • Social platforms
  • Personalize messaging based on prospect needs and industry
  • Engage prospects and move qualified leads into discovery conversations
  • Maintain disciplined follow-up across multiple touchpoints
  • Support basic Facebook and Instagram campaigns to generate inbound opportunities

Discovery, Qualification & Closing

  • Conduct discovery calls using frameworks such as BANT or MEDDIC
  • Understand prospects’ accounting, bookkeeping, and financial-service needs
  • Qualify opportunities based on fit, needs, budget, and buying intent
  • Present relevant service solutions
  • Conduct demos and walkthroughs using tools such as Digits
  • Handle objections confidently and professionally
  • Prepare proposals and move opportunities toward close
  • Independently close smaller deals
  • Coordinate with the service delivery team for smooth client onboarding

Pipeline & CRM Management

  • Own opportunities from initial prospecting through close
  • Maintain consistent follow-up with active prospects
  • Track conversations, tasks, and deal stages accurately in the CRM
  • Keep pipeline data clean and current
  • Ensure opportunities do not stall due to missed follow-ups
  • Maintain clear visibility into next steps across every active deal

Reporting & Performance

  • Track:
    • Outreach activity
    • Response rates
    • Discovery calls
    • Qualified opportunities
    • Conversion rates
    • Deals closed
    • Revenue generated
    • Paid campaign performance
  • Maintain accurate CRM notes and reporting
  • Provide weekly performance insights and pipeline updates
  • Identify opportunities to improve messaging, targeting, and conversion

Must-Have Experience & Skills

  • Proven B2B sales experience, preferably selling:
    • Accounting services
    • Bookkeeping services
    • Financial services
    • Related professional services
  • Experience conducting discovery and qualification calls
  • Demonstrated ability to close deals independently
  • Experience managing opportunities across the full sales cycle
  • Strong outbound prospecting and lead-generation experience
  • Familiarity with tools such as:
    • Apollo
    • Salesloft
    • Outreach
    • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRM platforms
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong objection-handling and follow-up skills
  • Ability to work independently during U.S. EST business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to SMBs or service-based businesses
  • Understanding of accounting workflows and financial operations
  • Familiarity with GoHighLevel
  • Experience using Digits
  • Experience supporting or running Facebook and Instagram campaigns
  • Experience selling into industries such as construction, real estate, e-commerce, trucking, or home services

Tools & Tech

HubSpot | Salesforce | Apollo | Salesloft | Outreach | LinkedIn Sales Navigator | GoHighLevel | Digits | Meta Ads

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’ve sold accounting, bookkeeping, financial, or professional services before
  • You can confidently move from cold outreach to discovery to close
  • You understand that success is measured by pipeline and revenue, not just activity
  • You can speak credibly with business owners about operational and financial pain points
  • You’re comfortable balancing outbound prospecting with inbound opportunities
  • You follow up consistently and maintain an organized pipeline
  • You take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for direction

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by researching target accounts and building prospect lists before moving into cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach.

Throughout the day, you’ll conduct discovery calls, qualify prospects, demonstrate solutions, handle objections, prepare proposals, and move active opportunities toward close.

You’ll also maintain CRM records, follow up with prospects, review campaign performance, and coordinate successful new clients with the service delivery team.

In short: you own the sales process from prospecting through close and turn qualified opportunities into revenue.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Qualified opportunities generated
  • Deals closed
  • Revenue contribution
  • Lead → discovery call conversion
  • Discovery call → close conversion
  • Outreach response rates
  • Pipeline growth and velocity
  • Consistent follow-up execution
  • CRM accuracy and pipeline hygiene

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Spark Hire Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you have experience selling accounting, bookkeeping, financial, or professional services and can confidently own the sales process from prospecting through discovery and close, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help build a high-performing pipeline across growing SMB markets.
