Bullhorn's core purpose is to create an incredible customer experience, and the organization has a sharp focus on delivering very high quality products and services to its customers. The company culture is shaped by five Core Values: Ownership, Energy, Speed & Agility, Service, and Being Human. Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.

Bullhorn is a fast-paced and dynamic environment where hard work and outstanding results are rewarded and celebrated. We value those that exhibit an eagerness to learn and a strong natural desire for continuous improvement and we encourage team members to stretch themselves, acknowledge challenges and learn from them. With a strong focus on growth, we provide ample opportunities for career development and prioritize promoting from within. We believe that leaders should care deeply about the development of their employees at all levels, emphasizing emotional intelligence and accountability. Our leaders collaborate closely to ensure the success of their teams, and we work together to achieve shared goals, creating a challenging and rewarding workplace for everyone.

About the Role

As a DevOps Engineer at Bullhorn, you'll be building the tools and systems that facilitate large-scale software releases safely and effectively. This includes all pipelines for building, packaging, deploying, and validating software delivery. You will help the team take code changes safely and quickly from a developer's machine all the way to production. We're a release-engineering and platform team: we build and maintain the systems that enable engineering teams to deploy with confidence. We relentlessly automate manual toil from the software delivery lifecycle.

This is a hands-on building role. You'll write automations, own our deploy and CI/CD tooling, containerize and modernize our environments, and partner directly with engineering teams to remove the friction that slows them down.

A Typical Day Will Include...

  • Designing, building, and maintaining deploy and release pipelines, and the automation that reduces manual intervention during releases

  • Building and improving our internal release tooling — for example, automating script packaging and DBA approvals, code + script deploys, and release-finishing workflows

  • Advancing our CI/CD GitOps process: authoring reusable GitLab CI templates, Helm charts, and ArgoCD applications so teams can self-serve their own build and deploy pipelines

  • Containerizing and modernizing our QA and lower environments (Kubernetes, Helm, Ansible) to bring them closer to production parity

  • Modernizing build tools across the org to ensure we’re using the latest and greatest technology across all teams.

  • Attending daily team stand-ups and collaborating with a distributed, cross-functional team across US and UK time zones

  • Troubleshooting deployment and infrastructure issues, and partnering with engineering teams to resolve environment-specific problems

  • Writing clean, well-tested automation and scripts (Python, Bash) and following solid engineering practices for the tools we own

  • Contributing to documentation, runbooks, and developer enablement so knowledge is shared and not siloed

  • Mentoring teammates, driving conversations about priorities and process, and independently owning complex, cross-cutting initiatives

  • Working within a positive, energizing, collaborative team environment

This Role Is a Fit for You If...

  • You want to be an integral part of an innovative, high-performance engineering team

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment with frequent software releases

  • You're an automation-first thinker — if you do something more than twice, your instinct is to automate it

  • You can work through complex problems independently while knowing when to pull others in and help less experienced teammates do the same

  • You're comfortable scripting and building tooling in Python and Bash/shell

  • You have hands-on experience with CI/CD systems — GitLab CI/CD and/or Jenkins — including building and maintaining pipelines

  • You're experienced with containers and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm

  • You're comfortable building full-stack automation tooling — scripting and backend work in Python, and frontend/UI work in JavaScript (our internal tools have both a Python backend and a web frontend)

  • You've worked with GitOps and/or infrastructure-as-code and configuration management (ArgoCD, Ansible, or similar)

  • You're comfortable with Git-based workflows and modern versioning practices

  • You see AI tooling as a force multiplier and are eager to use it to raise your own and the team's output

  • You care about reliability, security, and developer experience, and you communicate clearly with the engineering teams you support

  • You're comfortable challenging and being challenged by your teammates

Bonus Points...

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a similar field, or relevant work experience

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS), including services like RDS

  • Experience with deployment tooling such as Octopus Deploy, and with artifact repositories (Nexus, Artifactory)

  • Experience with monitoring and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Backstage, Rancher, or ELK)

  • Comfort working across geographically distributed teams and time zones

jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

About Client

Our client is the world's leading manufacturer of advanced control and automation systems, innovating technology and reinventing the way people live and work, offering integrated solutions to control audio & video systems. The client streamlines technology, improving the quality of life for people in corporate boardrooms, conference rooms, classrooms, auditoriums, and in their homes.

The automation and control solutions for buildings and homes let people control entire environments with the push of a button, integrating systems such as A/V, lighting, shading, IT, security, BMS, and HVAC to provide greater comfort, convenience, and security. All the products are designed and built to work together as a cohesive system, enabling customers to monitor, manage, and operate everything from the cloud.

Job Description

We are looking for a Camera BSP & Middleware Engineer to drive the design and development of a unified camera infrastructure across Linux and Android platforms.

This role combines deep embedded Linux and Android expertise with camera subsystem integration. The engineer will be responsible for sensor bring-up, driver development, middleware integration, and image quality tuning, ensuring compliance with Android Camera HAL standards and optimized multimedia performance across platforms.

Technical Requirements (Mandatory)

  • Strong experience with Linux kernel camera drivers and V4L2 (including sub-device drivers)

  • Proven experience integrating and maintaining Android Camera HAL

  • Hands-on experience with camera sensor bring-up and board-level integration

  • Experience working with Device Tree / DTBO overlays, including power sequencing, reset, and clock (MCLK) configuration

  • Experience tuning image quality pipelines, including:

  • 3A algorithms (AE, AWB, AF)

  • Lens Shading Correction (LSC)

jobs.title: Jr. Salesforce Administrator / QA Tester
jobs.excerpt: Role Summary Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce.
jobs.description:
Role Summary
Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce. The program runs in continuous release cycles, and every cycle changes objects, page layouts, permission sets, flows, Apex, and integrations. Each of those changes has to be proven out end to end before it reaches production users.

We are looking for a junior Salesforce administrator (remote) who wants to spend the bulk of their time in structured, repeatable quality assurance. This person will execute full end-to-end test passes in our sandboxes, over and over, across each release: building and maintaining the test scripts, running them, logging what breaks, retesting fixes, and confirming regressions have not been introduced elsewhere.

Repetition is the job, not a side effect of it. The right candidate is someone who is genuinely comfortable running the same 200-step regression pass every sprint and catching the one step that changed — and who is methodical enough to keep the documentation accurate while doing it.

Engagement at a Glance

Working titleJunior Salesforce Administrator / QA TesterReports toDirector of Program Management & CRMLocationOffshore / nearshore, fully remoteTime zone requirementMinimum 6 hours of daily overlap with 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. US EasternCommitmentFull-time, 40 hours per weekDuration6–12 months, with option to extendEngagement typeOpen — vendor staff augmentation, individual contractor, or employer-of-recordSeniorityJunior (1–3 years); this is a hands-on execution role, not a lead role
Time zone is a hard requirement. Testing is iterative and conversational — the tester needs to be able to ask an administrator or developer a question and get an answer inside the same working session. Candidates should be located where the standard working day overlaps with US Eastern.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-end and regression testing (primary, ~60% of time)

  • Execute full end-to-end test passes across core business processes in the sandbox environments, following documented scripts, for every release cycle.
  • Run regression suites after each configuration or code change to confirm that existing functionality still behaves as expected.
  • Test across the full record lifecycle — record creation, field updates, stage and status transitions, automation firing, downstream record effects, and reporting output.
  • Retest and close out defects after fixes are deployed, and confirm the fix has not broken adjacent functionality.
  • Validate behavior after sandbox refreshes and deployments, including smoke testing of critical paths.

Test design and documentation (~20% of time)

  • Write and maintain test cases and test scripts from user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.
  • Keep the test case library current as requirements change; retire cases that no longer apply and add coverage for new functionality.
  • Log defects with clear, reproducible steps, expected vs. actual results, affected records, screenshots, and severity.
  • Maintain test execution records so that release readiness can be assessed at a glance.

Test data and environment support (~10% of time)

  • Prepare and refresh test data sets, including bulk loads via Data Loader or Data Import Wizard.
  • Write basic SOQL queries to verify data state and confirm expected record changes.
  • Test across multiple user profiles and permission sets to confirm record visibility, field-level security, and sharing behave correctly for each role.

Light administrative configuration (~10% of time)

  • Perform straightforward declarative configuration under supervision — custom fields, page layouts, list views, validation rules, simple reports and dashboards.
  • Assist with user setup, permission set assignment, and access troubleshooting.
  • Support user acceptance testing cycles: prepare UAT scripts, walk business testers through them, and consolidate their feedback.

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience in a Salesforce environment as an administrator, QA tester, business analyst, or support analyst.
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce platform: standard and custom objects, record types, page layouts, profiles and permission sets, validation rules, and Flow.
  • Demonstrated experience executing manual test cases and logging defects in a tracked system (Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar).
  • Ability to read a user story or acceptance criteria and translate it into concrete test steps.
  • Comfort with repetitive, detail-intensive work and a track record of sustained accuracy in it.
  • Basic SOQL and comfort with Data Loader or a comparable data tool.
  • Clear written and spoken English — defect reports and test notes are read by developers and business stakeholders, so writing quality matters.
  • Availability for the required daily overlap with US Eastern business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM-201) — preferred, not required. Hands-on experience carries more weight than the credential, and we will consider candidates who are working toward it.
  • Experience testing during a data migration or multi-org consolidation.
  • Exposure to integration testing between Salesforce and external systems, including basic API concepts.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or comparable tracking and documentation tools.
  • Any experience with test automation (Selenium, Provar, Playwright) or reading Apex test results — useful, but this role is manual-first.
  • Background in healthcare, insurance, legal services, or another regulated environment where access control and audit trails matter.

What Success Looks Like

  • By 15 days: has run a full end-to-end pass on at least one core process independently, using existing scripts, and is logging usable defects without rework.
  • By 30 days: is authoring new test cases from user stories with minimal correction, and owns the regression suite for at least one functional area.
  • By 60 days: is the reliable go-to for release readiness on their areas — the team trusts that if this person has signed off, the release is safe to deploy.

jobs.title: Jr. Salesforce Administrator / QA Tester
jobs.excerpt: Role Summary Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce.
jobs.description:
Role Summary
Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce. The program runs in continuous release cycles, and every cycle changes objects, page layouts, permission sets, flows, Apex, and integrations. Each of those changes has to be proven out end to end before it reaches production users.

We are looking for a junior Salesforce administrator (remote) who wants to spend the bulk of their time in structured, repeatable quality assurance. This person will execute full end-to-end test passes in our sandboxes, over and over, across each release: building and maintaining the test scripts, running them, logging what breaks, retesting fixes, and confirming regressions have not been introduced elsewhere.

Repetition is the job, not a side effect of it. The right candidate is someone who is genuinely comfortable running the same 200-step regression pass every sprint and catching the one step that changed — and who is methodical enough to keep the documentation accurate while doing it.

Engagement at a Glance

Working titleJunior Salesforce Administrator / QA TesterReports toDirector of Program Management & CRMLocationOffshore / nearshore, fully remoteTime zone requirementMinimum 6 hours of daily overlap with 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. US EasternCommitmentFull-time, 40 hours per weekDuration6–12 months, with option to extendEngagement typeOpen — vendor staff augmentation, individual contractor, or employer-of-recordSeniorityJunior (1–3 years); this is a hands-on execution role, not a lead role
Time zone is a hard requirement. Testing is iterative and conversational — the tester needs to be able to ask an administrator or developer a question and get an answer inside the same working session. Candidates should be located where the standard working day overlaps with US Eastern.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-end and regression testing (primary, ~60% of time)

  • Execute full end-to-end test passes across core business processes in the sandbox environments, following documented scripts, for every release cycle.
  • Run regression suites after each configuration or code change to confirm that existing functionality still behaves as expected.
  • Test across the full record lifecycle — record creation, field updates, stage and status transitions, automation firing, downstream record effects, and reporting output.
  • Retest and close out defects after fixes are deployed, and confirm the fix has not broken adjacent functionality.
  • Validate behavior after sandbox refreshes and deployments, including smoke testing of critical paths.

Test design and documentation (~20% of time)

  • Write and maintain test cases and test scripts from user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.
  • Keep the test case library current as requirements change; retire cases that no longer apply and add coverage for new functionality.
  • Log defects with clear, reproducible steps, expected vs. actual results, affected records, screenshots, and severity.
  • Maintain test execution records so that release readiness can be assessed at a glance.

Test data and environment support (~10% of time)

  • Prepare and refresh test data sets, including bulk loads via Data Loader or Data Import Wizard.
  • Write basic SOQL queries to verify data state and confirm expected record changes.
  • Test across multiple user profiles and permission sets to confirm record visibility, field-level security, and sharing behave correctly for each role.

Light administrative configuration (~10% of time)

  • Perform straightforward declarative configuration under supervision — custom fields, page layouts, list views, validation rules, simple reports and dashboards.
  • Assist with user setup, permission set assignment, and access troubleshooting.
  • Support user acceptance testing cycles: prepare UAT scripts, walk business testers through them, and consolidate their feedback.

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience in a Salesforce environment as an administrator, QA tester, business analyst, or support analyst.
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce platform: standard and custom objects, record types, page layouts, profiles and permission sets, validation rules, and Flow.
  • Demonstrated experience executing manual test cases and logging defects in a tracked system (Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar).
  • Ability to read a user story or acceptance criteria and translate it into concrete test steps.
  • Comfort with repetitive, detail-intensive work and a track record of sustained accuracy in it.
  • Basic SOQL and comfort with Data Loader or a comparable data tool.
  • Clear written and spoken English — defect reports and test notes are read by developers and business stakeholders, so writing quality matters.
  • Availability for the required daily overlap with US Eastern business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM-201) — preferred, not required. Hands-on experience carries more weight than the credential, and we will consider candidates who are working toward it.
  • Experience testing during a data migration or multi-org consolidation.
  • Exposure to integration testing between Salesforce and external systems, including basic API concepts.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or comparable tracking and documentation tools.
  • Any experience with test automation (Selenium, Provar, Playwright) or reading Apex test results — useful, but this role is manual-first.
  • Background in healthcare, insurance, legal services, or another regulated environment where access control and audit trails matter.

What Success Looks Like

  • By 15 days: has run a full end-to-end pass on at least one core process independently, using existing scripts, and is logging usable defects without rework.
  • By 30 days: is authoring new test cases from user stories with minimal correction, and owns the regression suite for at least one functional area.
  • By 60 days: is the reliable go-to for release readiness on their areas — the team trusts that if this person has signed off, the release is safe to deploy.

jobs.excerpt: Full-Stack Developer Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.
jobs.description:
Full-Stack Developer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for a Full-Stack Developer with strong experience in TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Postgres to build and ship features across a modern client portal.

You’ll own features from design through production, working across the frontend, backend, database, and integrations as needed. This is a hands-on role where you’ll be expected to think beyond the happy path, build reliable features, and improve the codebase as you go.

You’ll work closely with a small engineering and product team, receiving fast feedback and having significant ownership over what you build.

What You’ll Own

End-to-End Feature Development

  • Take features from design prototype through production
  • Build frontend interfaces using TypeScript, React, and Next.js
  • Handle route handlers, database migrations, emails, and UI as part of a complete feature
  • Work across candidate profiles, roles and candidates pages, interview flows, billing, and other portal features
  • Ensure features are production-ready rather than focused only on the happy path

Data & UI Resilience

  • Build features that handle real-world data and edge cases
  • Account for empty states, error states, long names, lengthy CVs, and multiple applications
  • Ensure UI states are clear, intentional, and user-friendly
  • Identify potential edge cases before they become production issues
  • Improve existing features when you identify reliability or usability gaps

Testing & Code Quality

  • Write automated tests for areas that currently lack coverage
  • Add regression coverage for new features and important workflows
  • Keep the codebase stable and maintainable
  • Identify and resolve issues discovered through testing or code review
  • Leave each area of the codebase better than you found it

Database & Backend

  • Write and review Postgres migrations
  • Work confidently with SQL, joins, and database relationships
  • Read and reason about row-level security policies
  • Maintain predictable Supabase Auth and Realtime behavior
  • Understand how frontend, backend, and database changes work together

Third-Party Integrations

  • Work with integrations such as Stripe, Resend, Workable, and SparkHire
  • Connect third-party services to product features when required
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues
  • Read and understand the existing Python FastAPI service when features interact with AI or data functionality

Code Review & Collaboration

  • Write clear and well-documented pull requests
  • Provide enough context for reviewers to understand and approve changes efficiently
  • Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback
  • Progress toward reviewing API and database migration pull requests independently
  • Collaborate directly with engineering and product team members in a fast feedback environment

Requirements

  • 2–4 years of experience shipping production TypeScript and React applications
  • Strong experience with Next.js, ideally including App Router, Server Components, and Route Handlers
  • Solid understanding of SQL and relational databases
  • Ability to write joins, read migrations, and understand database relationships
  • Understanding of Postgres and row-level security concepts
  • Experience building production-ready UIs with thoughtful empty, loading, and error states
  • Experience working in a monorepo or codebase where features span frontend, backend, and database layers
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests
  • Familiarity with pull requests and modern code-review workflows
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Ability to own features independently from requirements through deployment
  • Strong written communication and attention to detail

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Supabase
  • Experience with Stripe or Resend
  • Experience working with Workable or SparkHire integrations
  • Familiarity with Python and FastAPI
  • Experience with unit or integration testing
  • Experience working with AI or data-focused backend services
  • Experience using tools such as CodeRabbit or similar AI-assisted code review tools
  • Previous experience working in a small, fast-moving product team

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Can take a feature from a brief to production without needing every task broken down
  • Think about migrations, edge cases, testing, and integrations alongside the UI
  • Care about how features behave with real-world data
  • Communicate proactively when you encounter blockers
  • Welcome feedback and use it to improve your work
  • Are comfortable working across both frontend and backend systems
  • Prefer shipping small, reliable improvements consistently
  • Take pride in leaving the codebase cleaner and more stable than you found it

What Success Looks Like

  • Features move efficiently from design to production
  • New functionality works reliably across real-world data scenarios
  • Strong automated test coverage across key areas of the portal
  • Database migrations and security policies remain reliable and well-structured
  • Pull requests are clear, focused, and easy to review
  • Third-party integrations work consistently across product workflows
  • Bugs and edge cases are identified and addressed proactively
  • The codebase becomes more stable and maintainable over time

Typical Day

Your day may start with a design prototype, feature request, or product comment. You’ll work across the stack to turn that requirement into a production-ready feature—writing the database migration, building the UI, implementing the route handler, connecting required integrations, and adding tests.

Other days may involve fixing an edge case that surfaced in production, such as a candidate with multiple applications causing an unexpected issue in a list view. You’ll investigate the problem, implement the fix, test it, and deploy the improvement.

The team operates with a tight feedback loop, so expect short standups, direct collaboration, and most decisions to happen through comments and pull requests rather than lengthy meetings.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. AI Rating & Recruiter Screening
  3. Technical/Client Interview
  4. Final Selection & Onboarding

jobs.description:
The Field Access Manager (FAM) will act as the main point of contact at designated accounts providing account management support to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) and their staff on behalf of patients who are prescribed a product for approved indications. As a part of this strategy, the FAM will provide on-going education to accounts regarding the Patient Services program, the regional payer landscape, and pharmacy channel access. The FAM will help coordinate pull-through efforts for patients who have been prescribed the product, irrespective of channel (HUB, specialty pharmacy, etc.), provided proper HIPAA consent has been secured from the patient. The FAM will be expected to be the primary face of the Patient Services platforms within designated HCP offices. The FAM is also responsible for partnering with internal and external stakeholders to optimize access to the product for patients.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Offer educational resources to support the entire patient’s journey by optimizing processes for prior authorizations/appeals/specialty pharmacy and addressing access issues.
  • Coordinate utilization of the patient service platform to seamlessly support the customer and patient when office chooses the HUB or SP as their ideal path to approved therapy.
  • Coordinate annual pharmacy reauthorizations at designated accounts to ensure timely reauthorization and continuation of therapy is maintained.
  • Work cross functionally and collaboratively with partners in Sales, Market Access, Patient Services, Strategic Accounts and more to act as a process and payer expert. The FAM will help identify and address time sensitive market development and implementation efforts to remove access barriers to the product for appropriate patients, while optimizing adherence.
  • Build and execute a strategic business plan to meet the needs of top accounts and ensure successful implementation of market access initiatives.
  • Obtain and maintain knowledge and understanding of payer landscape, including specialty pharmacy and utilization management criteria, on a national, regional and local level so that you can act as a process and payer expert.
  • Continuously strive to understand the alignment of Payer/PBM/SP and how national/regional pharmacy drug formularies impact market access in their designated geography.
  • Assist in providing appropriate field insights to ensure support of all access and patient/payer support programs and resources offered by the company’s Patient Support Programs.
  • Anticipate, navigate and address individual account and patient access issues that arise by partnering with all appropriate stakeholders.

  • Ability to conduct impactful educational presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of Veeva systems.

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Advanced Degree preferred.
  • Pediatric Endocrinology and/or Endocrinology experience preferred.
  • Previous launch experience in Access/Reimbursement role
  • Previous experience in other functions within the biopharmaceutical industry a plus (e.g. product marketing, managed care, field sales, case management or large healthcare practice experience).

Job Summary

Aptive Resources is seeking an AI Program Manager with at least fifteen years of experience across diverse IT projects, both large and small, and the ability to manage a portfolio of projects. In this role you will lead Aptive’s delivery team supporting the Veterans Health Administration’s National Artificial Intelligence Institute developing the operating model that lets AI work scale beyond a handful of central projects, designing the field operations structure that helps front-line clinicians become AI adopters, and reporting program outcomes to senior VHA leadership. This senior level, full-time position is remote. This is a contingent hire position.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Provide technical program leadership for the contractor team across all six workstreams, aligning AI inventory, risk management, oversight, strategy, and field operations delivery to a single operating model.
  • Develop the AI center of excellence operational playbook, including the staffing model and supporting standard operating procedures.
  • Document and recommend distributed VHA AI innovation and governance processes so that AI work can be executed outside the central Institute without loss of oversight.
  • Develop and recommend the operational structure and support model for field partnership pilots, including five field-based pilot AI project development teams.
  • Lead the team’s support to VHA business units in creating and updating their AI innovation and governance strategies, covering at least five business units.
  • Develop AI entrepreneur and adopter playbooks covering internal development pathways and vendor evaluation.
  • Design and lead the qualitative and quantitative assessment of pilot outcomes and of program implementation.
  • Manage the program to cost, schedule, and performance, and identify and mitigate risks to the program.
  • Serve as the contractor’s senior escalation point to government leadership on delivery status, resourcing, and risk.
  • Develop additional programming for the VHA AI Assessment Subcommittee, field AI committees, and other centralized governance entities, including trainings and summits.
  • Support administrative operations, planning, and content development for a monthly meeting cadence across at least two AI oversight committees and one workgroup.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Years of experience: 15 years minimum of program management experience across diverse IT projects, both large and small. Preferred: ten or more of those years in healthcare and five or more leading artificial intelligence, data science, or emerging-technology programs.
  • Required experience: Experience with diverse IT projects, including AI-related, both large and small, and the ability to manage a portfolio of projects. Well versed in the full systems development life cycle, enterprise-wide network engineering, strategic information planning, business process reengineering, and structure and management practices. Able to identify and mitigate risks to the program and to manage to cost, schedule, and performance. Experience with and demonstrated understanding of SAFe’s Lean Agile principles and practices to drive value and sustain organizational change and operational excellence through the empowering of high-performing Agile teams.

Must complete VA Privacy and Information Security Awareness and Rules of Behavior training (TMS #10176) prior to system access and annually thereafter.
  • Citizenship: Must be authorized to work in the United States. All work must be performed within a jurisdiction subject to the law of the United States or its territories.

  • Demonstrated success standing up an AI center of excellence, innovation pipeline, or comparable operating model inside a large organization.
  • Command of the full systems development life cycle, strategic information planning, and business process reengineering in an enterprise IT environment.

jobs.excerpt: Hi.  We’re Hummingbird. We’re elevating patient access so patients can get healthcare how, when, and where they need it.
jobs.description:
Hi. We’re Hummingbird.

We’re elevating patient access so patients can get healthcare how, when, and where they need it. We partner with healthcare systems to transform how patients access care, enabling their providers to focus on what matters most – caring for patients. By managing patient access as a technology-enabled service, we help health systems stabilize costs and improve patient experience while creating good jobs that attract and retain talent in the industry. Our team of experts is obsessed with the connection between the people, processes, and technology that make healthcare organizations hum. Join us and help build the healthcare experience we want for our communities, our families, and ourselves.

Summary

Help us build the team that patients count on when they call for care.

As part of a team of recruiters at Hummingbird, you'll participate in full-cycle recruiting for Patient Access Specialists and Triage Nurses, the team members patients reach first for everyday needs like booking an appointment, requesting a refill, getting clinical advice, or getting help logging into their patient portal.

You'll work alongside other recruiters to manage a high volume of requisitions and candidates, using structured interview and selection practices to keep hiring consistent and moving quickly. You'll partner closely with hiring managers to clarify requirements, keep the process on track, and advise on best hiring practices. You'll bring a sharp eye for process improvements, volunteering where we could adapt our work. This is fast-moving work, and it suits people who can prioritize independently, adapt quickly as priorities shift, and keep things moving without waiting to be told what's next.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

  • Manage end-to-end recruiting for high-volume hiring, from intake through offer execution.

  • Partner with recruiting leadership and hiring managers to clarify role requirements, set process expectations, and keep hiring on track.

  • Apply structured interview and selection practices to ensure consistent, defensible hiring decisions across a high volume of candidates.

  • Coordinate sourcing efforts and manage candidate pipelines through the applicant tracking system.

  • Evaluate candidates against role requirements for Patient Access Specialist and Triage Nurse positions, including technical skills and behaviors.

  • Identify bottlenecks or inefficiencies in the hiring process and recommend improvements to keep pace with volume.

  • Track requisition status and candidate progress, flagging risks to hiring timelines early.

  • Maintain clear documentation of hiring decisions and candidate communication throughout the process.

The Details

  • Employment Eligibility: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship

  • Work Location: Remote. You must work from a location within the United States with consistent internet service.

  • Work Type: Full-time

  • Compensation: Expected range is $70,000 - $92,000. New hires usually start between $70,000 and $85,000, depending on experience and internal equity.

  • Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; 401(k); parental leave; career development support; and more

Required & Desired Skills

What You'll Bring

  • 2+ years of full-cycle recruiting or talent acquisition experience across multiple roles or functions or equivalent experience in people-facing roles that require strong task management and tailored communication.

  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems and structured interview and selection practices.

  • Experience partnering with hiring managers to clarify requirements and manage hiring timelines.

  • Comfortable managing a high volume of requisitions and candidates at the same time.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain hiring decisions and next steps to stakeholders who weren't in the details.

  • Sound judgment in applying structured hiring practices consistently across roles.

Nice to Have

  • Experience recruiting for contact center or high-volume healthcare roles.

  • Experience navigating Workday ATS.

  • Experience contributing to improvements in recruiting processes, tools, or workflows.

  • Comfort working in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.

What Helps You Shine

  • Please note that we use both your resume and your written and oral communication throughout the hiring process to understand your fit for this role.

  • Thoughtful, clear responses help us see your attention to detail, your professionalism, and your ability to communicate with care, all skills that are essential for success on our team.

Please Note: The seniority level of this position may be adjusted during the recruitment process based on candidate skills and experience.


A Note on Authentic Interviews

We believe the best hiring conversations are real ones. Notes are welcome, and jotting things down during the call is completely fine. What we ask is that you don’t use AI tools or similar assistance to generate your responses in real time. We’re genuinely trying to get to know you: how you think, how you communicate, and what you’ve experienced. That connection matters to us, and it’s hard to find when answers are scripted rather than interactive.

We’re a team that makes healthcare more human. We’d love to meet the person behind your application.

The Hummingbird Approach
We value a team that brings diverse perspectives and experiences to the work we do. While there are many ways to do this, people who are successful at Hummingbird:

  • Lead with Respect by valuing kindness and working to actively foster an environment of inclusion and respect.
  • Embrace Growth and seek out learning and growth for themselves and support those around them in their growth journey. They bring curiosity and an openness to innovation to all their interactions.
  • Bring a Win Together mentality by approaching conflict directly, listening carefully, and seeking to understand. They problem-solve with the goal of finding successes, not trade-offs, for all involved.

Equal Opportunity Statement
Hummingbird Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic. We value the talents of individuals from all backgrounds and actively seek a diverse workforce.

jobs.title: Jr. Salesforce Administrator / QA Tester
jobs.excerpt: Role Summary Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce.
jobs.description:
Role Summary
Prove Partners is consolidating two Salesforce orgs and migrating a legacy system of record into Salesforce. The program runs in continuous release cycles, and every cycle changes objects, page layouts, permission sets, flows, Apex, and integrations. Each of those changes has to be proven out end to end before it reaches production users.

We are looking for a junior Salesforce administrator (remote) who wants to spend the bulk of their time in structured, repeatable quality assurance. This person will execute full end-to-end test passes in our sandboxes, over and over, across each release: building and maintaining the test scripts, running them, logging what breaks, retesting fixes, and confirming regressions have not been introduced elsewhere.

Repetition is the job, not a side effect of it. The right candidate is someone who is genuinely comfortable running the same 200-step regression pass every sprint and catching the one step that changed — and who is methodical enough to keep the documentation accurate while doing it.

Engagement at a Glance

Working titleJunior Salesforce Administrator / QA TesterReports toDirector of Program Management & CRMLocationOffshore / nearshore, fully remoteTime zone requirementMinimum 6 hours of daily overlap with 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. US EasternCommitmentFull-time, 40 hours per weekDuration6–12 months, with option to extendEngagement typeOpen — vendor staff augmentation, individual contractor, or employer-of-recordSeniorityJunior (1–3 years); this is a hands-on execution role, not a lead role
Time zone is a hard requirement. Testing is iterative and conversational — the tester needs to be able to ask an administrator or developer a question and get an answer inside the same working session. Candidates should be located where the standard working day overlaps with US Eastern.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-end and regression testing (primary, ~60% of time)

  • Execute full end-to-end test passes across core business processes in the sandbox environments, following documented scripts, for every release cycle.
  • Run regression suites after each configuration or code change to confirm that existing functionality still behaves as expected.
  • Test across the full record lifecycle — record creation, field updates, stage and status transitions, automation firing, downstream record effects, and reporting output.
  • Retest and close out defects after fixes are deployed, and confirm the fix has not broken adjacent functionality.
  • Validate behavior after sandbox refreshes and deployments, including smoke testing of critical paths.

Test design and documentation (~20% of time)

  • Write and maintain test cases and test scripts from user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation.
  • Keep the test case library current as requirements change; retire cases that no longer apply and add coverage for new functionality.
  • Log defects with clear, reproducible steps, expected vs. actual results, affected records, screenshots, and severity.
  • Maintain test execution records so that release readiness can be assessed at a glance.

Test data and environment support (~10% of time)

  • Prepare and refresh test data sets, including bulk loads via Data Loader or Data Import Wizard.
  • Write basic SOQL queries to verify data state and confirm expected record changes.
  • Test across multiple user profiles and permission sets to confirm record visibility, field-level security, and sharing behave correctly for each role.

Light administrative configuration (~10% of time)

  • Perform straightforward declarative configuration under supervision — custom fields, page layouts, list views, validation rules, simple reports and dashboards.
  • Assist with user setup, permission set assignment, and access troubleshooting.
  • Support user acceptance testing cycles: prepare UAT scripts, walk business testers through them, and consolidate their feedback.

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience in a Salesforce environment as an administrator, QA tester, business analyst, or support analyst.
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce platform: standard and custom objects, record types, page layouts, profiles and permission sets, validation rules, and Flow.
  • Demonstrated experience executing manual test cases and logging defects in a tracked system (Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar).
  • Ability to read a user story or acceptance criteria and translate it into concrete test steps.
  • Comfort with repetitive, detail-intensive work and a track record of sustained accuracy in it.
  • Basic SOQL and comfort with Data Loader or a comparable data tool.
  • Clear written and spoken English — defect reports and test notes are read by developers and business stakeholders, so writing quality matters.
  • Availability for the required daily overlap with US Eastern business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM-201) — preferred, not required. Hands-on experience carries more weight than the credential, and we will consider candidates who are working toward it.
  • Experience testing during a data migration or multi-org consolidation.
  • Exposure to integration testing between Salesforce and external systems, including basic API concepts.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or comparable tracking and documentation tools.
  • Any experience with test automation (Selenium, Provar, Playwright) or reading Apex test results — useful, but this role is manual-first.
  • Background in healthcare, insurance, legal services, or another regulated environment where access control and audit trails matter.

What Success Looks Like

  • By 15 days: has run a full end-to-end pass on at least one core process independently, using existing scripts, and is logging usable defects without rework.
  • By 30 days: is authoring new test cases from user stories with minimal correction, and owns the regression suite for at least one functional area.
  • By 60 days: is the reliable go-to for release readiness on their areas — the team trusts that if this person has signed off, the release is safe to deploy.

Position Title

Credit Risk Quantitative Model Analyst Sr

Location

Nationwide, MI 48098

Job Summary

The Senior Credit Risk Quantitative Model Analyst supports the Credit Risk Administration Team with the development, testing, implementation, monitoring, documentation, and maintenance of all credit risk rating models. Responsibilities include sourcing, cleaning, and transforming data; researching applicable methods; training and testing a variety of specifications; documenting all facets of the development process; implementation of models and related logic in production systems; assessing outputs across different levels of inputs (sensitivity analysis and scenario analysis); back-testing and ongoing performance monitoring; and, communicating aspects of the model and its application to non-technical stakeholders.

Job Responsibilities:

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and apply mathematical or statistical theory and methods to collect, organize, interpret, and summarize numerical data sets from multiple sources to develop credit risk rating models or other credit risk-related initiatives.
  • Derive model assumptions that are well reasoned and supportable.
  • Monitor the performance and calibration of existing models.
  • Implement models in code in a transparent and easily maintainable way within loan origination applications.
  • Comprehensively and clearly document all modeling or analysis work that meets internal, GAAP, and regulatory requirements; translate model theory and related results for non-quantitative audiences.
  • Develop and support strong controls for the model implementation framework and maintain related documentation.
  • Support independent model validation process, internal and external audits, and regulatory reviews.
  • Interact with model users, validators, and regulators to address model issues and remediation actions.
  • Interact with key stakeholder groups such as Accounting, Treasury, Credit, Lines of Business, Model Risk Management, and Enterprise Technology in the design, development, and ongoing usage of models.

jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/21/2026

Meet the Team

Isovalent, now part of Cisco, is the company founded by the creators of Ciliumand eBPF. Cisco Isovalent builds open-source software and enterprise solutions solving networking, security, and observability needs for modern cloud-native infrastructure. The flagship technology, Cilium, is the choice of numerous industry-leading global organizations.

As part of Cisco Hypershield, our team develops enterprise security applications that help organizations secure modern cloud and distributed environments. We build intuitive user experiences that simplify policy management, vulnerability visibility, reporting, and security workflows, enabling customers to confidently manage and protect their infrastructure at scale.

Your Impact

As a Product Designer, you will focus primarily on Hypershield experiences supporting a variety of roles from Network Security Engineers to Platform Teams. You will partner closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, and other designers to understand complex security workflows, identify gaps and opportunities, explore concepts, and translate them into intuitive product experiences. Success in this role means bringing a strong user perspective to complex problems and helping cross-functional teams move from requirements and technical capabilities to thoughtful, usable solutions. The day-to-day involves opportunities to:

  • Develop user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity designs for Hypershield experiences.

  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering to understand product requirements, technical capabilities, and constraints and translate them into effective user experiences.

  • Evaluate complex workflows from the user’s perspective, identify gaps and opportunities, and develop design options that help teams arrive at well-informed solutions.

  • Iterate on designs using feedback from users, research, designers, product partners, and engineers, and collaborate with Engineering through implementation.

  • Apply established design systems and use modern design and AI-assisted tools to explore concepts and accelerate prototyping.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of related experience or Master’s degree with 3+ years of related experience.

  • 3+ years of professional enterprise experience in product design, UX design, or UI/UX design creating digital product experiences.

  • Portfolio demonstratingend-to-end product design work includinguser flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity product designs using Figma or similar design and prototyping tools.

  • Experience translating product requirements, user needs, and technical capabilities into intuitive user-centered design solutions and collaborating with Product Management, Engineering and Research through implementation.

  • Experience using AI-enabled design or prototyping tools to develop, iterate, or enhance product design concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing enterprise software, infrastructure, SaaS, cybersecurity, networking IT, or other technically complex products.

  • Familiarity with security, networking, infrastructure or Security Operations Center (SOC) workflows or security concepts such as threat detection, investigation, triage, intelligence, or incident response.

  • Strong visual and interaction design skills, including experience evaluating end-to-end workflows and identifying usability or experience gaps.

  • Demonstrated critical thinking and curiosity when exploring complex product or user problems, including the ability to identify gaps and ask questions that improve the solution.

  • Experience working with or contributing to established design systems and exploring emerging AI-assisted design approaches such as Figma Make, Claude, MCP-based workflows, or similar technologies.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

As a Solutions Architect focused on Service and Offer Creation, you will play a critical role in defining, building, and scaling innovative network security offerings across Palo Alto Networks’ Network Security Product portfolio. You will work at the intersection of product, engineering, GTM, and partners to create differentiated, repeatable, and scalable service offerings centered on NGFW, SASE, and SD-WAN technologies.

This role requires a strong blend of technical depth, business acumen, and the ability to translate complex architectures into consumable offers that drive customer outcomes and revenue growth.

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering to influence roadmap based on field and customer requirements

  • Ensure offerings align with industry trends such as Zero Trust, AI-driven security, and autonomous operations

    • SASE architectures (SSE, CASB, ZTNA)

  • Proven experience in building service offerings, managed services, or packaged solutions

  • Strong understanding of enterprise networking (routing, switching, VPNs, segmentation, cloud networking)

  • Experience working with service providers, MSPs, or large enterprise environments

  • Experience with multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus

jobs.excerpt: THE OPPORTUNITYThe Beehive Project Developer is an independent contractor who will build and scale the Beehive Microgrid™️ line of business — identifying a sustainable growth model, opening and growing revenue streams, owning the overall revenue performance of the Beehive social enterprise, and developing regional fleets that make renewable disaster response possible at scale.
jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

The Beehive Project Developer is an independent contractor who will build and scale the Beehive Microgrid™️ line of business — identifying a sustainable growth model, opening and growing revenue streams, owning the overall revenue performance of the Beehive social enterprise, and developing regional fleets that make renewable disaster response possible at scale.

This is a commercial and growth-focused role at its core, paired with hands-on project development. You will define how Beehive Microgrids grow into a self-sustaining business — leasing mobile energy assets, cultivating investors and partners, and standing up repeatable regional fleets — much like a solar project developer, but with ownership of the business model as well as the build.

You will work directly with our CEO on partnerships and growth strategy, and closely with our HQ Technology Team and regional program teams to turn strategy into deployed, revenue-generating fleets. This is a development and business-building role; active disaster deployments are handled by regional field teams.

ABOUT US

Footprint Project is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit disaster service organization headquartered in New Orleans, Louisiana. We develop and deploy sustainable response technologies to empower community resilience. Footprint Project works across the disaster management cycle to expand frontline access to mobile microgrids and reduce fossil fuel use. Visit to learn more.

The Beehive Microgrid™ is our flagship resilience model: a dynamic network of rapidly deployable mobile energy assets built around a semi-permanent, centralized “Hive” and a fleet of mobile energy “Bees” (power, cooling, and water units). In blue-sky mode, a Hive serves as office, storage, and maintenance base while Bees power everyday community operations; in grey-sky mode, Bees deploy to deliver electricity, refrigeration, and clean water, and the Hive becomes a community hub and charging station.

We are ready to scale. Our goal is to grow Beehive Microgrids into a sustainable, revenue-generating line of business that lets Footprint rapidly expand deployment nationwide — and we are looking for the person to build that engine.

JOB DETAILS

  • Engagement: Independent contractor (1099), ongoing and open-ended, approximately full-time. As a contractor, you determine how and when you work to deliver the agreed outcomes, use your own equipment, and are free to serve other clients.
  • Location: New Orleans, LA or Asheville, NC metro areas preferred; open to fully remote for the right candidate.
  • Travel: Occasional travel to regions/sites (pre-approved travel expenses reimbursed)
  • Compensation: Flat monthly retainer, with potential for additional deliverables-based compensation. Our contract rates are benchmarked against local market standards for independent consultants. The final rate offered will be based on the contractor’s primary location, level of experience, specialized expertise, and complexity of the deliverables.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Growth Model & Revenue Ownership

  • Identify and build a sustainable growth model for the Beehive line of work, enabling Footprint to rapidly scale deployment nationwide.
  • Own and grow the overall revenue generated by the Beehive line of business, with P&L-style accountability for its performance.
  • Integrate mobile batteries into Commercial & Industrial (C&I) projects.
  • Sell the Beehive Microgrid model to developers.
  • Rent Bees for events.
  • Identify and develop additional Beehive revenue opportunities as the business grows.

Fleet Development & Project Management

  • Lead end-to-end development of regional Beehive Microgrid™ fleets, from concept and scoping through procurement, build-out, and deployment-readiness.
  • Manage project timelines, interdependencies, and delivery across multiple regions.
  • Coordinate with regional program teams on siting, site assessment, and deployment-readiness for Hives and Bees.

RFPs & Procurement

  • Develop and run RFPs for equipment, vendors, and EPC/build partners supporting regional fleets.
  • Manage procurement of Hive and Bee assets and related equipment, evaluating bids and making sourcing recommendations.
  • Coordinate with Footprint staff on funder and grant procurement requirements (e.g., Buy America, prevailing wage, and applicable procurement standards).

Vendor & Partner Management

  • Manage relationships with vendors, suppliers, and EPC/build partners, holding them to scope, schedule, quality, and cost.
  • Support the CEO in cultivating sponsors and partners, providing development-side inputs and project scoping to advance opportunities.

Regional Expansion & Repeatability

  • Help identify and stand up new and expansion regions in addition to established regions.
  • Develop repeatable playbooks, templates, and processes that make launching a fleet in a new region faster and more consistent.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience in solar / clean-energy project development, including running RFPs, managing procurement, and managing vendors and EPCs.
  • A business development mindset with a track record of building revenue — selling, renting, or otherwise monetizing energy assets, products, or services.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects end to end, on schedule and on budget.
  • Experience developing standardized, repeatable processes across multiple projects or sites.
  • Ability to work independently as a contractor — setting your own methods and schedule to deliver defined outcomes.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with mobile, modular, or distributed energy assets (rather than only fixed rooftop or utility-scale).
  • Experience selling into Commercial & Industrial (C&I) markets or to project developers.
  • Familiarity with grant- or publicly funded procurement environments and their requirements.
  • Experience in disaster response, resilience, or mission-driven / nonprofit settings.

No specific certifications or credentials (e.g., PMP, NABCEP, PE) are required.

Applications without both a cover letter and resume will not be considered.

The successful candidate will be responsible for defining and administering data privacy, classification, retention, and data-sharing policies across the CMM data platform, ensuring that sensitive and court-related data is protected, properly classified, and shared only under appropriate agreements and controls.

The Privacy & Data Sharing Specialist will execute the following responsibilities:

  • Establish and satisfy complex system-wide data privacy and classification requirements based on the analysis of user, policy, regulatory, and resource demands.

  • Support customers in the development and implementation of data privacy and data-sharing policies.

  • Define and maintain data classification, retention, and handling rules for sensitive, court-related, and personally identifiable information (PII).

  • Draft, review, and administer data sharing agreements, memoranda of understanding (MOUs), and interconnection security agreements (ISAs) with external agencies and partners.

  • Experience may be considered in lieu of degree.

  • Experience developing, negotiating, and administering data sharing agreements, memoranda of understanding (MOUs), or interconnection security agreements (ISAs) with external partners or agencies.

  • Familiarity with SQL for data querying and validation.

Overview

Experience the advantages of real career change!

When you join Piedmont, you’re not just changing your work environment. We open doors to real change in the lives we touch — especially yours. We’re committed to bringing award-winning care to communities across Georgia and celebrating the strength our diversity creates. Together, we’re doing big things. We offer a collaborative culture, innovative resources, and leadership that is genuinely invested in your growth. With competitive benefits, wellness programs, and opportunities for advancement, you’ll have what you need to thrive now and build a strong future.

Responsibilities

This position specializes in using ionizing radiation to produce cross-sectional images to help doctors diagnose and treat patients. CT Technologists perform diagnostic Computerized Tomographic examinations in accordance with all prescribed standards under the direct guidance of the supervising radiologist. CT Technologists provide patient care to all age groups to include neonatal, pediatrics, adult, and geriatrics. The Virtual CT technologist must demonstrate the ability to perform advanced CT imaging while incorporating competent/proficient knowledge of cross-sectional anatomy and physiology. Virtual CT technologists must be capable of providing and directing safe competent technical care based on each patient's identified needs, regardless of complexity, utilizing remote communication tools and relying on the cooperative clinical skills of the on-site CT support team.

What you will do

  • The remote technologist demonstrates competence and proficiency in performing all CT procedures on patients of all age groups. The remote technologist assists with correct patient positioning, protocol selection and utilizes all required equipment.
  • The remote technologist maintains competencies in all non-scanner related components.
  • The remote technologist accurately follows established imaging protocols for exams being performed.
  • Adheres to the Radiation Safety Policies and the principles of a viable dose reduction program.
  • Performs quality control procedures in accordance with the ACR guidelines.
  • The remote technologist must possess the ability to post-process advance imaging procedures by using applications such as Syngo-Via.
  • The remote technologist must function independently with little guidance from a manager.
  • The remote technologist must review all orders and protocols for appropriateness, all labs and all legal documentation to confirm patient readiness prior to scan.
  • All Safety behavior and tools must be practiced and adhered to throughout the patient encounter.
  • Remotely initiates and controls scanning and technical parameters in real time while monitoring image quality.
  • Maintains continuous audio/video communications with on-site support team and provides guidance to the qualified on-site operator.
  • Documents scan details, protocol deviations, and technical issues.
  • Use remote sessions as opportunities to train on-site staff toward full technical competency.

Qualifications

Education

  • Graduate of an accredited college for Radiologic Technology required

Work Experience

  • 2 years of experience as a CT Technologist required

Licenses and Certifications

  • Registered by the American Registry of Radiologic Technology (R) (CT) required
  • Advanced certification by ARRT in Computed Tomography (CT) required
  • BLS certified required

This is a part-time, remote, freelance role with the flexibility to decide your business hours. Candidate does not have to based in any specific location as the role is remote. This role is a great opportunity to supplement your current job or private practice.

You will be a practitioner on our telehealth platform 'Intellect', where your role is to support our clients' mental health and personal growth based on the individual needs and goals.

There are 4 roles that focus on different types of 1-on-1 sessions:

1. Network Psychiatrist

Network Psychiatrist will assist Intellect in providing psychiatric consultations (online and/or in person) wherein we will refer clients over to the network partner. As a member of our psychiatry network, the network psychiatrist will conduct appropriate clinical care within local regulations as well as necessary reporting and documentation.

We will refer clients who require clinical care over to our network psychiatrist. The psychiatrist will then schedule an initial consultation within 2 weeks of the referral and share with Intellect the expected treatment plan going forward. Network psychiatrist will thereafter be responsible for the continued treatment of the client, and will be required to provide periodic updates on the progress of the client thereafter. Our network psychiatrists are required to have the following credentials:

  • Master Degree in Medicine (M. Med(Psychiatry) or equivalent qualification required to practice psychiatry
  • Licensed/ Board certified to practice, prescribe and/or dispense medication in their respective countries based on the in-country requirements and regulations
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in residency
  • Possesses good record in clinical excellence and commitment to medical education
  • Ability to perform age-appropriate assessments on clients
  • Able to interact effectively with clients of diverse educational, socioeconomic and ethnic backgrounds, skill levels and value systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communications, listening, and social skills
  • Compassionate about helping clients and using clinically proven protocols

2. Crisis Helpline Responder

Crisis Helpline Responders focus on providing immediate client intervention that are in need of immediate support through a hotline. Our responders are required to have the following background:

  • 2 - 3 years of experience in helplines, either in a paid or voluntary capacity
  • Can effectively communicate in their native language
  • Completed training in Crisis Intervention or Suicide Prevention
  • Experience working with high risk clinical situations (at risk of or affected by suicide or crisis cases) and
  • Has the appropriate insurances required by your country
  • Ability to maintain emotional composure in high stress situations, ability to bounce back from stressful interactions and high-risk cases

3. Behavioral Health Coach

As a behavioral health coach you will focus on conducting 1-on-1 30 minute virtual coaching sessions that focus on subclinical cases (lack of motivation, stress, procrastination, etc). Our coaches are required to have the following credentials:

  • Has a Master / Postgraduate Diploma training in Counselling / Clinical Psychology or ICF accreditation
  • Skilled in Cognitive Behavioural Therapy or other evidence-based approaches (e.g. Motivational Interviewing, DBT, SFBT, etc.)
  • Candidate must have accumulated at least 300 hours worth of sessions
  • Candidate must be proficient in other languages other than English
  • Candidates with prior experience in EAP, counselling working adults or coaching managerial roles is a plus

4. Clinical Provider

Clinical providers on the other hand focus on clients that are in need of higher touch care. They provide 60 minute clinical online sessions and assist potential clients with cases such as MDD, Phobia, Trauma, etc. Our clinical providers are required to have the following credentials:

  • Has a Master / Postgraduate Diploma training in Clinical Psychology or Counselling
  • Skilled in Cognitive Behavioural Therapy or other evidence-based approaches (e.g. DBT, SFBT, etc.)
  • Candidate must have accumulated at least 300 clinical hours
  • Candidate must be proficient in other languages other than English
  • Candidates with prior experience in EAP, counselling working adults or coaching managerial roles is a plus
