jobs.title: Adviseur financiële gebiedsontwikkeling (planeconoom)
jobs.excerpt: Zet jij je tanden graag in complexe gebiedsontwikkelingsopgaven?
jobs.description:
Zet jij je tanden graag in complexe gebiedsontwikkelingsopgaven? Word jij ook zo blij van het aansturen van een project dat gedurende je betrokkenheid fysiek vorm krijgt? Wil je ook bijdragen aan het creëren van de leefomgeving van de toekomst? Niet door rapporten te schrijven, maar door een ontwikkelstrategie te bedenken die écht wordt uitgevoerd. Of door het bouwen van een coalitie met marktpartijen en overheden. Leer jij het liefst door samen te werken met gedreven collega’s? En geloof jij net als wij in denken, durven én doen? Dan is TwynstraGudde voor jou ‘the place to be’!

Wij werken als adviseurs, kwartiermakers en managers aan complexe ruimtelijke vraagstukken van publieke, semipublieke en private partijen. Haalbaarheid en uitvoerbaarheid zijn voor ons daarbij sleutelwoorden. Kenmerken van deze vraagstukken zijn de aanwezigheid van een maatschappelijke component, de complexe politiek bestuurlijke omgeving en het lokale of regionale schaalniveau. Wij zijn de adviesgroep Ruimte, Wonen en Economie van TwynstraGudde.

Wij maken impact op morgen én op overmorgen. Creatief zijn we, soms grensverleggend en tegelijkertijd pragmatisch. Opdrachtgevers kunnen op ons rekenen: onze kracht is om van strategie tot realisatie te komen. Wij werken aan inbreidingslocaties voor woningbouw, spoorzones, transformatie van brownfields, herontwikkeling van zorgterreinen en reconstructies van verrommeld buitengebied. Help jij hen, samen met ons, vooruit?

Jouw rol

Als Adviseur financiën gebiedsontwikkeling (planeconoom) werk je aan grote én kleine opgaven.

Je kunt producten als grondexploitaties, exploitatieplannen, residuele grondprijsberekeningen en businesscases ontwerpen, doorrekenen, beoordelen én deze financiële informatie vertalen zodat besluitvorming op verschillende niveaus (ambtelijk en bestuurlijk) kan plaatsvinden. Samen met andere financieel experts, projectleiders en/ of bestuurders kun je een ontwikkelstrategie uitdenken en uitvoeren. Het gaat hierbij ook vaak om samenwerkingsopgaven tussen partijen, waarbij je moet laveren tussen belangen. Je kijkt hierbij over de grenzen van het project en je eigen vakgebied heen. Samen met collega’s sta je klaar voor verschillende opdrachtgevers. Je rol varieert sterk per project en omgeving. Hierin kun jij zelf je koers bepalen.

Jouw werkzaamheden

  • Adviseren: doordat je inhoudelijk sterk bent, kun je opdrachtgevers van gedegen en diepgaand advies voorzien.

  • Beslissingen nemen: je hakt knopen door als Adviseur financiën gebiedsontwikkeling (planeconoom).

  • Verbinden: je zorgt er samen met collega’s voor dat er draagvlak ontstaat, bouwt aan coalities en verbindt partijen, in- en extern.

  • Onderhandelen: je bent in staat om onderhandelingen te voeren met (markt)partijen, bijvoorbeeld als het gaat om het sluiten van anterieure overeenkomsten.

  • Managen: je overziet de te nemen stappen, zorg je voor integrale aansturing van het project en ben je gesprekspartner van bestuurders.

  • Ontwikkelen: je denkt bewust na over je eigen leer- en ontwikkelpad en leert graag bij.

Je werkt aan meerdere kortlopende opdrachten naast elkaar of voor langere tijd aan één opdracht. Daarbij werk je zelfstandig of in teamverband en maak je natuurlijk ook deel uit van onze adviesgroep Ruimte, Wonen en Economie, en van bredere samenwerkingsverbanden binnen het bureau als geheel.

Requirements

Jouw profiel

Je staat bekend als iemand die ruime kennis en ervaring heeft met de financiële kant van gebiedsontwikkelingen. Doordat je analytisch vaardig bent, kun je problemen snel identificeren en met je communicatieve kwaliteiten kun je tot de kern van vraagstukken komen. Je hebt gedegen kennis in huis van business cases, grondexploitaties en het inzetten van andere financiële instrumenten bij gebiedsontwikkelingen. Daarnaast zorgt jouw creativiteit voor haalbare oplossingen. Ook ben je in staat om processen te organiseren en draagvlak te creëren, en ben je creatief om tot haalbare oplossingen te kunnen komen. Daarnaast lever je gedegen werk af en controleer je bij de opdrachtgever of jouw werkzaamheden aan de verwachtingen voldoen. Je trekt snel werk naar je toe, omdat je ziet wat mensen of organisaties nodig hebben. Tenslotte sta je open voor reflectie, leren en ontwikkeling.

Wat we van je vragen

  • Afgeronde HBO of WO opleiding en academisch werk- en denkniveau.

  • Minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring in het ruimtelijke domein.

  • Aantoonbare kennis van het opstellen van grondexploitaties/businesscases, exploitatieplannen, residuele grondprijsberekeningen.

  • Affiniteit met het vervullen van de rol van adviseur.

  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden, resultaatgericht en met financieel inzicht.

Bij TwynstraGudde stimuleren we een inclusieve werkplek waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn. Meer weten? Lees dan ons diversiteit en inclusie statement.

Over ons

Het werk dat we doen raakt ons. Iedere dag. Het heeft impact op onze maatschappij. Op de leefomgeving. Op morgen én op overmorgen. Wie doet mee en wie blijft achter? Wat vernieuw je? Wat behoud je?
Wij zijn de adviesgroep Ruimte Wonen en Economie. Wij helpen onze opdrachtgevers omdat wij vinden dat het beter moet, net als jij. Niet alleen vandaag of morgen, maar ook over 50 jaar. Wij gaan niet voor het snelle scoren, maar voor de lange termijn. Wij brengen complexe, ruimtelijke en duurzaamheidsvraagstukken tot de essentie terug. We helpen onze klanten om in control te blijven. Om los te laten. Scherp en samenwerkend. Soms regelen we, soms ontregelen we. Maar we helpen, altijd.

Aspecten die wij belangrijk vinden

  • Kwaliteit van de leefomgeving

  • Duurzaamheid

  • Realistische strategieën

We worden enthousiast van praktische en werkende oplossingen. We hanteren een hoge kwaliteitsstandaard, zijn ambitieus én collegiaal. We streven actief naar meer diversiteit en inclusiviteit en nodigen nadrukkelijk kandidaten van alle achtergronden uit om te reageren.

Wat we bieden

Bij TwynstraGudde werk je aan maatschappelijk relevante projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers. Dat doen we al 55 jaar. Daarbij vinden we het belangrijk dat jij je kunt ontwikkelen op een manier die bij je past, zodat we samen tot optimale resultaten komen.

Wat je van ons kunt verwachten

  • Een afwisselende baan met een salaris dat recht doet aan je rol en ervaring, inclusief flexibele beloning.

  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden: zoals een telefoon, laptop en uitgebreide pensioen- en mobiliteitsregelingen.

  • Een inspirerende werkomgeving met gedreven collega’s.

  • Ruime mogelijkheden om je werk en ontwikkeling op jouw manier vorm te geven.

Wat je verder van ons kunt verwachten

  • Een can do mentaliteit, met ruimte voor initiatief en ondernemerschap.

  • Een team met veel gezelligheid en humor.

  • Veel ruimte om te leren en ontwikkelen in thema’s die jou pakken.

Kennismaken

Werk jij met ons mee aan de mooiste projecten die Nederland te bieden heeft? Solliciteer direct! In je motivatiebrief zien we, naast jouw geschiktheid en waarom je interesse hebt, graag terug wat jij meeneemt naar TwynstraGudde en waar jij bijzonder in bent. Wil je meer informatie? Neem dan contact op met Erwin Uil via telefoonnummer 033-467 7231.

We nemen na ontvangst van je sollicitatie zo snel mogelijk contact met je op.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel FSP is hiring Site Activation Partners in Mexico, Argentina or Brazil! Candidates must have at least 2 years of experience in start-up working with US/Canada. This is a 7-month temporary assignment with the potential to transition into a full-time role.

The Site Activation Partner(SAP) is responsible for leading or supporting operational activities from start- up to close-out, for assigned studies and investigator sites to ensure compliance with study timelines and in accordance with prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Client standards. Responsibility within a country and may span over more than 1 country depending on the geographical region and business needs.

Organizational Relationships:

Reports to Parexel-assigned Line Management with day-to-day direction from Client; refer to Organizational Chart for details regarding assigned role and associated reporting structure.

Primary Responsibilities:

Clinical Trial Site Activation

  • Initiate and coordinate activities and essential documents management during start-up towards the compilation of a high-quality Investigator Initiation Package (IIP) leading to approval for site initiation

  • Register investigator sites and Client stakeholders in Client registries and systems as required. Update and regularly maintain the registry with accuracy and have it inspection ready

  • Work directly and interact with investigator sites to confirm readiness for site start-up by reviewing study site profile ready in Shared Investigator Platform (SIP) or reviewing/completing critical information Sheet inclusive of but not limited to Investigator Initiation Packages (IIP) essential documents components, Site contracts contacts, clinical supply shipment information, payment information, IRB submission and status

  • Take the lead to resolve issues or concerns and timely escalation of Site issues where applicable

  • Prepare, validate and submit regulatory documents such as completed IIP, IRB approval forms, FDA 1572/Attestation Form, for internal regulatory approval within required timelines

  • Manage and coordinate with other supporting roles to ensure timely site activation and operational activities

  • Support the compilation of the Central Investigator Review Board (IRB) package and submissions to approval of the study (where applicable) and other committees as per country requirements

  • Coordinate the timely communication, documentation and responses between Client and Central Ethics committee to bring clinical study to approval (country dependent)

  • Support investigators sites with local IRB workflow from preparation, submission through approval.

  • Assist with preparation, handling and distribution of non-Clinical Trial Supplies and maintenance of tracking information as needed.

  • Collaborate with the Study Team on the development and readiness of sites electronic Investigator Site File (eISF) when utilized and act as primary point of contact for the sites and manage the Site Operations/CRO monitor access to eISF prior to Site Initiation Visit (SIV).

  • Assist with the preparation, handling, distribution, filing, and archiving of clinical documentation and reports according to the scope of work and standard operating procedures.

  • Support & implement activities in SIP to align with Client strategy as it relates to the role.

  • Coordinate translation of documents that are within scope with the preferred translation vendors.

Clinical Trials Conduct

  • Post site activation, initiate and coordinate activities and essential documents management with the investigator’s sites towards the compilation of a high-quality documents and updates through the life cycle of a study such as the documents management for protocol amendments, FDA 1572/Attestation revisions, Ethics Committee annual approvals and other activities required during study conduct

  • Ensure maintenance of IRB/Ethics and other committees’ activities as applicable

  • Responsible for timely filing of documents to Trial Master File and assisting with periodic quality review of study files for accuracy and completeness

  • Accurately update and maintain clinical trial systems that track site compliance and performance within project timelines

  • Supports investigator sites, and study teams in preparation for and providing responses to site audits / inspections

Internal & External Communication

  • Maintain ongoing contact and communication with the study team and respond promptly to study team and investigator site requests

  • Attend study Start-up meeting and provide functional updates on a country and site level

  • Establish tools for efficient updates to study team as needed regarding site status, issues, delays, approvals

  • Disseminate Central or Local Ethics Approval to study team and Investigator Sites where applicable

  • Communicate Local sites approvals to study team members and stakeholders

Clinical Trial Site Support

  • As needed, perform, awareness session with site personnel on Client requirements and to ensure ongoing compliance with study documentation in accordance with prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Client standards

  • Identify and resolve investigator site issues within required timeframes; align with study team and local country colleagues on corrective and preventative actions to close open issues and to prevent recurrence / persistence of issues

General

  • Completes training assigned by Client and/or EP, as necessary, including general training requirements, SOPs, system and process related training

  • Adhere to EP and Client SOPs and processes

  • A good understanding of the Site Activation requirements and processes within the country/region and be able to learn and potentially implement in more than one (1) country

Additional Responsibilities

  • May be assigned as Site Activation Partner Point of Contact (PoC) on a study conducted in multi- country

  • May be assigned as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on a system and/or process, and represent the SAP function as applicable

  • May represent the SAP role on global initiatives

  • Able to act as an SME on projects and initiatives, as requested

  • Support the mentoring of new hires on processes/ systems

  • Ability to use and learn systems, and to use independently

  • Microsoft Suite

  • Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS)

  • Electronic Trial Master File

  • Electronic Investigator Site File (e.g. Florence)

  • Document exchange portals

  • Shared Investigator Platform

  • Ethics, National Networks and Governing Bodies Portals and platforms (as needed)

Education and Certification:

  • School diploma/certificate with equivalent combination of education, training and experience; Bachelor of Science, Bachelor of Arts or Bachelor’s in Life Sciences preferred

Skills and Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years’ relevant experience in clinical site management, working with US/Canada.

  • Experience working in the pharmaceutical industry/or CRO in study site activation is preferred

  • Knowledge of clinical trial methodologies, ICH/GCP, FDA and Global and local country regulations

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills in relating to colleagues and associates both inside and outside of the organization

  • Good technical skills and ability to learn and use multiple systems

  • Demonstrated knowledge of clinical research and development processes, Key operational elements of a clinical trial, and ability to gain command of process details

  • Understand the quality expectations and emphasis on right first time. Demonstrate compliance with all applicable company, regulatory and country requirements. Attention to detail evident in a disciplined approach

  • Ability to work independently and also as a team member

  • Ability to organize tasks, time and priorities, ability to multi-task

  • Understand basic medical terminology, GCP requirements and proficient in computer operations

Language Skills:

  • Must be fluent in Local language and in English. Multilanguage capability is preferred

jobs.excerpt: Compensation Range:$90,000 - $105,000 Compensation Disclaimer: The salary range listed reflects the base pay for this role at Altus Group and is provided where required by local regulations.
jobs.description:
Compensation Range:

$90,000 - $105,000

Compensation Disclaimer:
The salary range listed reflects the base pay for this role at Altus Group and is provided where required by local regulations. Actual offers may differ based on experience, market conditions, and other relevant factors. The range does not include additional compensation such as bonuses, equity, benefits, or other incentives.

The opportunity

Reporting to the Senior Director, Managed Services, we are hiring a Senior Consultant, Managed Services, also known as a Senior Review Appraiser. As our new Senior Consultant, Managed Services, you will review institutional-grade commercial real estate appraisal reports for TIAA-Nuveen, ensuring valuation theory, assumptions, and supporting analysis are sound. You will assess the reasonableness of key valuation inputs, including cap rates, discount rates, and other assumptions, while helping support consistent and well-informed valuation decisions across a significant real estate portfolio. You will work with appraisal information across approximately 50 real estate funds and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to support high-quality valuation reviews.

This is a US-based role open across 48 states, with a preference for candidates in the Eastern or Central time zones to support collaboration with the India team.

What’s in it for you

Review complex institutional-grade real estate valuations. You will work with sophisticated commercial real estate appraisal reports and evaluate the assumptions, methodologies, and analysis that support major institutional investment decisions.

Bring your expertise to a specialized team. You will join a team supporting TIAA-Nuveen’s real estate valuation needs, with exposure to a broad portfolio of funds and property types within an institutional investment environment.

Use your judgment to influence valuation quality. Your review of cap rates, discount rates, market assumptions, and other valuation inputs will help identify issues, strengthen analysis, and support well-founded valuation conclusions.

Continue developing your appraisal career. You will have the opportunity to apply your appraisal experience in a review-focused role while continuing to build toward the MAI designation and deepen your knowledge of institutional real estate valuation.

Collaborate across teams and locations. You will work with Senior Managers, the Senior Director, and colleagues in India to share insights, discuss valuation considerations, and support consistent review practices.

As our new Senior Consultant, you will:

  • Review institutional appraisals.You will review appraisal reports for institutional-grade commercial real estate, assessing whether the valuation theory, methodology, assumptions, and supporting analysis are accurate and reasonable. You will examine key inputs such as cap rates, discount rates, and other factors that influence valuation conclusions.

  • Assess valuation assumptions.You will use your commercial real estate appraisal expertise to identify questions, inconsistencies, or areas requiring further support. You will apply sound judgment when evaluating the reasonableness of valuation conclusions and the assumptions behind them.

  • Support portfolio valuation oversight.You will contribute to the review of appraisals across approximately 50 real estate funds supporting TIAA-Nuveen. You will help maintain consistency and quality across valuation reviews within an institutional investment environment.

  • Collaborate with appraisal professionals. You will work with Senior Managers, the Senior Director, and other internal stakeholders to discuss appraisal findings, clarify valuation considerations, and support review priorities. You will also collaborate with the India team across time zones.

  • Communicate review findings. You will clearly document and communicate questions, observations, and conclusions arising from your appraisal reviews. You will help ensure valuation considerations are understood and appropriately addressed.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement.The Managed Services team, along with the broader Altus Group organization, strategically integrates artificial intelligence (AI) into its processes and workflows. You will support the integration of AI and process improvements to enhance efficiency, consistency, and decision-making. You will help develop and refine valuation review practices and procedures that promote consistency, and sound valuation judgment.

You bring:

  • The appraisal review experience. You bring 3–5 or more years of experience reviewing appraisals for institutional-grade commercial real estate. You understand how to assess appraisal methodology, valuation theory, market assumptions, and the reasonableness of valuation conclusions.

  • The professional designation and licensing.You hold a state Certified General Appraiser license and are on track to achieve the MAI designation through the Appraisal Institute.

  • The technical proficiency.You have daily or weekly experience using Argus Enterprise and can demonstrate practical fluency with the platform. Experience with Rockport Val or a comparable valuation platform may also be considered.

  • The real estate knowledge.You have a strong understanding of commercial real estate valuation, including cap rates, discount rates, market conditions, and the assumptions that support institutional-grade appraisal reports.

  • The analytical judgment.You can evaluate complex information, identify issues that require further investigation, and form well-supported conclusions. You are comfortable questioning assumptions respectfully and using evidence to support your perspective.

  • The communication and collaboration skills.You communicate clearly and work effectively with colleagues, senior leaders, and external stakeholders. You are engaged, open-minded, and collaborative, with an approach that supports constructive discussion and shared problem-solving.

  • The educational background.An undergraduate or graduate degree in real estate, finance, economics, accounting, or a related field would be an asset. Equivalent knowledge gained through education, training, and practical experience is also valuable.

Apply now

If you're excited about this role but your experience aligns differently with every requirement, we encourage you to apply. While specific qualifications may be strictly required, others can be based on various experiences, backgrounds, and knowledge. We can't promise an interview, but we will consider your whole application.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in the role, your experience, and what you are looking for in your next career opportunity. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.

  • A virtual interview with Senior Managers focused on your commercial real estate appraisal review experience, technical knowledge, collaboration style, and cultural alignment with the team. This interview is expected to be approximately 30 minutes.

  • A technical assessment or Argus case study focused on your practical proficiency with Argus Enterprise and your approach to reviewing valuation assumptions and appraisal analysis.

  • A final interview with the Senior Director, Managed Services, focused on your technical depth, institutional appraisal review experience, valuation judgment, and approach to working with internal and external stakeholders. This interview is expected to be approximately 45–60 minutes.

Unlock your Altus Experience!

If you’re looking to advance your career in in an industry that is transitioning for greatness, there’s no better place than Altus Group.

Our high trust, high performance culture prioritizes progressive programs that empower you to deliver your greatest performance while promoting collective success where everyone is recognized and connected.

We offer boundless opportunities in a rapidly growing global business: mentorship from the best and brightest in CRE, access to our Altus Intelligence Academy, and the chance to work with the best data sets, tools and technology in the industry.

What Altus Group offers:

  • Rewarding performance: competitive compensation, incentive and bonus plans, and a total rewards package prioritizing mental, physical, and financial well-being.

  • Growth and development: we invest in your professional learning. Our Altus Intelligence Academy offers over 150,000 hours of learning content.

  • Flexible work model: our Activity-Based Work model provides flexibility to align your work location to the needs of the work — use the office for collaboration and remote work for focused tasks.

Inclusivity & Accessibility

Altus Group is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where all clients and employees feel welcomed, accepted and valued. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

Applicants with disabilities may contact Altus Group to request and arrange for accommodations.If you need accommodation, please contact us at or +1 888 692 7487.

Use of Artificial Intelligence

AI tools may be used to support the initial stages of screening for this role; however, all assessments and final hiring decisions are reviewed and made by an Altus Group hiring professional.

Background Checks

Please note that as part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure workplace, Altus Group may conduct background checks on candidates who receive a conditional offer of employment. These checks may include, but are not limited to, verification of employment history, education credentials, criminal records, credit history (where relevant), and reference checks. The scope and nature of background checks may vary depending on the role, location, and applicable laws. All background checks will be conducted in compliance with local laws and regulations, and candidates will be informed of any checks required as part of the recruitment process.

Other Notes / Application Process

We appreciate all applicants; however, only those selected to move forward will be contacted. Thank you for your interest in Altus Group.

jobs.excerpt: At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions.
jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

Regional IT Support Developer – MES Focus

We are looking for a Regional IT Support Developer with MES focus to join our dynamic European IT team and support our MES4.0 ecosystem source code level across the region.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people from different countries and cultures, has strong application development and troubleshooting skills, and is eager to deepen their knowledge of Jabil MES systems. The role is ideal for a technical professional who likes solving complex application issues, analyzing code-level problems, improving system stability, and contributing to regional digital transformation initiatives.

The position includes providing L3 code-level application support in rotation with other regional colleagues to ensure 24/7 support coverage for business-critical MES applications.

Your Responsibilities

  • Provide L3 code-level support for MES application(s), and some other critical regional applications.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex application issues, including code, database, interface, and integration-related problems.
  • Participate in a regional support rotation with other colleagues to provide 7x24 hour coverage for critical MES application support.
  • Active participation in Major Incident calls for troubleshooting and fixing the issues
  • Participate on the follow up Problem Management calls and provide feedback for efficient preventive actions identification
  • Build local environment for bug fixing and testing the corrections
  • Analyze incidents, identify root causes, and implement sustainable technical solutions.
  • Develop, enhance, and maintain application components using technologies such as Angular, .NET, .NET Core, C#, SQL, and RabbitMQ.
  • Support MES ecosystem integrations with other business and manufacturing systems.
  • Work closely with Site SMEs, Digital Factory teams, IT Support teams, infrastructure teams, Devops and DBA colleagues and other regional/global counterparts.
  • Participate in regional and cross-functional IT projects, providing technical expertise and development support.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and knowledgebase articles.
  • Propose and implement continuous improvements to increase application reliability, performance, supportability, and user experience.
  • Support application testing, deployment validation, and post-release stabilization activities.

What We’re Looking For

  • Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in application development and/or application support.
  • Strong technical experience with the following technology stack:
    • Angular, Typescript
    • .NET, .NET Core
    • C#
    • SQL
    • RabbitMQ
    • Rest APIs
    • Azure Devops , git
    • EKS, Docker
    • aws services
  • Proven experience in troubleshooting complex application issues.
  • Ability to analyze logs, code, database queries, interfaces, and application behavior to identify root causes.
  • Experience supporting business-critical applications in a production environment.
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle, release management, and incident/problem management processes.
  • Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
  • Ability to work with multicultural teams across multiple countries and time zones.
  • Willingness to participate in regional 24/7 support rotation.
  • Willingness to travel regionally if required.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Has a strong developer mindset and enjoys solving technical problems.
  • Takes ownership of incidents, tasks, and technical improvements.
  • Is confident working with code, databases, integrations, and application logs.
  • Can remain calm and structured during critical production issues.
  • Asks questions, challenges assumptions, and learns from mistakes.
  • Is proactive, self-driven, and eager to continuously improve.
  • Thrives in a collaborative, multicultural environment.
  • Has a continuous improvement mindset with an Agile and Lean attitude.
  • Understands the importance of stable manufacturing systems and fast issue resolution.

Plus, but Not a Must

  • Experience with Jabil MES systems and the MES4.0 ecosystem.
  • Experience with Mendix.
  • Understanding of manufacturing, shopfloor, and business processes.
  • Experience with application monitoring, logging, and performance analysis.
  • Knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, or source control tools.
  • Experience working in a regional or global IT support organization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in application development, application support, or a similar technical role.
  • Experience in a manufacturing environment is preferred.
  • Experience with MES or production-critical applications is a strong advantage.

Опис вакансії
Регіональний IT Support Developer – фокус MES

Ми шукаємо регіонального IT Support Developer з фокусом на MES, який приєднається до нашої динамічної європейської IT-команди та підтримуватиме вихідний код екосистеми MES4.0 по всьому регіону.

Це чудова можливість для людини, яка любить працювати з колегами з різних країн і культур, має сильні навички розробки та усунення технічних проблем, а також хоче поглибити знання систем MES Jabil. Роль ідеально підходить для технічного спеціаліста, який отримує задоволення від вирішення складних проблем застосунків, аналізу проблем на рівні коду, покращення стабільності систем і участі в ініціативах цифрової трансформації регіону.

Посада передбачає надання L3 підтримки на рівні коду у ротації з іншими регіональними колегами, щоб забезпечити цілодобову (24/7) підтримку критично важливих MES-застосунків для бізнесу.

Ваші обов’язки

  • Надавати L3 підтримку на рівні коду для MES-застосунків та інших критично важливих регіональних систем.
  • Усувати складні проблеми застосунків, включно з кодом, базами даних, інтерфейсами та інтеграціями.
  • Брати участь у регіональній ротації підтримки разом із колегами для забезпечення 24/7 підтримки критичних MES-застосунків.
  • Активно брати участь у дзвінках щодо Major Incident для вирішення інцидентів.
  • Брати участь у подальших дзвінках Problem Management та надавати фідбек для визначення ефективних превентивних дій.
  • Створювати локальне середовище для виправлення багів і тестування виправлень.
  • Аналізувати інциденти, визначати першопричини та впроваджувати стійкі технічні рішення.
  • Розробляти, покращувати та підтримувати компоненти застосунків із використанням технологій Angular, .NET, .NET Core, C#, SQL, RabbitMQ.
  • Підтримувати інтеграції MES-екосистеми з іншими бізнес- та виробничими системами.
  • Тісно співпрацювати з локальними SME, Digital Factory командами, IT підтримкою, інфраструктурними командами, DevOps та DBA, а також регіональними і глобальними колегами.
  • Брати участь у регіональних та міжфункціональних IT-проєктах, надаючи технічну експертизу та підтримку розробки.
  • Створювати та підтримувати технічну документацію, інструкції з усунення несправностей та базу знань.
  • Пропонувати та впроваджувати покращення для підвищення надійності, продуктивності, зручності підтримки та користувацького досвіду.
  • Підтримувати тестування застосунків, валідацію релізів та стабілізацію після релізів.

Що ми шукаємо

  • Мінімум 4 роки практичного досвіду в розробці застосунків та/або їх підтримці.
  • Сильний технічний досвід зі стеком технологій:
    • Angular, TypeScript
    • .NET, .NET Core
    • C#
    • SQL
    • RabbitMQ
    • REST API
    • Azure DevOps, Git
    • EKS, Docker
    • AWS сервіси
  • Досвід усунення складних технічних проблем.
  • Уміння аналізувати логи, код, SQL-запити, інтерфейси та поведінку систем для визначення першопричин.
  • Досвід підтримки критично важливих бізнес-застосунків у продакшн-середовищі.
  • Розуміння життєвого циклу розробки ПЗ, реліз-менеджменту та процесів інцидент- і проблем-менеджменту.
  • Добрі комунікаційні навички англійською мовою (усно та письмово).
  • Здатність працювати з мультикультурними командами в різних країнах і часових поясах.
  • Готовність брати участь у регіональній 24/7 ротації підтримки.
  • Готовність до регіональних відряджень за потреби.

Ідеальний кандидат

  • Має сильне мислення розробника та любить вирішувати технічні задачі.
  • Бере відповідальність за інциденти, задачі та технічні покращення.
  • Впевнено працює з кодом, базами даних, інтеграціями та логами.
  • Зберігає спокій і структурованість під час критичних інцидентів у продакшені.
  • Ставить запитання, ставить під сумнів припущення та навчається на помилках.
  • Проактивний, самостійний і прагне постійного вдосконалення.
  • Добре працює в команді та мультикультурному середовищі.
  • Має mindset безперервного покращення (Agile та Lean підхід).
  • Розуміє важливість стабільності виробничих систем і швидкого вирішення проблем.

Плюсом, але не обов’язково

  • Досвід роботи з системами Jabil MES та екосистемою MES4.0.
  • Досвід роботи з Mendix.
  • Розуміння виробничих процесів (shopfloor) та бізнес-процесів.
  • Досвід моніторингу застосунків, логування та аналізу продуктивності.
  • Знання DevOps практик, CI/CD або інструментів контролю версій.
  • Досвід роботи в регіональній або глобальній IT-підтримці.

Кваліфікації

  • Бакалавр у сфері інформаційних технологій, інженерії, комп’ютерних наук, бізнес-інформатики або суміжних спеціальностей.
  • Мінімум 4 роки досвіду в розробці застосунків, їх підтримці або подібній технічній ролі.
  • Досвід у виробничому середовищі є перевагою.
  • Досвід з MES або критичними виробничими системами є сильним плюсом.

jobs.description:
Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, you will lead the regional sales organization for UPLIZNA in Neurology (gMG and NMOSD), translating brand strategy into focused execution and delivering results through a high-performing team.

The Regional Sales Director (RSD) is accountable for the leadership, performance and development of the UPLIZNA Neurology sales organization across the assigned region. This leader will establish regional strategy, create clarity around priorities and expectations, and develop District Managers and field teams to execute with excellence. The RSD will operate as a senior commercial leader and strategic business partner, using market insights, customer understanding and cross-functional collaboration to identify opportunities, remove barriers and drive sustainable performance in a complex rare disease marketplace.

  • Lead the region as a business, translating UPLIZNA brand priorities into a focused regional strategy, clear execution imperatives, measurable standards and disciplined operating rhythms.
  • Deliver business results through others by equipping District Managers as force multipliers, setting clear performance expectations, using leading indicators to identify opportunities and risks early, and driving timely action and accountability.
  • Coach and develop District Managers through a consistent observe, diagnose, practice and follow-up approach that strengthens leadership capability, business acumen, coaching quality, decision-making and representative performance.
  • Build and sustain a high-performing, inclusive and compliant culture grounded in Amgen values, patient focus, operational excellence, accountability, scientific integrity and clear, credible leadership communication.

The Forward Deploy Engineer is the central point of contact and technical liaison for MDI customers in active implementation and supporting existing customers as they expand their integration offerings. You’ll lead the technical implementation process from kickoff to go-live, mapping and configuring API connections, reviewing logs, and troubleshooting issues to keep integrations on track.

This role is ideal for someone technically literate and highly comfortable working with APIs who enjoys problem-solving, learning new systems, and explaining complex concepts clearly to non-technical customers. This is not a software engineering role: you won’t be writing production code, but you will need to be confident configuring, testing, and debugging API connections independently. You’ll partner closely with the partner success and engineering teams, escalating clearly documented issues when they’re beyond the scope of this role.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Serve as the technical point of contact for new customers throughout implementation, and for existing customers expanding their integration footprint, guiding each engagement from kickoff through go-live.
  2. Lead the end-to-end technical implementation process, mapping and configuring API connections with customers and validating setup over screen share in real time. The average implementation timeline is days, not months.
  3. Monitor logs, dashboards, and tools like Postman to identify when APIs are misconfigured or behaving unexpectedly, and independently resolve the majority of issues without engineering involvement.
  4. Draft clear technical documentation for each issue encountered, including root cause, steps taken, and resolution, to build a reliable internal record and knowledge base.
  5. Escalate unresolved or complex issues to engineering with well-documented context, ensuring a smooth handoff and minimal back-and-forth.
  6. Translate customer inquiries and data needs into clear technical tasks and configuration notes, acting as the bridge between customer expectations and technical execution.
  7. Partner with the Partner Success Managers and Clinical Support teams to align technical capabilities with customer expectations throughout the relationship.
  8. Identify recurring issues or friction points across implementations and recommend ways to simplify, document, or automate the process.
  9. Maintain a high level of responsiveness, ownership, and customer empathy across both the finite implementation period and ongoing expansion work.

Success Looks Like…

  • Quick integration timelines driving a seamless go-live.
  • High customer satisfaction scores during integration and beyond.
  • Low number of escalations needing hands-on engineering resources.
  • Accuracy and completeness of documentation.
  • Responsiveness and collaboration across technical and customer teams.

  • 3+ years’ experience in a customer-facing technical support or implementation role with an emphasis on API-driven applications. Must be comfortable working with customers’ technical teams live, troubleshooting on video calls.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, webhooks, JSON payloads, and HTTP status codes; comfortable reading logs and API documentation to identify root cause and resolve configuration issues without engineering support.
  • Familiarity with data mapping, payload structures, or basic scripting (Python, JavaScript, or SQL).
  • Experience using tools such as HubSpot, Postman or equivalent for troubleshooting and testing API calls.
  • Technically-savvy and able to communicate technical concepts and processes to both technical and non-technical users. This is a technical support/implementation role, not a software development role, so you won’t be writing production code, but you should be able to independently resolve the majority of configuration and integration issues you encounter.
  • Experience documenting integration processes or producing customer-facing support materials for internal and external use including workflows, process diagrams and SOPs.
  • High attention to detail and organization; able to manage multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and ability to learn new systems, data flows, and integration logic quickly.
  • Customer-first mindset: you thrive in helping customers solve problems and find clarity.
  • Experience in SaaS or healthcare technology integrations, a plus.

jobs.excerpt: 🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy¿Eres policía, guardia civil, funcionario/a de prisiones o preparas estas oposiciones?
jobs.description:
🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy

¿Eres policía, guardia civil, funcionario/a de prisiones o preparas estas oposiciones? Colabora en remoto con Polaris x Ucademy y ayuda a otros a conseguir su plaza.

📚 Oposiciones para las que buscamos preparadores

  • Policía Nacional (Escala Básica)

  • Guardia Civil (Escala de Cabos y Guardias)

  • Policía Municipal de Madrid

  • Policía Local de Andalucía

  • Policía Local de la Comunitat Valenciana

  • Ayudante de Instituciones Penitenciarias (Subgrupo C1)

  • Otras oposiciones de FYCSE

🌟 Quiénes somos

En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros.

Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento.

Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia. La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.

🔎 A quién buscamos

  • Agentes y funcionarios/as en activo o en excedencia (Policía Nacional, Guardia Civil, policías locales o Instituciones Penitenciarias) y preparadores/as de estas oposiciones.

  • Personas que conozcan el proceso completo por dentro: temario, psicotécnicos, ortografía, pruebas físicas, entrevista personal y reconocimiento médico.

  • Quienes sepan enseñar y acompañar: explicar con claridad, dar feedback útil y ayudar a sostener la preparación hasta el final.

  • Soltura con herramientas digitales. Si ya utilizas IA en tu día a día, mucho mejor.

🎯 En qué podrás colaborar

Según tu perfil, especialidad y disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos:

  • Clases online dinámicas, prácticas y cercanas.

  • Temario y actualización normativa, clave en estas convocatorias.

  • Preguntas tipo test, psicotécnicos y simulacros con el formato real del examen.

  • Preparación de las pruebas físicas: planes de entrenamiento, técnica y seguimiento.

  • Entrevista personal y pruebas de personalidad: simulacros y feedback.

  • Seguimiento de alumnos: resolver dudas y ayudarles a avanzar.

  • Vídeos cortos, esquemas y resúmenes.

🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración

No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educativos concretos, compatible con tu actividad profesional.

Si estás en activo, no te pedimos que dejes tu puesto. Queremos que pongas tu experiencia al servicio de otros opositores de una forma flexible.

🌍 100 % remoto
🕐 Horarios y disponibilidad a convenir
📚 Proyectos y entregables definidos desde el inicio
💰 Compensación competitiva según el proyecto y los entregables

🎬 Cómo es el proceso de selección

Queremos conocerte enseñando, no solo leyendo tu CV. El proceso tiene cuatro pasos:

1. Revisión de perfil. En la candidatura responderás a unas preguntas breves y nos enviarás un vídeo de presentación de 1 minuto. Grábalo con el móvil, sin complicaciones: cuéntanos quién eres, tu experiencia y qué oposición dominas.

2. Contacto de validación. Si tu perfil encaja, nos pondremos en contacto contigo por llamada o por escrito para resolver dudas, conocer tu disponibilidad y explicarte cómo colaboramos.

3. Clase de prueba. Te pediremos que nos envíes una clase grabada de máximo 5 minutos sobre un concepto de tu oposición, con un material de apoyo creado por ti. No buscamos una producción perfecta: queremos ver cómo explicas y cómo haces sencillo lo difícil.

4. Entrevista. Si tu clase encaja, te invitaremos a una entrevista para conocerte mejor, comentar tu clase y hablar de los proyectos en los que podrías colaborar.

Si conoces el camino hacia una plaza y quieres ayudar a otros a recorrerlo, queremos conocerte.

👉 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy.

jobs.description:
Aras is a leading provider of digital thread solutions for product lifecycle management (PLM) and engineering AI. As one of the fastest growing PLM companies, our AI-native, low-code platform enables the rapid delivery of flexible solutions that connect teams across disciplines and functions to critical product data and agentic AI throughout the product lifecycle and extended value chain.

The world's largest manufacturers leverage Aras Innovator to manage complex product lifecycles, accelerate innovation, improve operational efficiency, and bring products to market faster. We collaborate with companies in some of the world's most innovative industries, including automotive, industrial equipment, aerospace and defense, high tech, and life sciences.

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our L3 Support engineering team and help resolve complex escalated issues in Aras Innovator, our enterprise low-code platform. In this role, you will investigate issues across the application stack, identify root causes, deliver fixes and improvements for customer-reported problems, and help improve platform stability across SaaS, on-premises, and hybrid deployment models.

What You'll Be Doing

You will help diagnose, resolve, and prevent production issues affecting Aras Innovator customers.

  • Investigate complex issues and identify root causes across the application stack.
  • Drive escalated customer issues through analysis, fix development, testing, and deployment.
  • Develop enhancements, and product improvements that address customer-reported issues.
  • Evaluate technical approaches and work with product teams to refine solutions.
  • Support customer upgrades and adapt existing functionality to newer product versions.
  • Balance incoming escalations with planned improvement work as part of the team.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code using modern engineering and AI-assisted development practices.
  • Use troubleshooting and profiling tools to diagnose performance and stability issues.
  • Improve CI/CD and DevOps practices to streamline the delivery process.
  • Enhance platform reliability, scalability, performance, and security.
  • Share knowledge and help improve support and engineering practices.

Who You Are

  • An initiative-taking engineer who owns outcomes and follows through.
  • Analytical and methodical, with a strong drive to understand how and why issues occur.
  • Comfortable troubleshooting unfamiliar, ambiguous, or business-critical issues.
  • Customer-focused, with the ability to balance urgent escalations with longer-term improvement work.
  • A collaborative teammate who is eager to learn, grow, and support others.
  • Able to explain technical issues clearly to both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders.

What You'll Need

  • Commercial software development experience (3+ years with .net in production).
  • Strong knowledge of C# / .NET, with a solid understanding of OOP principles.
  • Experience with MS SQL Server and strong T-SQL
  • Experience using troubleshooting, diagnostic, and profiling tools.
  • Good knowledge of JavaScript/Typescript.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs and HTTP-based standards such as OData.
  • Proficiency with Git or another distributed version control system.
  • Experience working in Agile or Kanban development environments.
  • Intermediate+ or higher English proficiency, both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • Ability to use AI tools effectively in daily engineering work, including development, debugging, troubleshooting, and productivity tasks.
  • Experience working with large enterprise systems and legacy environments.
  • Experience with client-side development.
  • Direct experience with Docker, Kubernetes (AKS or Azure Container Apps), and Helm.

About Spokeo:

Spokeo is a people intelligence platform that helps over 18 million monthly visitors reconnect with friends, reunite with families, and build trust in new relationships. Thousands of companies also trust Spokeo’s 60 billion public records to improve customer research, help verify information, and prevent fraud.

Founded in 2006, Spokeo has built a dedicated, remote-first team with an average tenure of 6.9 years. It has earned recognition from Comparably as a Best Company for Compensation, Employee Happiness, Perks and Benefits, Support for Women, Work-Life Balance, and CEO Leadership.

About this Opportunity

Spokeo is seeking a Data Engineering Manager to help build a state-of-the-art analytics platform. As a Data Engineering Manager, you will report directly to our Director of Data Engineering and lead a cross-functional team of data engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable data solutions that meet our data, reporting, and analytics needs. You will provide leadership and technical skills to champion and implement data governance, data integrity, data engineering standards, data integration, and QA best practices. You will partner closely with our Product Owners to understand requirements, provide technical guidance to the team, and ensure the timely delivery of quality solutions.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead and manage data engineers to build data solutions for our business intelligence needs

  • Lead a cross-functional team in building a state-of-the-art data analytics platform

  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, product managers, and executives to understand and fulfill our data needs

  • Lead database development, data pipeline, integration, ETL, modeling, and data architecture using AWS technologies

  • Define and manage SLA’s for all data sets and reporting processes

  • Develop software engineering best practices, guidelines, procedures, and repeatable and scalable frameworks

  • Document, automate, and enforce data quality, data integrity, and QA best practices

What you’ve done:

  • 7+ years of experience in Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing

  • 5+ years of experience with cloud solutions (AWS, Azure)

  • 5+ years of experience with big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, MapReduce, Hive, Kafka)

  • 5+ years of experience with data pipelines orchestration tools like Airflow.

  • 2+ years of experience managing data engineering teams, providing technical guidance, and mentoring data engineers.

  • Expertise in data lakes, warehouses, modeling, ETL, and big data platforms.

  • Familiarity with MLOps to help design, automate, and streamline the entire lifecycle of ML models.

  • Expertise in RDBMS, SQL, query optimization, and security

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Management, or a related field

  • Attention to detail, excellent problem-solving ability, and strong communication skills


Working at Spokeo

Our mission is to advance transparency, and to achieve that goal, we rally around six core values: listening with empathy, understanding the why, clarifying with data, innovating to learn, collaborating to achieve, and insisting on quality.

As a remote-first company, we are able to hire team members residing in the following US states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, KY, MD, MI, MO, NJ, NV, NC, PA, SC, SD, TX, VA, WA, or WY.

In addition to a highly competitive base salary, our generous benefits include:

  • annual bonus program

  • stock options

  • 401K matching

  • 100% medical/dental/vision coverage

  • unlimited PTO

  • mental health resources

  • paid home office equipment

  • fitness reimbursements

  • support paying for courses

  • and more

We extend written offers to candidates who successfully complete their selection process. Offers will depend on several factors, including, but not limited to, marketplace competition, job leveling, experience, and skills.

Privacy Notice for Candidates:

Spokeo is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status. Spokeo fosters a business culture where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best products, and be relevant in a rapidly changing world.
